attributes.references: Informatica MDM Cross-Reference; SAP S/4HANA MM Document Number

attributes.name: total_order_cost
attributes.description: The total cost of the replenishment order calculated as approved_quantity multiplied by unit_cost. Represents the financial commitment for this replenishment event. Used for Open to Buy (OTB) budget tracking and P&L reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 330 — Inventory Valuation; FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; NRF OTB Management

attributes.name: trigger_type
attributes.description: The mechanism that triggered this replenishment order. reorder_point = on-hand fell below reorder point threshold; min_max = inventory fell below minimum level; days_of_supply = Weeks of Supply (WOS) fell below threshold; manual_override = buyer-initiated; vmi_signal = Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) supplier signal; promotional = triggered by upcoming promotion event. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: reorder_point|min_max|days_of_supply|manual_override|vmi_signal|promotional — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning Replenishment Triggers; NRF Inventory Replenishment Best Practices

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: The Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) per unit for this SKU at the time of the replenishment order, sourced from the SAP S/4HANA MM purchasing info record or the retail merchandising system Merchandising System (ORMS). Used for inventory valuation and GMROI analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 330 — Inventory Valuation; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO COGS; NRF GMROI Standards

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure in which ordered, approved, and received quantities are expressed. EA = Each, CS = Case, PL = Pallet, KG = Kilogram, LB = Pound, LT = Liter. Aligns with GS1 unit of measure codes.
attributes.references: GS1 Unit of Measure Codes; SAP S/4HANA MM Base Unit of Measure

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this replenishment order record was last modified in the Silver Layer data platform. Supports change detection and incremental processing.

products.name: cycle_count
products.description: Scheduled and ad-hoc physical inventory cycle count events at the SKU-location level. Captures count schedule, assigned counter, counted quantity, system quantity at time of count, variance quantity, variance percentage, count status (scheduled, in-progress, completed, reconciled), and approval workflow. Supports shrinkage investigation, inventory accuracy KPIs, and Sarbanes-Oxley inventory controls. Variances exceeding tolerance thresholds generate inventory_adjustment records for reconciliation.

attributes.name: cycle_count_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each cycle count event record at the SKU-location level.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module

attributes.name: adjustment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inventory adjustment record created as a result of this cycle count variance exceeding the tolerance threshold. Links the count event to its financial reconciliation record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail FI/CO Module; FASB ASC 330 Inventory

attributes.name: cost_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.cost_price. Business justification: Cycle count variance_cost calculation requires the authoritative cost price record. cycle_count already has sku_price_id but lacks cost_price_id. Linking to cost_price enables accurate financial varia

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.department. Business justification: Retail cycle count programs are scheduled and reported at department level — grocery, apparel, and electronics departments have distinct count frequencies and variance tolerances. Department-level cou

attributes.name: inventory_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.inventory_node. Business justification: cycle_count records physical inventory count events at the SKU-location level. inventory_node is the canonical master for every inventory-holding location. While cycle_count currently references store

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inventory node (store, Distribution Center (DC), or Micro-Fulfillment Center (MFC)) where the cycle count is being performed.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) being counted in this cycle count event.
attributes.references: GS1; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); Informatica MDM

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_position. Business justification: cycle_count records physical inventory count events at the SKU-location level. stock_position is the real-time on-hand record for that same SKU-location. A direct FK from cycle_count to stock_position

attributes.name: warehouse_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.warehouse_zone. Business justification: Retail DC cycle counts are organized and scheduled by warehouse zone. This link enables zone-level count frequency compliance reporting, accuracy trending by zone, and WMS-driven count scheduling — a

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: ABC classification of the SKU at the time of the cycle count, indicating inventory value and velocity tier. A = high-value/high-velocity; B = medium; C = low-value/low-velocity; D = dead stock. Drives count frequency prioritization.
attributes.references: NRF Inventory Accuracy Standards; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: adjustment_generated
attributes.description: Indicates whether an inventory_adjustment record has been generated from this cycle count variance. When True, the variance has been posted to the inventory ledger for reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail FI/CO Module; FASB ASC 330 Inventory; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the cycle count result was reviewed and approved by the designated supervisor or manager, completing the approval workflow.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: count_device_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the handheld scanner, mobile device, or RFID reader used to perform the physical count. Supports device-level audit trail and equipment calibration tracking.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: count_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the physical counting activity was completed and the count was submitted by the assigned counter.

attributes.name: count_frequency
attributes.description: The scheduled counting frequency for this SKU-location combination, typically driven by ABC classification or velocity. High-velocity A-items are counted more frequently than slow-moving C-items.
attributes.references: NRF Inventory Accuracy Standards; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: count_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for the counter or supervisor to record observations, exceptions, or explanations related to the cycle count result (e.g., damaged packaging, items in transit, display stock not included).
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404

attributes.name: count_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business reference number assigned to the cycle count event, used for cross-system tracking and audit trail. Typically generated by the WMS (e.g., Manhattan Associates) or SAP WM module.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module

attributes.name: count_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the physical counting activity was initiated by the assigned counter. Used for cycle time analysis and labor tracking.

attributes.name: count_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the cycle count event. 'scheduled' = count is planned but not started; 'in_progress' = counting is underway; 'completed' = physical count recorded; 'reconciled' = variance reviewed and inventory adjustment posted; 'cancelled' = count was voided.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404

attributes.name: count_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cycle count method. 'scheduled' = routine planned count; 'ad_hoc' = unplanned triggered count; 'blind' = counter does not see system quantity; 'directed' = WMS-directed count task; 'rfid_assisted' = count performed using Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) technology.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; NRF Inventory Accuracy Standards

attributes.name: counted_quantity
attributes.description: The actual physical quantity of the SKU observed and recorded by the counter during the cycle count. This is the primary measured outcome of the count event.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module; FASB ASC 330 Inventory

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cycle count record was first created in the system, establishing the audit trail for SOX inventory controls.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the monetary values (variance_cost, unit_cost) recorded in this cycle count record (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The retail fiscal period (year and period number, e.g., 2024-P06) during which the cycle count was performed. Used for period-end inventory accuracy reporting and financial close processes.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 330 Inventory; SAP S/4HANA Retail FI/CO Module

attributes.name: planogram_location
attributes.description: The planogram (POG) shelf position or fixture reference for the SKU at the store location, used to direct the counter to the correct physical location during in-store cycle counts.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); NRF Visual Merchandising Standards

attributes.name: recount_number
attributes.description: Sequential count of how many times this SKU-location has been recounted within the same cycle count event. First count = 1; first recount = 2; etc. Supports escalation workflows when repeated recounts still show variance.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404

attributes.name: recount_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a recount of this SKU-location is required because the variance exceeded the tolerance threshold or the count was flagged for discrepancy. When True, a follow-up count must be performed before reconciliation.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; NRF Inventory Accuracy Standards

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the cycle count was planned to be performed, as set in the WMS count schedule.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module

attributes.name: shrinkage_category
attributes.description: Classification of the root cause of inventory shrinkage identified through this cycle count. Populated during the reconciliation phase when a negative variance is confirmed. Supports shrinkage investigation and loss prevention analytics.
attributes.references: NRF Retail Security Survey; FTC Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: storage_bin
attributes.description: The specific warehouse storage bin, shelf, or slot location within the inventory node where the SKU is physically stored and counted. Granular location identifier used by the WMS for directed counting.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module

attributes.name: system_quantity
attributes.description: The inventory quantity recorded in the Warehouse Management System (WMS) or ERP at the exact time the cycle count was initiated. This is the 'book' quantity against which the physical count is compared.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module; FASB ASC 330 Inventory

attributes.name: trigger_reason
attributes.description: Business reason that initiated this cycle count. Supports shrinkage investigation and root cause analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: routine|negative_inventory|shrinkage_alert|receiving_discrepancy|customer_complaint|audit_request|rfid_discrepancy — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NRF Inventory Accuracy Standards; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: The Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) unit cost of the SKU at the time the cycle count was performed, used to calculate the financial impact of any inventory variance.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 330 Inventory; SAP S/4HANA Retail FI/CO Module

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure in which the SKU quantity is expressed for this cycle count (e.g., EA = Each, CS = Case, PK = Pack, LB = Pound, KG = Kilogram). Aligns with the GS1 unit of measure standard. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PK|LB|KG|OZ|FT|M|L|GAL — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 Unit of Measure Standards; SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cycle count record was last modified, supporting audit trail and change tracking requirements.

attributes.name: variance_cost
attributes.description: The monetary value of the inventory variance, calculated as variance_quantity multiplied by the unit cost at time of count. Expressed in the local operating currency. Used for Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) impact assessment and financial reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 330 Inventory; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Retail FI/CO Module

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: The variance quantity expressed as a percentage of the system on-hand quantity, calculated as (variance_quantity / system_quantity) * 100. Used to assess inventory accuracy and trigger shrinkage investigations when thresholds are exceeded.
attributes.references: NRF Inventory Accuracy Standards; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; FASB ASC 330 Inventory

attributes.name: variance_quantity
attributes.description: The difference between the physically counted quantity and the system on-hand quantity (counted_quantity minus system_quantity). A negative value indicates shrinkage or loss; a positive value indicates an overcount or unrecorded receipt.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 330 Inventory; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; NRF Inventory Accuracy Standards

attributes.name: variance_tolerance_pct
attributes.description: The maximum acceptable variance percentage for this SKU-location before a recount or inventory adjustment is triggered. Variances exceeding this threshold generate inventory_adjustment records for reconciliation.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; NRF Inventory Accuracy Standards; FASB ASC 330 Inventory

products.name: adjustment
products.description: Records all inventory quantity adjustments at the SKU-location level including shrinkage events, damage write-downs, cycle count corrections, receiving variances, expiry write-offs, and RTVs. Captures adjustment reason category, sub-reason (e.g., shoplifting, employee theft, admin error for shrinkage), adjusted quantity, cost impact, detection method, authorizing user, approval status, and loss prevention case reference where applicable. Feeds the stock_ledger and serves as the SSOT for all non-transactional inventory changes and shrinkage monitoring.

attributes.name: adjustment_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each inventory adjustment record. Serves as the primary key for the adjustment data product and is referenced by the stock ledger and loss prevention systems.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module

attributes.name: cost_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.cost_price. Business justification: Shrinkage and adjustment financial impact calculations require cost basis. GL posting, P&L impact analysis, and loss prevention reporting depend on linking adjustments to the cost structure for accura

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.department. Business justification: Loss-prevention and shrinkage reporting in retail is managed at department level. Adjustments must be attributed to a department for departmental P&L, shrinkage rate tracking, and compliance audits. d

attributes.name: inventory_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.inventory_node. Business justification: adjustment records all inventory quantity adjustments (shrinkage, damage, recalls) at the SKU-location level. inventory_node is the canonical master for every inventory-holding location. While adjustm

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific inventory node (store, Distribution Center (DC), Micro-Fulfillment Center (MFC), or dark store) where the adjustment is being recorded. Supports omnichannel inventory visibility.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module

attributes.name: order_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order_line. Business justification: Returns and omnichannel cancellations generate inventory adjustments traceable to a specific order line. Adjustment already links to pos_transaction for POS returns but has no FK for omnichannel retur

attributes.name: pos_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.pos_transaction. Business justification: Inventory adjustments for shrinkage, damage, or discrepancies are often discovered during POS operations (cashier finds damaged item, customer returns defective product). Linking adjustment to origina

attributes.name: recall_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.recall. Business justification: Recall-driven inventory adjustments (quarantine, write-off, RTV) are a named retail business process requiring direct linkage to the specific recall record for financial impact reporting, recovery rat

attributes.name: reversal_of_adjustment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the original adjustment record that this record is reversing. Populated only for reversal entries to maintain a complete audit trail of corrections. Nullable for original (non-reversal) adjustments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; FASB ASC 330 Inventory Accounting

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) whose inventory quantity is being adjusted. Links to the product master to identify the item at the variant level (size, color, style).
attributes.references: GS1 Global Product Classification; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: stock_ledger_id
attributes.description: Reference to the corresponding stock ledger entry created when this adjustment was posted. Establishes the audit trail between the adjustment record and the resulting stock position change. Nullable until the adjustment reaches 'posted' status.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; FASB ASC 330

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_position. Business justification: adjustment records inventory quantity changes at the SKU-location level. stock_position is the real-time on-hand record for that same SKU-location. A direct FK from adjustment to stock_position links

attributes.name: adjusted_quantity
attributes.description: The net quantity change applied to on-hand inventory for the SKU at the specified location. Negative values represent inventory reductions (shrinkage, damage, write-offs); positive values represent inventory additions (found stock, receiving corrections). Expressed in the SKU's unit of measure.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; FASB ASC 330

attributes.name: adjustment_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for the adjustment transaction. Used in audit trails, loss prevention case references, and cross-system reconciliation with SAP S/4HANA and ORMS. Format: ADJ- followed by 10 digits.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: adjustment_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the adjustment record. Controls whether the adjustment has been applied to the stock ledger. 'posted' indicates the adjustment has updated on-hand quantities; 'reversed' indicates a correcting entry was made.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: adjustment_timestamp
attributes.description: The principal real-world date and time when the inventory adjustment event occurred (e.g., when shrinkage was detected, when a cycle count discrepancy was identified, when damage was observed). Distinct from system audit timestamps. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; FASB ASC 330 Inventory Accounting

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the adjustment has been reviewed and approved through the authorization workflow. 'auto_approved' applies to system-generated adjustments below a defined threshold that bypass manual review. Distinct from adjustment_status which tracks the full posting lifecycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; NRF Loss Prevention Standards; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the adjustment was approved or rejected by the authorizing user. Used for SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance tracking on adjustment processing turnaround. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Batch or lot number of the inventory being adjusted, applicable for batch-tracked SKUs such as food, pharmaceuticals, and regulated products. Required for FDA recall traceability and CPSC product safety compliance. Nullable for non-batch-tracked items.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA); CPSC Product Safety Standards; GS1 Batch/Lot Traceability

attributes.name: cost_impact
attributes.description: Total financial impact of the inventory adjustment on Cost of Goods Sold (COGS), calculated as adjusted_quantity multiplied by unit_cost. Negative values represent write-downs (losses); positive values represent write-ups (gains). Posted to the general ledger via SAP FI/CO integration.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 330 Inventory Accounting; SAP S/4HANA Retail FI/CO Module; FTC Pricing Transparency

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System audit timestamp recording when the adjustment record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit compliance, and SLA tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the cost impact and unit cost are expressed (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR, CAD). Required for multi-currency retail operations and financial consolidation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency

attributes.name: detection_method
attributes.description: The method by which the inventory discrepancy or adjustment need was identified. Supports shrinkage root-cause analysis and RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) program effectiveness measurement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cycle_count|physical_inventory|rfid_scan|pos_exception|receiving_audit|system_alert|manual_observation|loss_prevention_investigation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NRF Retail Loss Prevention Standards; Manhattan Associates WMS; GS1 RFID Standards

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The expiration or best-before date of the inventory being written off, applicable for perishable grocery, food, and pharmaceutical SKUs. Required for FDA food safety compliance and expiry write-off reporting. Nullable for non-perishable items. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA); CPSC Product Safety Standards

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal accounting period (year and period number) to which this adjustment is attributed for financial reporting and shrinkage rate analysis. Format: YYYY-P## (e.g., 2024-P01 through 2024-P13 for 4-4-5 retail calendar).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 330 Inventory Accounting; National Retail Federation (NRF) Retail Calendar Standards

attributes.name: is_shrinkage
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this adjustment represents a shrinkage event (inventory loss due to theft, damage, administrative error, or vendor fraud). Used to filter and aggregate shrinkage metrics for loss prevention reporting and GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) analysis.
attributes.references: NRF Retail Loss Prevention Standards; FASB ASC 330

attributes.name: is_system_generated
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the adjustment was automatically generated by a system process (e.g., Blue Yonder replenishment system, RFID reconciliation engine, WMS cycle count automation) rather than manually entered by a user.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; Blue Yonder Demand Planning; SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inventory node type where the adjustment occurred. Distinguishes between store-level adjustments, Distribution Center (DC) adjustments, Micro-Fulfillment Center (MFC) adjustments, and dark store adjustments for segmented shrinkage and variance reporting.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module; NRF Standards

attributes.name: lp_case_reference
attributes.description: Reference number linking this inventory adjustment to an active or closed Loss Prevention (LP) investigation case (e.g., shoplifting incident, employee theft case). Nullable — only populated when the adjustment is associated with a formal LP case in the case management system or a dedicated LP system.
attributes.references: NRF Retail Loss Prevention Standards; Salesforce Service Cloud; FTC Consumer Protection

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, observations, or explanations provided by the initiating or authorizing user regarding the inventory adjustment. Supports audit trail completeness and loss prevention investigation documentation.
attributes.references: NRF Loss Prevention Standards; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which the inventory adjustment is posted to the stock ledger and general ledger. May differ from adjustment_timestamp when adjustments are batched or backdated for period-end closing. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 330 Inventory Accounting; SAP S/4HANA Retail FI/CO Module

attributes.name: quantity_after_adjustment
attributes.description: The on-hand inventory quantity for the SKU at the location immediately after this adjustment is applied. Derived at posting time and stored for audit trail and stock ledger reconciliation. Expressed in the SKU's unit of measure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; FASB ASC 330 Inventory Accounting

attributes.name: quantity_before_adjustment
attributes.description: The on-hand inventory quantity for the SKU at the location immediately prior to this adjustment being applied. Captured at the time of adjustment for audit trail completeness and variance analysis. Expressed in the SKU's unit of measure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; FASB ASC 330 Inventory Accounting

attributes.name: reason_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of why the inventory adjustment is being made. Drives reporting buckets for shrinkage monitoring, COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) impact analysis, and loss prevention dashboards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: shrinkage|damage|cycle_count_correction|receiving_variance|expiry_write_off|rtv|admin_correction|found_stock — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); NRF Retail Loss Prevention Standards; FASB ASC 330

attributes.name: reason_sub_category
attributes.description: Granular sub-classification within the reason category providing specific cause detail. Examples for shrinkage: shoplifting, employee theft, administrative error, vendor fraud. Examples for damage: in-transit damage, handling damage, shelf damage. Feeds loss prevention case analysis and shrinkage root-cause reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: shoplifting|employee_theft|admin_error|vendor_fraud|in_transit_damage|handling_damage|shelf_damage|expired|recalled|mis-ship — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NRF Retail Loss Prevention Standards; CPSC Product Safety; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: recall_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this inventory adjustment is associated with a product recall event initiated by the CPSC, FDA, or the retailer. Enables rapid identification and financial quantification of recall-related inventory write-offs.
attributes.references: CPSC Product Safety Standards; FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA); NRF Standards

attributes.name: rfid_tag_count
attributes.description: Number of RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) tags scanned during the detection event that triggered this adjustment. Populated only for RFID-based detection methods. Supports RFID program accuracy measurement and tag read-rate analysis.
attributes.references: GS1 RFID Standards (EPC Gen2); Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: source_document_number
attributes.description: The reference number of the originating source document (e.g., cycle count ID, RTV authorization number, receiving document number, damage report ID). Enables cross-system traceability and audit trail linkage.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: source_document_type
attributes.description: The type of source business document that triggered or supports this inventory adjustment. Provides traceability back to the originating business process (e.g., cycle count sheet, Return to Vendor (RTV) authorization, receiving document). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cycle_count|physical_inventory|rtv_authorization|receiving_document|damage_report|expiry_report|pos_exception_report — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: The Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) per unit at the time of adjustment, used to calculate the total cost impact of the inventory change. Sourced from the inventory valuation layer in SAP S/4HANA. Business-confidential as it reflects supplier pricing.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 330 Inventory Accounting; SAP S/4HANA Retail FI/CO Module

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure in which the adjusted quantity is expressed (e.g., EA=Each, CS=Case, LB=Pound, KG=Kilogram). Aligns with the SKU's base unit of measure in the product master to ensure accurate stock ledger posting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|LB|KG|OZ|L|M|FT|PK|BX — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System audit timestamp recording when the adjustment record was most recently modified. Tracks approval workflow updates, status changes, and corrections. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

products.name: stock_transfer
products.description: Inter-node stock transfer records capturing movement of inventory between stores, DCs, MFCs, and vendor locations. Captures transfer type (store-to-store, DC-to-store, cross-dock, RTV), source node, destination node, SKU, transfer quantity, shipment date, expected receipt date, actual receipt date, carrier, and transfer status. Supports omnichannel fulfillment (ship-from-store) and network balancing.

attributes.name: stock_transfer_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate identifier for each inter-node stock transfer record in the inventory management system.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the logistics carrier or 3PL (Third-Party Logistics) provider responsible for transporting the stock transfer between nodes. Used for carrier performance analytics and SLA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail SD Module

attributes.name: cost_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.cost_price. Business justification: Transfer accounting and intercompany pricing require cost data for inventory valuation during movement. Store-to-store transfers, DC-to-store shipments, and cross-dock operations need cost basis for f

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.dc_facility. Business justification: Store-to-store and ship-from-store transfers are initiated by specific associates. Tracking this supports fulfillment performance analytics, operational accountability, and process improvement initiat

attributes.name: destination_node_inventory_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the receiving inventory node (store, DC, MFC, or vendor location) to which the stock transfer is directed. Used for inventory receipt confirmation and network replenishment tracking.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module

attributes.name: location_id

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating purchase order that triggered this stock transfer, applicable for DC-to-store replenishment flows sourced from supplier inbound receipts. Links transfer to procurement context.

attributes.name: replenishment_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the replenishment plan that generated this stock transfer, linking the physical movement to the demand-driven planning signal from Blue Yonder or the retail merchandising system. Supports replenishment accuracy analytics.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) transaction record associated with this stock transfer, applicable for supplier-initiated VMI transfers or 3PL-managed shipments communicated via EDI 943/944 warehouse transfer messages.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI Standards; SAP S/4HANA Retail EDI Integration

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) being transferred. The SKU is the atomic unit of inventory tracking, uniquely identifying a product variant (size, color, style) within the retail assortment.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Product Classification; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); Informatica MDM

attributes.name: actual_receipt_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the stock transfer was physically received and confirmed at the destination node. Compared against expected_receipt_date to measure carrier and DC performance against SLA targets.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System audit timestamp recording when this stock transfer record was first persisted in the data platform. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the transfer cost is denominated (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency retail operations across international markets.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency

attributes.name: destination_node_type
attributes.description: Classification of the receiving inventory node. STORE: retail store; DC: distribution center; MFC: micro-fulfillment center; VENDOR: supplier location for RTV; DARK_STORE: fulfillment-only location.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; NRF Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: expected_receipt_date
attributes.description: Planned calendar date by which the stock transfer is expected to arrive at the destination node. Used for replenishment planning, weeks of supply (WOS) calculations, and SLA compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning; Manhattan Associates WMS; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: initiated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the stock transfer record was first created in the system, representing the business event of transfer initiation. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for the transfer lifecycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: inventory_cost_per_unit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Inventory Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) Per Unit
attributes.description: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) value per unit for the transferred SKU at time of transfer, used for inventory valuation, GMROI calculations, and financial reporting. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI/CO standard cost or moving average cost.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 330 Inventory Accounting; SAP S/4HANA Retail FI/CO Module

tag_set.value: Inventory Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) Per Unit

attributes.name: is_cross_dock
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this stock transfer is executed as a cross-docking (cross-dock) movement, where inventory is transferred directly from inbound to outbound at the DC without putaway storage. Supports DC throughput and flow-through analytics.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; NRF Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: is_ship_from_store
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this stock transfer is part of a ship-from-store (SFS) omnichannel fulfillment flow, where a retail store acts as a fulfillment node dispatching inventory to satisfy an e-commerce or BOPIS order.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud; NRF Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: is_vendor_managed
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this stock transfer is part of a Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) program, where the supplier initiates and manages the replenishment transfer rather than the retailer's internal planning team.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); GS1 VMI Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes or comments associated with the stock transfer, capturing exception details, special handling instructions, or carrier communication relevant to the transfer execution.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Operational priority assigned to the stock transfer, influencing pick sequencing, carrier selection, and dispatch scheduling at the DC or store. URGENT transfers may be triggered by stockout alerts or product recalls.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: Actual number of units confirmed received at the destination node upon delivery. May differ from transfer_quantity due to transit damage, shrinkage, or carrier discrepancies. Drives inventory reconciliation and shrinkage monitoring.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module; FASB ASC 330 Inventory Accounting

attributes.name: rfid_enabled
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this stock transfer was tracked using RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) technology for real-time inventory visibility during transit. Supports RFID-based inventory accuracy programs.
attributes.references: GS1 RFID Standards; NRF RFID Implementation Guidelines

attributes.name: shipment_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the stock transfer was physically dispatched from the source node. Used for lead time calculation, carrier SLA tracking, and inventory in-transit reporting.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; GS1 Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: source_node_type
attributes.description: Classification of the originating inventory node. STORE: retail store; DC: distribution center; MFC: micro-fulfillment center; VENDOR: supplier location for RTV or DSD; DARK_STORE: fulfillment-only location.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; NRF Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this stock transfer record originated. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and Silver layer provenance tracking across the retail technology stack.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security; Informatica MDM Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned shipment tracking number for the stock transfer, enabling real-time in-transit visibility and last-mile delivery monitoring. Used for exception management and carrier SLA validation.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; GS1 Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: transfer_cost
attributes.description: Total logistics cost incurred for executing this stock transfer, including carrier freight charges, handling fees, and any 3PL surcharges. Used for inventory valuation (COGS), P&L allocation, and supply chain cost optimization.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 330 Inventory Accounting; SAP S/4HANA Retail FI/CO Module

attributes.name: transfer_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business reference number for the stock transfer, used for tracking and communication across supply chain partners, carriers, and store operations. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM transfer order numbering.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; GS1 Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: transfer_quantity
attributes.description: Number of units of the SKU authorized and dispatched in this stock transfer. Represents the planned transfer quantity as recorded at time of transfer creation.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module

attributes.name: transfer_reason_code
attributes.description: Business reason code explaining why the stock transfer was initiated. REPLENISHMENT: routine inventory restocking; NETWORK_BALANCE: lateral balancing to address overstock/understock; RTV: return to vendor; RECALL: product safety recall per CPSC; DAMAGE_RETURN: return of damaged goods; OMNICHANNEL: ship-from-store or BOPIS fulfillment support.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); CPSC Product Recall Standards; NRF Inventory Management Standards

attributes.name: transfer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the stock transfer. DRAFT: initiated but not yet dispatched; IN_TRANSIT: shipment dispatched from source node; RECEIVED: confirmed receipt at destination node; CANCELLED: transfer voided before completion; EXCEPTION: discrepancy or damage reported during transit.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module

attributes.name: transfer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inter-node inventory movement. DC_TO_STORE: distribution center replenishment to store; STORE_TO_STORE: lateral balancing between stores; STORE_TO_DC: reverse logistics or consolidation; CROSS_DOCK: direct transfer without storage per cross-docking (DSD) model; RTV: Return to Vendor; MFC_TO_STORE: micro-fulfillment center to store for omnichannel fulfillment (ship-from-store).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); Manhattan Associates WMS; NRF Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure in which the transfer quantity is expressed. EACH: individual sellable unit; CASE: standard case pack; PALLET: full pallet load; CARTON: shipping carton; PACK: multi-unit consumer pack. Aligns with WMS and ERP unit-of-measure configuration.
attributes.references: GS1 Unit of Measure Standards; SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: 12-digit Universal Product Code (UPC) barcode identifier for the transferred SKU, used for scanning and verification during pick, pack, and receipt operations at DC and store nodes.
attributes.references: GS1 US UPC Standards; CPSC Product Identification Requirements

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System audit timestamp recording the most recent modification to this stock transfer record, such as status updates, quantity adjustments, or receipt confirmations. Supports change data capture and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity

attributes.name: variance_quantity
attributes.description: Difference between transfer_quantity and received_quantity, representing units lost, damaged, or unaccounted for during transit. Positive value indicates shortage; negative indicates overage. Drives shrinkage monitoring and carrier chargeback processes.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; FASB ASC 330 Inventory Accounting; NRF Shrinkage Standards

attributes.name: variance_reason_code
attributes.description: Reason code explaining the cause of any quantity variance between dispatched and received units. Used for shrinkage root cause analysis, carrier chargeback (RMA) processing, and inventory reconciliation.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; NRF Shrinkage and Loss Prevention Standards

products.name: goods_receipt
products.description: Records physical receipt of merchandise at DCs, stores, and MFCs against purchase orders, replenishment orders, or transfer orders. Captures receipt date, receiving node, supplier/source, PO/ASN reference, line-level received/accepted/rejected quantities with discrepancy details (shortage, overage, wrong SKU, damage), unit cost, receipt method (DSD, DC-to-store, cross-dock), quality inspection status, and discrepancy resolution status. Supports receiving workflows, vendor compliance chargebacks, and inventory accuracy at point of induction.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate identifier for each goods receipt record in the inventory domain. Primary key for the goods_receipt data product.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the scheduled inbound dock appointment at the receiving node. Links to the inbound_appointment product for dock scheduling, carrier arrival tracking, and receiving labor planning.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module

attributes.name: cost_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.cost_price. Business justification: Receiving process validates invoice costs against contracted pricing and updates landed cost. Three-way match (PO-receipt-invoice) depends on linking goods receipt to cost structure for variance detec

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.dc_facility. Business justification: Receiving inspections for food products must reference the active food safety plan to ensure HACCP compliance. FDA/FSMA requires documented receiving procedures tied to facility food safety plans for

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.department. Business justification: Store goods receipts are processed into specific departments (grocery receiving vs. apparel receiving). Department-level receiving metrics, compliance tracking, and vendor performance reporting by dep

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.fulfillment_node. Business justification: Inbound receiving at fulfillment DCs and ship-from-store nodes requires goods_receipt to reference the operational fulfillment_node for WMS integration, receiving capacity planning, and node-level rec

attributes.name: inbound_shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.inbound_shipment. Business justification: A goods receipt is the inventory system acknowledgment of an inbound shipment. Retail DC operations require direct linkage for receiving discrepancy management, carrier performance tracking, and ASN-t

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.location. Business justification: Receiving operations are cost centers with labor, equipment, and overhead costs tracked for budgeting and efficiency analysis. Goods_receipt needs cost_center_id to allocate receiving costs and measur

attributes.name: po_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific purchase order line item being received. Enables line-level PO matching, partial receipt tracking, and SKU-level discrepancy analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent purchase order against which this goods receipt is posted. Enables PO-to-receipt matching, open order tracking, and three-way match (PO, receipt, invoice) for accounts payable.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: recall_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.recall. Business justification: Receiving teams must check active recalls before accepting inbound shipments. When a recall is active, goods_receipt records must reference the specific recall for regulatory audit trails, chargeback

attributes.name: receiving_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.receiving_event. Business justification: A receiving_event (physical DC unload) directly triggers a goods_receipt (inventory posting). Retail DC operations require this link for discrepancy reconciliation between physical unit counts and inv

attributes.name: replenishment_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.replenishment_order. Business justification: goods_receipt records physical receipt of merchandise at DCs, stores, and MFCs against purchase orders and replenishment orders. A direct FK to replenishment_order links the physical receipt event to

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) being received. Links to the product master in the customer master data system or the retail merchandising system Merchandising System for item-level inventory induction.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Product Classification; Informatica MDM; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: accepted_qty
attributes.description: Quantity of units accepted into inventory after quality inspection. Excludes rejected, damaged, or wrong-SKU units. This is the quantity inducted into on-hand inventory and used for COGS valuation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); CPSC Product Safety Standards

attributes.name: chargeback_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this goods receipt record has identified discrepancies that qualify for a vendor compliance chargeback. True = chargeback may be issued to supplier; False = no chargeback applicable. Drives the vendor compliance chargeback workflow.
attributes.references: NRF Vendor Compliance Standards; SAP S/4HANA Retail MM/FI Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System audit timestamp recording when this goods receipt record was first created in the data platform. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and SLA monitoring.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the unit cost and total receipt cost (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency retail operations and financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; FASB ASC 830 (Foreign Currency Matters)

attributes.name: discrepancy_resolution_status
attributes.description: Current status of the discrepancy resolution workflow. 'pending' = discrepancy logged, not yet actioned; 'under_review' = being investigated with supplier; 'resolved' = discrepancy closed; 'chargeback_issued' = vendor compliance chargeback raised; 'waived' = discrepancy accepted without penalty.
attributes.references: NRF Vendor Compliance Standards; SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module

attributes.name: discrepancy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the primary discrepancy identified during receiving. 'shortage' = fewer units than expected; 'overage' = more units than expected; 'wrong_sku' = incorrect item received; 'damage' = merchandise physically damaged; 'expired' = past sell-by or use-by date; 'none' = no discrepancy. Drives chargeback and resolution workflows.
attributes.references: NRF Vendor Compliance Standards; SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module

attributes.name: expected_qty
attributes.description: Quantity of units expected at the receiving node based on the ASN or replenishment plan. May differ from ordered quantity due to partial shipments or split deliveries. Used for receiving dock planning and discrepancy detection.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: inspection_date
attributes.description: Date on which the quality inspection of received merchandise was completed. Used for compliance reporting, CPSC/FDA audit trails, and receiving cycle time analysis.
attributes.references: CPSC Product Safety Standards; FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA); ISO 9001

attributes.name: ordered_qty
attributes.description: Quantity of units originally ordered on the purchase order line. Used as the baseline for receipt variance calculation, fill rate measurement, and vendor compliance scoring.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module

attributes.name: overage_qty
attributes.description: Quantity of units received in excess of the ASN or PO expectation (received_qty minus expected_qty when positive). Overages require disposition decisions and may trigger vendor compliance chargebacks.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; NRF Vendor Compliance Standards

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: Externally-known purchase order number as referenced on supplier documentation and EDI transactions. Retained for operational readability, vendor communication, and three-way match without requiring a join.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; GS1 EDI Standard (850 Purchase Order)

attributes.name: quality_inspection_status
attributes.description: Status of the quality inspection performed on received merchandise. 'not_required' = inspection waived per supplier agreement; 'pending' = awaiting inspection; 'passed' = all units meet quality standards; 'failed' = units do not meet standards; 'partial_pass' = some units accepted, some rejected. Drives accepted/rejected quantity split.
attributes.references: CPSC Product Safety Standards; FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA); ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the physical goods receipt was posted. Used for inventory valuation, vendor compliance reporting, and lead time analysis. Aligns with SAP Posting Date (BUDAT) in the MM module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; FASB ASC 330 (Inventory Accounting)

attributes.name: receipt_method
attributes.description: Method by which merchandise was physically received. 'dsd' = Direct Store Delivery from supplier; 'dc_to_store' = replenishment from Distribution Center; 'cross_dock' = direct transfer without storage; 'drop_ship' = vendor direct-to-customer; 'transfer_order' = inter-node stock transfer. Drives receiving workflow and inventory valuation logic.
attributes.references: NRF Industry Standards; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: receipt_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the receiving associate documenting special conditions, discrepancy details, handling instructions, or other observations at the time of receipt. Supports discrepancy investigation and vendor communication.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module

attributes.name: receipt_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the goods receipt document, typically generated by the WMS or ERP upon physical receipt confirmation. Maps to SAP Material Document Number (MBLNR) or Manhattan WMS Receipt Number.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: receipt_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the goods receipt workflow. 'draft' indicates initiated but not confirmed; 'open' indicates awaiting physical receipt; 'in_progress' indicates receiving underway; 'completed' indicates fully processed and inventory inducted; 'cancelled' indicates voided; 'on_hold' indicates paused pending resolution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|open|in_progress|completed|cancelled|on_hold — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: The principal real-world event timestamp recording when the physical merchandise was received and confirmed at the receiving node (DC, store, or MFC). Distinct from system audit timestamps. Maps to SAP Posting Date/Time in MIGO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: received_qty
attributes.description: Total quantity of units physically counted and received at the dock, prior to quality inspection. Includes all units regardless of condition. Used as the gross receipt quantity for inventory induction and discrepancy calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module (MIGO); Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: receiving_node_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical location type where goods were received. 'dc' = Distribution Center; 'store' = retail store; 'mfc' = Micro-Fulfillment Center; 'dark_store' = fulfillment-only location. Determines applicable receiving workflows and inventory induction rules.
attributes.references: NRF Industry Standards; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: rejected_qty
attributes.description: Quantity of units rejected during quality inspection and not inducted into inventory. Drives Return to Vendor (RTV) processing, vendor compliance chargebacks, and RMA initiation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Salesforce Service Cloud (RMA); NRF Industry Standards

attributes.name: rfid_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the received merchandise was verified using RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) scanning during the receiving process. True = RFID scan confirmed; False = manual or barcode-only verification. Supports inventory accuracy at point of induction.
attributes.references: GS1 RFID Standards (EPC/RFID); NRF Industry Standards

attributes.name: rtv_initiated
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Return to Vendor (RTV) process has been initiated for rejected units from this goods receipt. True = RTV in progress; False = no RTV initiated. Supports reverse logistics and vendor debit memo processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; NRF Vendor Compliance Standards

attributes.name: shortage_qty
attributes.description: Quantity of units short-shipped relative to the ASN or PO expectation (expected_qty minus received_qty when negative). Used for vendor compliance chargeback calculation and fill rate reporting.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI Standard; SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; NRF Vendor Compliance Standards

attributes.name: total_receipt_cost
attributes.description: Total cost of accepted merchandise received (accepted_qty × unit_cost). Used for inventory valuation, COGS posting, and financial reconciliation. Classified as confidential due to commercial sensitivity.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 330 (Inventory Accounting); SAP S/4HANA Retail FI/CO Module

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Cost per unit of the received merchandise as per the purchase order or supplier invoice. Used for inventory valuation (COGS), gross margin calculation (GMROI), and financial posting to the general ledger. Classified as confidential due to commercial sensitivity.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 330 (Inventory Accounting); SAP S/4HANA Retail FI/CO Module

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure in which receipt quantities are expressed (e.g., EA = Each, CS = Case, PK = Pack, LB = Pound, KG = Kilogram). Aligns with GS1 unit of measure codes and SAP base unit of measure (MEINS). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PK|LB|KG|OZ|L|M|FT — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module (MEINS)

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: 12-digit Universal Product Code (UPC) barcode identifier for the received item. Used for RFID/barcode scanning during receiving, inventory accuracy validation, and GS1 compliance.
attributes.references: GS1 US; CPSC Product Identification Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System audit timestamp recording when this goods receipt record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking, discrepancy resolution audits, and data quality monitoring.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability)

products.name: reservation
products.description: Records all inventory encumbrances that restrict stock from general availability — including soft-allocations (BOPIS reservation, ship-from-store allocation, e-commerce hold) and hard holds (quality hold, regulatory recall, legal hold, damage hold, price investigation). Captures encumbrance type, SKU, quantity, node, start/expiry timestamps, associated order or case reference, authorizing party, hold reason, authorizing department, release status, and resolution details. Single source of truth for all reserved and held stock, enabling accurate ATP calculation on stock_position.

attributes.name: reservation_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each inventory reservation or hold record. Primary key for the reservation data product.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module

attributes.name: account_id

attributes.name: cart_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.cart. Business justification: Inventory reservations are created from cart items during checkout to hold stock. Tracks cart-to-reservation lifecycle for abandoned cart inventory release and reservation expiry management.

attributes.name: checkout_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.checkout. Business justification: Reservations are created during checkout to hold inventory during payment authorization. Links reservation lifecycle to checkout session for payment-hold-release coordination and checkout abandonment

attributes.name: cycle_count_id
attributes.description: RFID tag identifier associated with the specific unit(s) reserved, enabling item-level tracking and automated hold verification. Populated when RFID-based inventory tracking is active at the node. Supports real-time inventory visibility for omnichannel fulfillment.
attributes.references: GS1 RFID Standards (EPC/RFID); Manhattan Associates WMS RFID Module

attributes.name: digital_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.digital_catalog. Business justification: Omnichannel availability reporting requires tracing which storefront catalog listing (digital_catalog) triggered an inventory hold. Enables catalog-level reservation analytics, BOPIS/ROPIS slot manage

attributes.name: fulfillment_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.fulfillment_line. Business justification: Reservations are SKU-level allocations matching fulfillment line granularity. Retail WMS systems reserve specific SKU quantities for specific order lines during wave planning and pick task generation.

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer order (OMS order) that triggered this inventory reservation. Populated for BOPIS, ROPIS, ship-from-store, and e-commerce hold encumbrances. Null for non-order-driven holds (quality, legal, regulatory). Links reservation to the order fulfillment lifecycle.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud OMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail SD Module

attributes.name: inventory_node_id
attributes.description: System identifier for the inventory node (store, DC, MFC, dark store) where the reserved stock physically resides. Central to ATP calculation and omnichannel fulfillment routing (BOPIS, SFS, ship-from-DC).
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: System identifier of the employee or system user who authorized the inventory hold or reservation. Required for hard holds (quality, legal, regulatory) for audit and compliance purposes. For automated soft allocations, this may reference a system service account.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; ISO 27001 Access Control; OSHA Workplace Safety Standards

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.fulfillment_order. Business justification: Inventory reservations are created during fulfillment order allocation in retail operations. When an online order or BOPIS order enters fulfillment, the WMS reserves specific inventory for that fulfil

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.profile. Business justification: Retail omnichannel fulfillment (BOPIS, ship-from-store, curbside pickup) requires tracking which customer profile created each inventory reservation. Essential for customer service, order fulfillment,

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_offer. Business justification: Promotional reservations (BOPIS/flash-sale holds) must reference the triggering promo offer for redemption validation and inventory accounting. Retailers require this link to reconcile promotional hol

attributes.name: redemption_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.redemption. Business justification: A loyalty redemption for a physical product reward directly triggers an inventory reservation. This FK links the redemption event to its inventory hold, enabling fulfillment teams to track which redem

attributes.name: reward_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.reward. Business justification: When a loyalty reward involves a physical product (free item, gift), inventory must be reserved against that specific reward. Reward-driven inventory reservation is a standard retail fulfillment proce

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: System identifier for the SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) whose inventory is being reserved or held. Links to the product master for item-level ATP (Available to Promise) calculation and omnichannel fulfillment routing.

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the stock_position record at the SKU-node level that this reservation encumbers. Enables direct linkage between the reservation and the ATP calculation on the stock_position product, ensuring accurate real-time inventory visibility.

attributes.name: authorizing_department
attributes.description: Name or code of the business department that authorized the hold (e.g., Quality Assurance, Legal, Compliance, Store Operations, E-Commerce Fulfillment). Supports departmental accountability reporting and hold resolution workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail FI/CO Module; NRF Retail Operations Standards

attributes.name: case_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference to the service case, quality investigation, legal matter, or regulatory recall case that authorized a hard hold. Populated for quality_hold, legal_hold, regulatory_recall, and damage_hold encumbrance types. Links to the case management system case management.
attributes.references: Salesforce Service Cloud; CPSC Recall Procedures; FDA Food Safety Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System-generated timestamp when the reservation record was first written to the data platform (Silver layer ingestion time). Distinct from reservation_timestamp which captures the business event time. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: encumbrance_type

attributes.name: expiry_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the reservation automatically expires if not fulfilled or manually extended. attributes.name: fiscal_period

attributes.name: fulfillment_channel

Null for non-order-driven hard holds.

attributes.name: hold_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the specific business reason for the reservation or hold (e.g., BOPIS_ALLOC, SFS_ALLOC, ECOM_HOLD, QA_FAIL, RECALL_CPSC, LEGAL_HOLD, DMG_INBOUND, PRICE_INVEST). Enables operational reporting and root-cause analysis of inventory encumbrances.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; CPSC Recall Procedures; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module

attributes.name: hold_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the specific reason for the inventory hold or reservation, providing operational context beyond the structured hold_reason_code. Required for legal holds and regulatory recalls per compliance documentation standards.

attributes.name: inventory_cost_per_unit

attributes.name: is_recalled

attributes.name: is_vendor_managed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reserved inventory is managed under a Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) agreement, where the supplier retains ownership and replenishment responsibility. Affects financial liability and hold authorization workflows.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to the reservation, governing queue position in fulfillment workflows and hold resolution SLAs. 'critical' applies to regulatory recalls and legal holds; 'high' to same-day BOPIS; 'standard' to regular e-commerce holds; 'low' to pre-emptive soft allocations.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; NRF SLA Standards

attributes.name: release_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing resolution details, disposition instructions, or compliance notes recorded at the time of hold release. Required for regulatory recalls and legal holds to document the resolution rationale for audit purposes.
attributes.references: CPSC Recall Procedures; FDA FSMA; ISO 27001 Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: release_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for releasing a hard hold. 'pending' — release request submitted awaiting authorization; 'approved' — release authorized by responsible department; 'rejected' — release denied, hold remains active; 'auto_released' — system-triggered release upon expiry or order fulfillment; 'escalated' — requires senior authorization.
attributes.references: Salesforce Service Cloud; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: release_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the reservation was released, cancelled, or converted. Null while the reservation is active. Used for hold duration analysis, SLA compliance reporting, and ATP recalculation upon release.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module

attributes.name: reservation_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable business identifier for the reservation, used in operational communications, order management, and customer-facing references (e.g., BOPIS confirmation codes). Sourced from OMS or WMS upon creation.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: reservation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the inventory reservation. 'active' — stock is currently encumbered; 'expired' — reservation lapsed past expiry without fulfillment; 'released' — hold manually or systematically lifted; 'cancelled' — reservation voided before fulfillment; 'pending_release' — awaiting authorization to release; 'converted' — soft allocation fulfilled and converted to a shipment.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module; NRF Inventory Standards

attributes.name: reservation_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (with timezone offset) when the inventory encumbrance was created — the principal business event timestamp. For BOPIS/e-commerce holds, this is when the customer completed checkout. For quality/legal holds, this is when the hold was authorized.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR); ISO 8601

attributes.name: reserved_quantity
attributes.description: Number of units of the SKU encumbered by this reservation. Subtracted from on-hand quantity to derive ATP (Available to Promise) on the stock_position product. Must be positive and not exceed available on-hand at time of reservation creation.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module; NRF Inventory Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record that originated this reservation record (e.g., WMS = Manhattan Associates WMS, OMS = Order Management System, ECOM = the e-commerce platform, ERP = SAP S/4HANA, MANUAL = manually entered hold). Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver layer. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WMS|OMS|ECOM|ERP|ORMS|CAR|SFCC|MANUAL — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Informatica MDM; ISO 27001 Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: storage_bin
attributes.description: Specific bin, shelf, or slot location within the node where the reserved inventory is physically stored. Enables warehouse associates to locate and pick reserved stock efficiently. Sourced from Manhattan Associates WMS bin management.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the reserved_quantity (e.g., EA = Each, CS = Case, LB = Pound, KG = Kilogram). Aligns with the SKU's base unit of measure in the product master to ensure accurate inventory accounting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|LB|KG|OZ|FT|M|L|GAL — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: 12-digit Universal Product Code (UPC) barcode identifier for the reserved item. Used for RFID scanning, POS reconciliation, and regulatory recall identification per GS1 standards.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards for Barcodes and Product Identification

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System-generated timestamp of the most recent modification to the reservation record (e.g., quantity adjustment, status change, expiry extension). Used for change data capture (CDC) and incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security; Databricks Delta Lake CDC Standards

products.name: reorder_policy

Trigger thresholds generate inventory_replenishment_order records when stock_position breaches defined levels. Owned and maintained by replenishment planners; consumed by automated replenishment engines.

attributes.name: reorder_policy_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the reorder policy record. Primary key for the reorder_policy data product in the inventory domain.

attributes.name: demand_forecast_id
attributes.description: Reference to the demand forecast record from Blue Yonder Demand Planning that drives replenishment quantity calculations for forecast_driven reorder method. Null for non-forecast-driven methods.
