attributes.name: item_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.item_hierarchy. Business justification: Retail reorder policies are set at category/subcategory level (item_hierarchy nodes) to govern safety stock, lead times, and replenishment methods across all SKUs in a category. Category managers expe

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inventory node (store, Distribution Center (DC), or Micro-Fulfillment Center (MFC)) where this reorder policy governs stock replenishment. Combined with sku_id, forms the natural business key.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module

attributes.name: replenishment_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent replenishment plan that governs or generated this reorder policy. Links the policy to the broader supply chain planning context managed in Blue Yonder Demand Planning.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) for which this reorder policy applies. Combined with location_id, forms the natural business key for a reorder policy.
attributes.references: GS1; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); Informatica MDM

attributes.name: uom_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.uom. Business justification: Reorder quantities (MOQ, safety stock, order multiples) must reference validated UOM definitions to ensure correct unit conversions across ordering systems. reorder_policy.unit_of_measure is a plain d

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: ABC classification of the SKU at this location based on sales velocity and revenue contribution: A (high-velocity/high-value), B (medium), C (low-velocity/low-value), D (dead stock or near-dead). Influences replenishment priority, safety stock levels, and review cycle frequency.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); NRF Industry Standards; ISO 9001

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the replenishment planner or manager who approved this reorder policy for activation. Supports governance, audit trail, and accountability for policy parameters.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; ISO 9001 Quality Management; Internal Governance Standards

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this reorder policy was formally approved for activation by the authorized planner or manager. Supports audit trail and policy lifecycle management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this reorder policy record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and policy lifecycle tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The calendar date from which this reorder policy becomes active and the replenishment engine begins applying its parameters. Supports time-bound policy management and seasonal policy transitions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The calendar date after which this reorder policy is no longer active. Null indicates an open-ended policy with no planned expiration. Used to manage seasonal policies, promotional replenishment windows, and policy version transitions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: is_auto_replenishment
attributes.description: Indicates whether replenishment orders are automatically generated and submitted when the reorder trigger is breached (True), or whether a replenishment planner must manually review and approve the suggested order (False).
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning; SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module

attributes.name: is_seasonal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reorder policy applies seasonal adjustments to replenishment parameters (e.g., elevated safety stock or WOS targets during peak seasons). When True, seasonal override parameters may be applied by the replenishment engine.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: is_vendor_managed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU-location replenishment is managed by the supplier under a Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) agreement. When True, the supplier is responsible for monitoring stock levels and initiating replenishment orders rather than the retailer's automated engine.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); NRF VMI Standards

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which a replenishment planner reviewed and validated the parameters of this reorder policy. Supports governance and audit of policy maintenance cadence.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: The expected number of calendar days from placement of a replenishment purchase order to receipt of goods at the destination location. Used to calculate the reorder point and ensure stock does not fall below safety stock during the replenishment cycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Blue Yonder Demand Planning; NRF Industry Standards

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inventory node type to which this policy applies: store (retail store), DC (Distribution Center), MFC (Micro-Fulfillment Center), dark_store (fulfillment-only location), or warehouse. Drives replenishment logic differences by node type.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; NRF Industry Standards

attributes.name: max_stock_quantity
attributes.description: The maximum allowable on-hand inventory level (in units) for this SKU at this location. Used in min/max reorder method as the upper bound. Replenishment orders are sized to bring stock up to this level without exceeding it.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module

attributes.name: min_stock_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum allowable on-hand inventory level (in units) for this SKU at this location. Used in min/max reorder method as the lower bound. Stock falling below this level triggers an urgent replenishment order.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module

attributes.name: moq
attributes.description: The minimum number of units that must be ordered per replenishment order as stipulated by the supplier contract. Replenishment engine enforces this floor when generating inventory_replenishment_order records.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next planner review of this reorder policy's parameters. Calculated from last_reviewed_date plus the review_cycle_days. Drives planner workqueue prioritization.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for replenishment planners to document rationale for policy parameter choices, exceptions, seasonal considerations, or supplier-specific constraints associated with this reorder policy.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); Internal Operational Standards

attributes.name: order_multiple
attributes.business_glossary_term: Order Multiple (Case Pack / Minimum Order Quantity)
attributes.description: The quantity increment in which orders must be placed, reflecting the supplier's case pack size or Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ). All replenishment order quantities are rounded up to the nearest multiple of this value to comply with supplier constraints.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; GS1; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

tag_set.value: Order Multiple (Case Pack / Minimum Order Quantity)

attributes.name: order_quantity
attributes.description: The fixed quantity (in units) to order each time a replenishment trigger is activated. Used for fixed_quantity reorder method. For other methods, this field may be null and the order quantity is dynamically calculated.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: policy_code
attributes.description: Business-facing unique alphanumeric code identifying the reorder policy, used by replenishment planners and referenced in automated replenishment engines (e.g., Blue Yonder). Externally visible identifier across systems.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: policy_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the reorder policy, used by replenishment planners to identify and manage policies (e.g., 'DC Grocery Min/Max Weekly', 'Store Electronics WOS-Based').

attributes.name: policy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the reorder policy. Controls whether the policy is actively used by the replenishment engine to generate inventory_replenishment_order records. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|inactive|draft|pending_approval|expired|suspended — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning; SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module

attributes.name: policy_version
attributes.description: Incrementing version number for this reorder policy record, incremented each time parameters are materially changed. Supports policy change history tracking and rollback capability for replenishment planners.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: reorder_method
attributes.description: The replenishment calculation method applied by this policy: min_max (reorder when stock falls below minimum, order up to maximum), days_of_supply (maintain a target number of days of inventory), wos_based (Weeks of Supply (WOS) target), forecast_driven (demand forecast from Blue Yonder), fixed_quantity (constant order quantity), vendor_managed (VMI — Vendor Managed Inventory where supplier controls replenishment). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: min_max|days_of_supply|wos_based|forecast_driven|fixed_quantity|vendor_managed — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); NRF Industry Standards

attributes.name: reorder_point_quantity
attributes.description: The on-hand stock level (in units) at which a replenishment order is automatically triggered. When the stock_position in inventory falls at or below this threshold, an inventory_replenishment_order record is generated. Core parameter for min/max and fixed-quantity reorder methods.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Blue Yonder Demand Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: review_cycle_days
attributes.description: The frequency in calendar days at which the replenishment engine evaluates this policy and checks whether a reorder trigger has been breached. Defines the periodic review interval (e.g., daily=1, weekly=7, bi-weekly=14).
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Buffer stock quantity (in units) maintained above the reorder point to protect against demand variability and supply lead time uncertainty. Prevents stockouts during replenishment cycles. A key input to the reorder point calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Blue Yonder Demand Planning; ISO 9001 Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this reorder policy was originated or last updated: ORMS (the retail merchandising system Merchandising System), SAP_MM (SAP S/4HANA MM Module), BLUE_YONDER (Blue Yonder Demand Planning), MANUAL (planner-entered), MDM (the customer master data system). Supports data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM; Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: target_days_of_supply
attributes.description: The desired number of days of inventory coverage to maintain at this location for this SKU. Used in days_of_supply reorder method to calculate the replenishment order quantity based on forecasted daily demand.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: target_wos
attributes.description: The desired number of weeks of inventory coverage (Weeks of Supply — WOS) to maintain at this location for this SKU. Used in wos_based reorder method. Replenishment orders are sized to achieve this WOS target based on forecasted weekly demand.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning; NRF Industry Standards; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this reorder policy record was most recently modified. Tracks parameter changes made by replenishment planners and supports change audit trails.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); Internal Audit Standards

products.description: Commercial relationship record between a customer and Retail, distinct from profile (identity). Tracks account number, status (active/suspended/closed), open date, tier (standard/premium/VIP), credit limit, preferred store, preferred channel (in-store/online/mobile), default payment method reference, and account-level flags (employee discount eligibility, tax-exempt status, B2B pricing flag). One profile may have multiple accounts (e.g., personal + business). Supports account-level reporting, credit management, and omnichannel preference routing.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the account. Primary key.

attributes.name: billing_address_id
attributes.description: Reference to the default billing address for this account. Used for invoicing, credit checks, and payment processing. Null if no billing address on file.

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee assigned as the dedicated account manager for this account (typically for high-value B2B or VIP accounts). Null for standard consumer accounts without dedicated management.
attributes.references: NRF - National Retail Federation Best Practices

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer's preferred or home store location for in-store pickup, returns, and personalized store-based services. Null if no preference set.
attributes.references: NRF - National Retail Federation Best Practices

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list. Business justification: B2B and corporate accounts require contract-specific pricing (volume discounts, negotiated rates, special terms). Account managers assign custom price lists during contract setup. Essential for wholes

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_zone. Business justification: Key account management assigns B2B and loyalty accounts to a specific price zone governing consistent pricing across channels. Retail operations require account-level price zone assignment for contrac

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer profile who owns this account. One customer may have multiple accounts (e.g., personal and business).

attributes.name: sales_territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.sales_territory. Business justification: B2B account territory assignment is a core retail sales operations process: revenue attribution, sales rep assignment, and territory-based quota reporting all require knowing which sales territory own

attributes.name: shipping_address_id
attributes.description: Reference to the default shipping address for this account. Used for order fulfillment and delivery. Null if no default shipping address set.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique account number used for customer communication, statements, and customer service lookup. Distinct from internal account_id.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the account. Active accounts can transact; suspended accounts are temporarily blocked; closed accounts are permanently terminated; pending_activation awaits customer verification; frozen accounts are under investigation; dormant accounts have no recent activity.
attributes.references: NRF - National Retail Federation Best Practices

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the account indicating the nature of the commercial relationship: personal (B2C consumer), business (B2B corporate), employee (staff discount account), or wholesale (bulk buyer).
attributes.references: NRF - National Retail Federation Best Practices

attributes.name: b2b_pricing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account receives B2B contract pricing instead of standard retail pricing. True for wholesale and corporate accounts; false for consumer accounts.
attributes.references: NRF - National Retail Federation Best Practices

attributes.name: close_date
attributes.description: Date when the account was permanently closed. Null for active accounts. Used for churn analysis and account lifecycle reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this account record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: credit_limit
attributes.description: Maximum credit amount (in base currency) extended to this account for deferred payment or credit purchases. Null for cash-only accounts. Used for credit management and risk assessment.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the account's base currency (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). All monetary transactions and balances for this account are denominated in this currency.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: SCD2 row effective start date

attributes.name: effective_to
attributes.description: SCD2 row effective end date

attributes.name: employee_discount_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is eligible for employee discount pricing. True for employee accounts and authorized family members; false otherwise.
attributes.references: NRF - National Retail Federation Best Practices

attributes.name: is_current
attributes.description: SCD2 flag indicating current active record

attributes.name: loyalty_program_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is enrolled in the retailer's loyalty or rewards program. True if enrolled; false otherwise. Used for loyalty analytics and targeted promotions.
attributes.references: NRF - National Retail Federation Best Practices

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for internal notes about the account (e.g., special handling instructions, VIP preferences, service history, escalation notes). Used by customer service and account management teams.
attributes.references: NRF - National Retail Federation Best Practices

attributes.name: open_date
attributes.description: Date when the account was first opened and activated. Used for account age calculations, tenure-based benefits, and lifecycle analytics.

attributes.name: preferred_channel
attributes.description: Customer's preferred interaction channel for shopping and service. Used for omnichannel routing, personalized marketing, and channel-specific offers.
attributes.references: NRF - National Retail Federation Best Practices

attributes.name: row_hash
attributes.description: Hash of tracked columns for change detection

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: Date when the account was most recently suspended. Null if never suspended or currently active. Used for compliance and risk management reporting.

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why the account was suspended (e.g., payment default, fraud investigation, customer request, policy violation). Null if never suspended.
attributes.references: FTC - Federal Trade Commission Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: tax_exempt_certificate_number
attributes.description: Government-issued tax exemption certificate number for tax-exempt accounts. Null for non-exempt accounts. Required for audit and compliance verification.
attributes.references: FTC - Federal Trade Commission Pricing Transparency Standards

attributes.name: tax_exempt_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the tax exemption certificate. Null for non-exempt accounts or perpetual exemptions. Used for compliance monitoring and renewal reminders.
attributes.references: FTC - Federal Trade Commission Pricing Transparency Standards

attributes.name: tax_exempt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is exempt from sales tax (e.g., non-profit organizations, government entities, resellers with valid tax exemption certificates). True if exempt; false otherwise.
attributes.references: FTC - Federal Trade Commission Pricing Transparency Standards

attributes.name: tier
attributes.description: Service tier or membership level of the account, determining benefits, discounts, and service priority. Standard is base tier; premium, VIP, and platinum offer escalating benefits.
attributes.references: NRF - National Retail Federation Best Practices

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this account record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization.

products.name: contact
products.description: Stores all contact points for a customer profile or corporate account including email addresses, phone numbers, and social handles. Each row represents a single contact method with type (primary email, mobile, work phone, WhatsApp), verification status, opt-in/opt-out flags per channel, verification date, and source system. Supports omnichannel outreach, CRM campaigns via the case management system, and GDPR/CCPA consent enforcement at the contact-method level.

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the contact method record. Primary key.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: In B2B retail, contact persons (procurement officers, buyers, account managers) are directly associated with corporate accounts, not just individual profiles. Adding account_id to contact enables acco

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer profile or corporate account that owns this contact method. Links to the customer master record in the customer master data system.

attributes.name: bounce_count
attributes.description: The cumulative number of times communication attempts via this contact method have bounced or failed. Used to trigger contact validation workflows and suppress invalid addresses.

attributes.name: consent_source
attributes.description: The channel or touchpoint where the customer provided consent for this contact method (e.g., web registration, mobile app, POS, call center, in-store signup). Supports consent audit trails. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: web|mobile_app|pos|call_center|email|in_store|third_party — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the contact method. Active indicates usable for communication; bounced/invalid indicates delivery failure; suppressed indicates customer request or compliance block; pending_verification indicates awaiting confirmation.

attributes.name: contact_type
attributes.description: The type or category of contact method (e.g., primary email, mobile phone, work phone, WhatsApp, SMS, fax). Determines the channel and priority for omnichannel outreach. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: primary_email|secondary_email|mobile|home_phone|work_phone|whatsapp|sms|fax — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country associated with this contact method (e.g., USA, GBR, CAN). Used for regional compliance and localization of communications.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this contact method record was first created in the system. Supports audit trails and data lineage.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this contact method ceased to be active or valid. Nullable for currently active contact methods. Supports temporal tracking and historical analysis.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this contact method became active and valid for customer communication. Supports temporal tracking and historical analysis.

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the primary contact method for the customer. Used to prioritize communication channels in omnichannel campaigns and clienteling.

attributes.name: is_verified
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the contact method has been verified (e.g., email verification link clicked, phone number confirmed via OTP). Ensures data quality for marketing and transactional communications.

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 language code indicating the customers preferred language for communications via this contact method (e.g., en, es, fr). Supports personalized omnichannel outreach.

attributes.name: last_bounce_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent bounce or delivery failure for this contact method. Nullable if no bounces have occurred.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this contact method record was last updated. Supports change tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: last_used_date
attributes.description: The date when this contact method was last successfully used for customer communication (email sent, SMS delivered, call completed). Helps identify stale or inactive contact points.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric ranking indicating the priority order of this contact method relative to other contact methods for the same customer. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used for fallback logic in omnichannel campaigns.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this contact method in the source system. Enables traceability and cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The actual contact point value: email address, phone number, or social media handle. This is the primary data element used for customer communication and CRM campaigns via the case management system. Classified as restricted PII as it may contain email, phone, or other personal identifiers.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4 - Personal Data; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date when the contact method was last verified by the customer. Used to track data freshness and trigger re-verification workflows.

products.name: address
products.description: Physical and mailing addresses associated with a customer profile or corporate account. Stores address type (billing, shipping, store pickup, home, work), full address lines, city, state/province, postal code, country, geocoordinates (lat/lng), address validation status, USPS/postal standardization flag, and default shipping flag. Critical for last-mile delivery, BOPIS/ROPIS fulfillment, and tax jurisdiction determination.

attributes.name: address_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the address record. Primary key.

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_zone. Business justification: E-commerce and delivery pricing requires address-based price zone resolution to determine applicable retail prices for a customer's delivery location. Retail pricing engines resolve zone from delivery

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer or corporate account associated with this address.

attributes.name: address_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the address record. Active addresses are available for use in orders and shipments.

attributes.name: address_type
attributes.description: Classification of the address purpose: billing, shipping, store pickup (BOPIS/ROPIS), home, work, or mailing.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality name for the address.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR) identifying the country of the address.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the address record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: delivery_instructions
attributes.description: Special delivery instructions provided by the customer (e.g., gate code, leave at door, ring bell).

attributes.name: delivery_point_barcode
attributes.description: USPS Delivery Point Barcode (DPBC) or equivalent postal barcode for automated mail sorting and delivery.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this address becomes active and valid for use in transactions.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this address remains active. Null indicates the address is currently active with no end date.

attributes.name: is_default_billing
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this address is the default billing address for the customer.

attributes.name: is_default_shipping
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this address is the default shipping destination for the customer.

attributes.name: last_used_date
attributes.description: Date when this address was last used in a transaction (order, shipment, or billing event).

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate in decimal degrees for geolocation and last-mile delivery optimization.

attributes.name: line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line including street number, street name, and unit/apartment number.

attributes.name: line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for additional location details such as building name, floor, suite, or department.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate in decimal degrees for geolocation and last-mile delivery optimization.

attributes.name: military_address_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address is a military address (APO/FPO/DPO). Requires special handling for international military mail.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the address record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: nickname
attributes.description: Customer-provided friendly name for the address (e.g., Home, Office, Mom's House) for easy identification.

attributes.name: po_box_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address is a PO Box. Some carriers and products cannot deliver to PO Boxes.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal code, ZIP code, or postcode for the address. Used for delivery routing and tax jurisdiction determination.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28; Universal Postal Union Standards

attributes.name: residential_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address is a residential location (true) or commercial/business location (false). Impacts shipping rates and delivery windows.

attributes.name: standardization_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address has been standardized to postal service formatting rules (USPS Publication 28, etc.).

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region code or name. For US addresses, use two-letter state abbreviation (e.g., CA, NY).

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction identifier derived from the address, used to determine applicable sales tax rates and rules.

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Status of address validation against postal service standards (USPS, Canada Post, etc.). Validated addresses reduce delivery failures.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Certification; Informatica Address Verification

attributes.name: verification_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the address was last verified against postal service databases or address validation services.

products.name: consent
products.description: Authoritative audit trail of customer privacy consent decisions required for GDPR and CCPA compliance. Each row captures consent type (marketing email, SMS, data sharing, profiling, cookies), consent status (granted/withdrawn/pending), consent version, collection channel (web/POS/mobile/paper), collection timestamp, IP address at time of consent, the specific privacy policy version accepted, and the profile reference for the consenting customer. Immutable append-only records supporting regulatory reporting, right-to-erasure workflows, and consent proof during audits.
products.reference: GDPR Consent Record / CCPA Privacy Record

attributes.name: consent_id
attributes.description: Primary key for consent

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: B2B consent management requires linking consent records to corporate accounts in addition to individual profiles. GDPR and CCPA compliance for B2B customers (e.g., marketing opt-ins, data processing a

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who provided or withdrew consent. Links to the customer master record.

attributes.name: collection_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the consent was collected: web (e-commerce site), mobile app, POS (point of sale terminal), paper form (in-store signup), call center, email campaign, or in-store kiosk. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: web|mobile_app|pos|paper_form|call_center|email|in_store_kiosk — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: Current status of the consent: granted (customer opted in), withdrawn (customer opted out), pending (awaiting customer action), expired (consent period ended), or revoked (administratively cancelled).

attributes.name: consent_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the consent decision was captured. Critical for audit trails and regulatory proof of consent timing.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1) - Demonstrating consent; CCPA Section 1798.135

attributes.name: consent_type
attributes.description: The specific type of consent being recorded: marketing email, SMS, push notifications, data sharing with partners, profiling for personalization, cookie tracking, or third-party data sharing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: marketing_email|marketing_sms|marketing_push|data_sharing|profiling|cookies|third_party_sharing — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 - Lawfulness of processing; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: data_subject_rights_notice
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the customer was informed of their data subject rights (right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, objection) at the time of consent collection.

attributes.name: double_opt_in_confirmed
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the customer confirmed their consent via a double opt-in process (e.g., email confirmation link). Best practice for email marketing consent.

attributes.name: double_opt_in_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the customer confirmed their consent via double opt-in. Null if double opt-in was not used or not yet confirmed.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this consent expires and must be re-obtained. Null if consent does not expire. Used for consent refresh workflows.

attributes.name: granularity
attributes.description: The level of granularity at which consent was obtained: global (all purposes), channel-specific (email vs SMS), purpose-specific (marketing vs analytics), or brand-specific (for multi-brand retailers).

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: The IP address from which the consent was submitted. Used as proof of consent origin for regulatory compliance and fraud detection.

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: The legal jurisdiction (country or state code) under which this consent was collected and is governed. Determines applicable privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA, etc.).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 3 - Territorial scope; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: The language in which the consent form was presented to the customer (ISO 639-1 two-letter code, e.g., EN, ES, FR). Required for multi-lingual compliance.

attributes.name: legal_basis
attributes.description: The legal basis under GDPR for processing this data: consent, contract fulfillment, legal obligation, vital interest, public task, or legitimate interest. Required for GDPR Article 6 compliance.

attributes.name: method
attributes.description: The method by which consent was obtained: explicit opt-in (customer actively checked box), implicit opt-in (inferred from action), pre-checked box (legacy, non-compliant), verbal (phone), or written signature (paper form).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(2) - Clear and distinguishable consent

attributes.name: minor_consent_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this consent record pertains to a minor (under age of digital consent in jurisdiction). Triggers additional parental consent requirements under GDPR Article 8 and COPPA.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 8 - Conditions for children's consent; COPPA

attributes.name: parental_consent_verified
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether parental or guardian consent has been verified for a minor. Required for COPPA and GDPR Article 8 compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 8 - Conditions for children's consent; COPPA

attributes.name: privacy_policy_version
attributes.description: The specific version of the privacy policy document that was in effect and accepted by the customer at the time of consent. Required for regulatory audit trails.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 13 - Information to be provided; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: proof_document_url
attributes.description: URL or storage path to the digitally signed or archived copy of the consent form as presented to the customer. Used for audit and regulatory inspection.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this consent record was first created in the data platform. Immutable. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: record_source_system
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the source system that originated this consent record (e.g., the e-commerce platform, POS system, call center CRM). Used for data lineage and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Detailed description of the scope and purpose of the consent. Explains what data will be used for and how, ensuring transparency and specificity required by privacy regulations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(2) - Specific and informed consent

attributes.name: third_party_recipient
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the third party with whom data may be shared under this consent. Null if no third-party sharing is involved. Required for transparency under GDPR Article 13.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 13(1)(e) - Recipients of personal data

attributes.name: user_agent
attributes.description: The browser or application user agent string captured at the time of consent. Provides additional context for consent collection environment.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the consent form or privacy policy that was presented to the customer at the time of consent. Enables tracking of which policy version the customer agreed to.

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: Optional free-text reason provided by the customer for withdrawing consent. Used for customer experience analysis and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: withdrawal_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the customer withdrew their consent. Null if consent has not been withdrawn. Critical for right-to-erasure workflows.

domains.name: product
domains.description: Authoritative catalog of all merchandise including SKUs, UPCs, GTINs, EANs, product hierarchies (department, category, subcategory), attributes, descriptions, images, private label vs. national brands, and assortment depth and breadth classifications. Managed via PIM (Product Information Management) and MDM systems. Supports category management, new item setup, and product lifecycle from introduction to discontinuation.

products.name: sku
products.description: Authoritative master record for every Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) in the retail assortment. This is the SSOT for all SKU-level product identity and physical characteristics across the enterprise. Captures the unique sellable unit identity including UPC, EAN, GTIN, internal item number, SKU description, brand reference, unit of measure, pack size, weight, dimensions (gross/net weight, length, width, height, volume, cube), ti-hi pallet configuration, temperature requirement, stackability, country of origin, hazmat flag, age-restriction flag, shelf life, product lifecycle status (active, discontinued, seasonal, clearance, pending setup), and creation/modification timestamps. Aligned with GS1 GDSN Trade Item standard. Sourced from the customer master data system and the retail merchandising system Merchandising System (ORMS). Central hub entity — all other product domain entities reference this record.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Stock Keeping Unit. Primary key for the SKU master record.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: add column product_brand_id (BIGINT) with FK to product.product_brand.product_brand_id - SKUs belong to brands and this relationship is fundamental for brand-level reporting and assortment planning

attributes.name: item_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.item_hierarchy. Business justification: sku has department_code, category_code, subcategory_code (all STRING) which should be normalized to a single FK to item_hierarchy. The hierarchy table is the authoritative source for merchandise taxon

attributes.name: uom_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.uom. Business justification: sku.unit_of_measure (STRING) should be normalized to a proper FK to uom reference table. UOM is the authoritative master for all units of measure with conversion factors and standards compliance (GS1,

attributes.name: age_restriction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU has age restrictions for purchase (e.g., alcohol, tobacco, mature-rated products). True if age-restricted, False if not.
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating where the product was manufactured or produced. Required for customs and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this SKU record was first created in the master data system. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: cube
attributes.description: Cubic volume of the SKU package calculated as length × width × height. Used for warehouse space planning and transportation optimization. Measured in cubic feet or cubic meters.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the SKU including key product attributes, features, and specifications. Used for product information management and customer-facing displays.

attributes.name: dimension_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for length, width, and height fields. IN (Inch), CM (Centimeter), FT (Foot), M (Meter).

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date when this SKU will be or was discontinued and removed from the active assortment. Null if the SKU is not planned for discontinuation. Follows format yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: ean
attributes.description: 13-digit European Article Number used for product identification globally. International barcode standard.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this SKU becomes active and available for sale. Used for new product launches and seasonal assortment planning. Follows format yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: gross_weight
attributes.description: Total weight of the SKU including packaging, measured in the unit specified by weight_unit_of_measure. Used for shipping and logistics calculations.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: Global Trade Item Number that uniquely identifies trade items worldwide. Can be 8, 12, 13, or 14 digits. Umbrella term encompassing UPC, EAN, and other GS1 identifiers.

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is classified as hazardous material requiring special handling, storage, and transportation procedures. True if hazmat, False if not.

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Height dimension of the SKU package, measured in the unit specified by dimension_unit_of_measure. Used for space planning and logistics.

attributes.name: hi
attributes.description: Number of layers (tiers) that can be stacked on a pallet. Part of the Ti-Hi pallet configuration used in warehouse and distribution center operations.

attributes.name: image_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the primary product image. Used for e-commerce, mobile apps, and digital signage.

attributes.name: internal_item_number
attributes.description: Retailer-specific internal product identifier used in legacy systems and internal operations. May differ from external GTIN/UPC.

attributes.name: length
attributes.description: Length dimension of the SKU package, measured in the unit specified by dimension_unit_of_measure. Used for space planning and logistics.

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the SKU in the product assortment. ACTIVE (currently sold), DISCONTINUED (no longer ordered), SEASONAL (sold during specific periods), CLEARANCE (being phased out), PENDING_SETUP (not yet available for sale), INACTIVE (temporarily unavailable).

attributes.name: minimum_age_requirement
attributes.description: Minimum age in years required to purchase this SKU. Null if no age restriction applies. Typically 18 or 21 for restricted products.
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this SKU record was last modified in the master data system. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: net_weight
attributes.description: Weight of the product contents excluding packaging, measured in the unit specified by weight_unit_of_measure. Used for regulatory compliance and consumer information.

attributes.name: pack_size
attributes.description: Number of consumer units contained in a single sellable pack. For example, a 6-pack of soda has pack_size = 6.

attributes.name: private_label_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is a private label (store brand) product or a national brand. True for private label, False for national brand.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Number of days the product remains sellable and safe for consumption from the date of manufacture or receipt. Critical for perishable goods and inventory rotation.

attributes.name: short_description
attributes.description: Abbreviated product description for use in constrained display contexts such as receipts, labels, and mobile interfaces. Typically 40-60 characters.

attributes.name: stackable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU can be safely stacked during storage and transportation. True if stackable, False if not.

attributes.name: temperature_requirement
attributes.description: Storage and transportation temperature requirement for the SKU. AMBIENT (room temperature), REFRIGERATED (32-40°F), FROZEN (below 0°F), CONTROLLED (specific temperature range).

attributes.name: ti
attributes.description: Number of units per layer on a pallet. Part of the Ti-Hi pallet configuration used in warehouse and distribution center operations.

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: 12-digit Universal Product Code used for point-of-sale scanning in North America. Standard barcode identifier for retail products.

attributes.name: vendor_item_number
attributes.description: The supplier's own product identifier for this SKU. Used for purchase orders and vendor communication.

attributes.name: volume

attributes.name: volume_unit_of_measure

attributes.name: weight_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for gross_weight and net_weight fields. LB (Pound), KG (Kilogram), OZ (Ounce), G (Gram).

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Width dimension of the SKU package, measured in the unit specified by dimension_unit_of_measure. Used for space planning and logistics.

products.name: item_hierarchy
products.description: Defines the full merchandise hierarchy and category taxonomy used to organize SKUs into departments, categories, subcategories, and segments for both operational and strategic purposes. This is the SSOT for all product classification and category management taxonomy. Captures hierarchy node identity, node code, node name, level (department, category, subcategory, segment), parent node reference (self-referencing for tree traversal), hierarchy path, hierarchy type (operational, strategic/category management), buyer assignment, planner assignment, strategic classification (destination, routine, convenience, seasonal), assortment breadth/depth targets, category manager, and effective dates. Supports category management, assortment planning, planogram design, financial reporting roll-ups, and NRF ARTS merchandise hierarchy alignment. Managed in the retail merchandising system Merchandising System (ORMS) and SAP S/4HANA MM module.

attributes.name: item_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the item hierarchy node. Primary key for the item hierarchy entity. This is the system-generated surrogate key for each node in the merchandise hierarchy tree.

attributes.name: parent_hierarchy_node_item_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent node in the hierarchy tree. Self-referencing relationship enabling tree traversal and roll-up aggregations. Null for top-level division nodes.

attributes.name: allows_direct_sku_assignment
attributes.business_glossary_term: Allows Direct SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) Assignment Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether SKUs can be directly assigned to this hierarchy node. Typically True for leaf nodes (subcategory, segment, class) and False for parent nodes (division, department, category). Controls data quality and hierarchy integrity in PIM (Product Information Management) systems.

tag_set.value: Allows Direct SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) Assignment Flag

attributes.name: assortment_breadth_target
attributes.description: Target number of distinct subcategories or product families within this category. Assortment breadth measures the range of categories offered. Used in category management and OTB (Open to Buy) planning.

attributes.name: assortment_depth_target
attributes.description: Target number of distinct SKUs (Stock Keeping Units) within a subcategory or product family. Assortment depth measures the variety within a category. Deeper assortments offer more choice but increase inventory complexity and carrying costs.

attributes.name: category_manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the category manager responsible for strategic category management, assortment optimization, and category P&L performance. Category managers define assortment breadth and depth targets and drive GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hierarchy node record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and master data governance. Automatically populated by the customer master data system (Master Data Management) or source system.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Automated data quality score (0-100) calculated by the customer master data system based on completeness, accuracy, consistency, and timeliness rules. Scores below threshold trigger data stewardship workflows. Supports master data governance and continuous improvement.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this hierarchy node is retired or deprecated. Null for currently active nodes. Supports historical reporting and category lifecycle management. Enables analysis of discontinued categories and assortment changes over time.

attributes.name: effective_start_date

attributes.name: external_reference_code

attributes.name: hierarchy_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the hierarchy node purpose, scope, and business rules. Includes category definition, inclusion/exclusion criteria, and merchandising guidelines. Used for training, onboarding, and cross-functional alignment.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: The level of this node within the merchandise hierarchy tree. Defines the depth and classification granularity. Division is the highest level, followed by department, category, subcategory, segment, and class as the most granular.

attributes.name: hierarchy_node_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the hierarchy node. This is the externally-known unique code used in the retail merchandising system Merchandising System (ORMS) and SAP S/4HANA MM module for category management and reporting. Examples: DEPT01, CAT-ELEC, SUBCAT-TV.

attributes.name: hierarchy_node_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the hierarchy node. Examples: Electronics, Home Appliances, Televisions, 4K Smart TVs. Used in reporting, planograms, and category management dashboards.

attributes.name: hierarchy_path
attributes.description: Full path from root to current node using node codes separated by forward slashes. Example: DIVISION01/DEPT05/CAT-ELEC/SUBCAT-TV. Enables efficient hierarchy queries and reporting roll-ups without recursive joins.

attributes.name: hierarchy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the hierarchy purpose. Operational hierarchies support daily store operations and planograms. Strategic hierarchies support category management and assortment planning. Financial hierarchies align with P&L reporting. Planning hierarchies support OTB (Open to Buy) and MRP (Material Requirements Planning).

attributes.name: is_leaf_node
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this node is a leaf node (has no children) in the hierarchy tree. Leaf nodes are the most granular classification level and are directly associated with SKUs. True for leaf nodes, False for parent nodes.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system account that last modified this hierarchy node record. Supports audit trail, accountability, and master data governance. Captured from the customer master data system workflow or source system authentication.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hierarchy node record was last updated. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing. Updated automatically on every modification in the customer master data system or source system.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Average supplier delivery lead time in days for this category. Used in demand planning, safety stock calculations, and OTB (Open to Buy) planning. Managed in Blue Yonder Demand Planning and the retail merchandising system Merchandising System (ORMS).

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the hierarchy node. Active nodes are in use for assortment planning and reporting. Inactive nodes are temporarily disabled. Pending nodes are awaiting approval. Deprecated nodes are being phased out. Archived nodes are retained for historical reporting only.

attributes.name: markdown_cadence
attributes.description: Frequency and timing of planned price markdowns for this category. Weekly and biweekly cadences support fast fashion and perishables. Monthly cadences support durable goods. Seasonal cadences align with end-of-season clearance. Event-driven markdowns respond to competitive pressure or excess inventory. Managed in the retail merchandising system Price Management (RPM).

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity required by suppliers for this category. Impacts purchase order planning, inventory carrying costs, and cash flow management. Negotiated by buyers and enforced in procurement systems.

attributes.name: omnichannel_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this category is available across all channels (stores, e-commerce, mobile app, BOPIS, ship-from-store). True for omnichannel categories, False for channel-specific categories. Supports unified commerce strategy and cross-channel inventory visibility.

attributes.name: planner_name
attributes.description: Name of the merchandise planner responsible for demand forecasting, inventory planning, and replenishment for this category. Planners use Blue Yonder Demand Planning to optimize inventory levels and minimize stockouts and overstock.

attributes.name: pricing_strategy
attributes.description: Pricing strategy classification for this category. EDLP (Everyday Low Price) maintains consistent low prices. Hi-Lo (High-Low Pricing Strategy) uses frequent promotions and markdowns. Premium targets higher-margin positioning. Competitive matches market pricing. Value emphasizes affordability. Managed in the retail merchandising system Price Management (RPM).

attributes.name: private_label_penetration_target_percent
attributes.description: Target percentage of category sales from private label (store brand) products. Private label products typically offer higher margins than national brands. Used in assortment planning and supplier negotiations to optimize category profitability.

attributes.name: replenishment_method
attributes.description: Inventory replenishment method for this category. Auto uses system-driven replenishment based on demand forecasting. Manual requires planner intervention. Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) delegates replenishment to suppliers. Cross-docking transfers inventory directly from receiving to shipping. Drop ship sends directly from vendor to customer.

attributes.name: safety_stock_weeks
attributes.description: Target safety stock level expressed in weeks of supply (WOS). Buffer inventory to protect against demand variability and supply chain disruptions. Calculated based on service level targets and lead time variability in Blue Yonder Demand Planning.

attributes.name: seasonality_indicator
attributes.description: Seasonal demand pattern classification for this category. Non-seasonal categories have consistent year-round demand. Seasonal categories have predictable demand peaks tied to calendar periods. Used in demand forecasting, markdown planning, and inventory optimization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: non_seasonal|spring|summer|fall|winter|holiday|back_to_school — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric sequence for ordering sibling nodes within the same parent. Used for consistent presentation in reports, planograms, and digital storefronts. Lower numbers appear first.

attributes.name: strategic_classification
attributes.description: Strategic role of the category in the overall merchandising strategy. Destination categories drive store traffic and differentiation. Routine categories are frequently purchased staples. Convenience categories are impulse or fill-in purchases. Seasonal categories have time-bound demand. Private label vs. national brand classification supports margin optimization.

attributes.name: target_gross_margin_percent
attributes.description: Target gross margin percentage for this category, expressed as a percentage of net sales. Used in pricing strategy, markdown planning, and category performance evaluation. Supports GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) optimization.

products.name: attribute
products.description: Stores extended descriptive, technical, and measurement attributes for each SKU beyond core identity fields using a flexible entity-attribute-value (EAV) pattern. Enables faceted search on e-commerce platforms, product comparison, PIM-driven enrichment, multi-UOM transaction support across procurement/inventory/POS, data completeness scoring for GS1 GDSN readiness, and regulatory attribute capture. Sourced from the customer master data system PIM module and the e-commerce platform product catalog. Aligned with GS1 GDSN attribute standards for trade item data synchronization.

attributes.name: attribute_id

attributes.name: approved_timestamp

attributes.name: attribute_group

Enables faceted search and attribute organization in PIM systems. attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this attribute record (e.g., 'active', 'inactive', 'pending_approval', 'deprecated', 'archived'). Supports attribute governance and PIM workflow management.

attributes.name: certification_body
attributes.description: The name of the organization or authority that certified this attribute value (e.g., 'USDA Organic', 'Energy Star', 'Fair Trade', 'UL Listed'). Applicable when is_certified is True.

attributes.name: certification_date

attributes.name: data_quality_score

attributes.name: data_type

attributes.name: display_order

attributes.name: effective_end_date

attributes.name: is_certified

attributes.name: is_comparable

attributes.name: is_searchable

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: locale

products.name: brand
products.description: Master record for all brands carried in the retail assortment, covering national brands, private label (store brand), exclusive, and licensed products. Captures brand name, brand owner, brand type (national, private label, exclusive, licensed), brand tier (premium, value, standard), country of origin, brand logo asset reference, brand status, launch date, and brand portfolio grouping. Supports private label vs. national brand assortment strategy, vendor brand negotiations, brand-level margin analysis, and consumer-facing brand filtering on e-commerce platforms.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product brand record. Primary key.

attributes.name: item_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: add column item_hierarchy_id (BIGINT) with FK to product.item_hierarchy.item_hierarchy_id - brands operate within product hierarchy categories for category management

attributes.name: average_margin_percent

attributes.name: brand_status

attributes.name: brand_type

attributes.name: code

attributes.name: country_of_origin_code

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: description

attributes.name: discontinuation_date

attributes.name: is_exclusive

attributes.name: is_licensed

True for licensed brands, false otherwise. Impacts royalty payments and contract management.

attributes.name: is_private_label

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: launch_date

attributes.name: lead_time_days

attributes.name: license_expiration_date

attributes.name: target_customer_segment

attributes.name: website_url

products.name: item_variant
products.description: Captures all SKU-to-SKU relationships including variant relationships (parent style/base item to child SKUs across size, color, flavor, scent, pack configuration) and approved substitution relationships (equivalent, upgrade, downgrade, cross-sell for fulfillment and out-of-stock scenarios). Critical for apparel size-color grids, grocery flavor/size variants, omnichannel fulfillment substitution, BOPIS/ROPIS picking, and reducing lost sales from stockouts. attributes.name: bnpl_provider

attributes.name: capture_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the authorized payment was captured (funds marked for settlement). Typically occurs at order fulfillment or shipment.

attributes.name: card_brand
attributes.description: Brand or network of the payment card used (e.g., Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover). Applicable only when payment method type is credit or debit card. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: visa|mastercard|amex|discover|jcb|diners_club|unionpay — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: card_expiry_month
attributes.description: Expiration month of the payment card (1-12). Used for validation and recurring payment processing. Stored securely per PCI DSS requirements.

attributes.name: card_expiry_year
attributes.description: Expiration year of the payment card (four-digit format, e.g., 2025). Used for validation and recurring payment processing. Stored securely per PCI DSS requirements.

attributes.name: cardholder_name
attributes.description: Name of the cardholder as it appears on the payment card. Used for verification and fraud prevention. Stored securely per PCI DSS and GDPR requirements.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Channel or interface through which the payment was initiated. Distinguishes web, mobile app, in-store POS (Point of Sale), call center, kiosk, or third-party platform.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment tender record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the payment amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, CAD). Supports multi-currency transactions.

attributes.name: cvv_result_code
attributes.description: Result code indicating whether the Card Verification Value (CVV/CVV2/CVC) provided by the cardholder matched the issuer's records. Used for fraud prevention.

attributes.name: digital_wallet_type
attributes.description: Type of digital wallet used for this payment tender (e.g., Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay, PayPal, Venmo). Applicable only when payment method type is digital wallet.

attributes.name: fraud_decision
attributes.description: Decision outcome from fraud detection system. Indicates whether the payment was approved, declined, flagged for manual review, or challenged with additional authentication.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Fraud Prevention Best Practices

attributes.name: fraud_score
attributes.description: Numerical fraud risk score assigned by fraud detection system, typically ranging from 0 (low risk) to 100 (high risk). Used for payment approval decisions and risk management.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Fraud Prevention Best Practices

attributes.name: loyalty_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points redeemed as payment for this tender. Applicable only when payment method type is loyalty points.

attributes.name: masked_pan
attributes.description: Masked or truncated version of the payment card Primary Account Number (PAN), typically showing only the last four digits (e.g., ****1234). Used for display and customer service without exposing full card number.
attributes.references: PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard) Requirement 3.3

attributes.name: method_type
attributes.description: Type of payment instrument used for this tender. Includes credit card, debit card, gift card, loyalty points, BNPL (Buy Now Pay Later), cash, digital wallet (e.g., Apple Pay, Google Pay), or check. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_card|debit_card|gift_card|loyalty_points|bnpl|cash|digital_wallet|check — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: PCI SSC (Payment Card Industry Security Standards Council) Payment Types

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment tender. Tracks progression from authorization through settlement, including declined, voided, or refunded states.

attributes.name: processor_reference_code
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier assigned by the payment gateway or processor. Used for tracing and reconciliation with external payment systems.

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount refunded to the customer for this payment tender. May be partial or full refund of the original payment amount.

attributes.name: refund_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when a refund was processed for this payment tender. Applicable for returns and RMA (Return Merchandise Authorization) scenarios.

attributes.name: settlement_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payment was settled and funds were transferred from the customer's account to the merchant's account. Final step in payment lifecycle.

attributes.name: tender_sequence
attributes.description: Sequence number indicating the order in which this payment tender was applied in a split-tender scenario. First tender is 1, second is 2, etc.

attributes.name: three_ds_authentication_result
attributes.description: Result of 3-D Secure (3DS) authentication protocol for card-not-present transactions. Indicates whether cardholder was successfully authenticated, reducing fraud liability.

attributes.name: three_ds_version
attributes.description: Version of the 3-D Secure protocol used for authentication (e.g., 1.0.2, 2.1.0, 2.2.0). Newer versions provide enhanced security and user experience.

attributes.name: token
attributes.business_glossary_term: PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard) Payment Token
attributes.description: Tokenized reference to the payment instrument, replacing sensitive card data. Token is generated by PCI DSS compliant tokenization service and used for recurring payments or stored payment methods.

tag_set.value: PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard) Payment Token

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment tender record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: void_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payment authorization was voided (cancelled before capture). Applicable when order is cancelled before fulfillment.

products.name: discount
products.description: Discount and promotion application record at the order header or line level. Captures discount type (coupon, promo code, loyalty reward, markdown, BOGO, clearance, employee discount), discount code, discount amount or percentage, promotion campaign reference, stackability flag, applied-at level (header vs line), and approval status. Enables promotion attribution, markdown tracking, sell-through analysis, and P&L impact per order. Tax calculation attributes (taxable amount adjustment) included where discount affects tax basis.

attributes.name: discount_id
attributes.description: Primary key for discount

attributes.name: coupon_id

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user (manager or supervisor) who approved the discount application. Null if auto-applied or pending approval.

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the order to which this discount is applied. Links to the order header.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical store location where the discount was applied. Null for online or non-store channels.

attributes.name: markdown_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.markdown. Business justification: Discounts applied as part of markdown campaigns need markdown linkage for clearance performance tracking, markdown ROI analysis, and reconciliation of planned vs actual markdown execution. Business tr

attributes.name: membership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty program member who redeemed points or received a loyalty-based discount. Null if discount is not loyalty-based.

attributes.name: order_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific order line item to which this discount is applied. Null if discount is applied at order header level.

attributes.name: pos_terminal_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the Point of Sale (POS) terminal or register where the discount was applied. Null for online channels.

attributes.name: pos_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.pos_transaction. Business justification: Discounts and promotions are applied at POS transactions in-store. The discount table already links to header and order_line for online/omnichannel orders, but lacks a direct FK to pos_transaction for

attributes.name: pos_transaction_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.pos_transaction_line.
