products.name: pos_terminal
products.description: Master record for every Point-of-Sale (POS) terminal deployed within a store location. Captures terminal ID, lane number, terminal type (staffed checkout lane, self-checkout kiosk, mobile POS, customer service desk, pharmacy register), hardware model, software version, payment acceptance capabilities (EMV chip, NFC/contactless, PIN debit, EBT/SNAP, mobile wallet), peripheral devices (scanner, scale, receipt printer), installation date, last maintenance date, next scheduled maintenance, terminal status (active, offline, maintenance, decommissioned), PCI DSS compliance certification date, and assigned department or zone within the store. Critical for POS transaction reconciliation, shrinkage investigation, lane productivity analysis, and omnichannel payment compliance.

attributes.name: pos_terminal_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the POS terminal. Primary key. Inferred role: MASTER_RESOURCE.

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.store_department. Business justification: POS terminals are assigned to specific departments within a store (e.g., electronics department checkout, grocery department checkout). The pos_terminal record currently denormalizes department_code a

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the store location where this POS terminal is deployed.

attributes.name: barcode_scanner_type
attributes.description: Type of barcode scanner peripheral attached to the POS terminal. Determines scanning workflow and throughput capabilities.

attributes.name: cash_drawer_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal is connected to a cash drawer for handling cash transactions. False for self-checkout kiosks and mobile POS devices that do not accept cash.

attributes.name: contactless_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal supports Near Field Communication (NFC) contactless payments (tap-to-pay, mobile wallets like Apple Pay, Google Pay).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this POS terminal record was first created in the master data system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: customer_display_type
attributes.description: Type of customer-facing display device attached to the terminal. Shows transaction details, pricing, and promotional messages to the customer during checkout.

attributes.name: ebt_snap_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal is certified to accept Electronic Benefits Transfer (EBT) and Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) payments. Required for grocery retailers serving SNAP recipients.

attributes.name: emv_chip_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal supports EMV chip card transactions (contact chip reading). Required for PCI DSS compliance and fraud reduction.

attributes.name: encryption_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal encrypts payment card data at the point of interaction (P2PE - Point-to-Point Encryption). Required for PCI DSS compliance and fraud prevention.

attributes.name: hardware_model
attributes.description: Manufacturer model number or identifier for the POS terminal hardware (e.g., 'NCR RealPOS 82XRT', 'Toshiba TCx Sky', 'Zebra TC52'). Critical for maintenance planning and compatibility management.

attributes.name: hardware_serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned unique serial number for the physical POS terminal device. Used for warranty tracking, asset management, and theft prevention.

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the POS terminal was first installed and commissioned at the store location. Used for asset lifecycle tracking and depreciation calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: Internet Protocol (IP) address assigned to the POS terminal on the store network. Used for network troubleshooting, security monitoring, and remote management.

attributes.name: lane_number
attributes.description: Physical lane or checkout position number within the store layout. Used for customer wayfinding and operational reporting. Null for mobile POS devices.

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent preventive maintenance or repair service performed on the terminal. Used for maintenance schedule compliance tracking.

attributes.name: last_transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent transaction processed by this terminal. Used for terminal utilization analysis and anomaly detection (e.g., identifying inactive terminals).

attributes.name: mac_address
attributes.description: Media Access Control (MAC) address of the POS terminal network interface. Unique hardware identifier used for network access control and device authentication.

attributes.name: mobile_wallet_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal supports mobile wallet payment methods (Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay, etc.). Typically requires NFC hardware.

attributes.name: network_zone
attributes.description: Network security zone or segment where the POS terminal is deployed. Cardholder Data Environment (CDE) terminals are subject to stricter PCI DSS controls.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date when the next preventive maintenance service is scheduled for the terminal. Used for proactive maintenance planning and resource allocation.

attributes.name: operating_system
attributes.description: Operating system running on the POS terminal (e.g., 'Windows 10 IoT', 'Android 11', 'Linux Ubuntu 20.04'). Impacts security posture and application compatibility.

attributes.name: payment_processor
attributes.description: Name of the payment processing service or gateway integrated with this terminal (e.g., 'First Data', 'Worldpay', 'Square'). Determines payment acceptance capabilities and settlement routing.

attributes.name: pci_dss_certification_date
attributes.description: Date when the terminal last passed Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) compliance certification. Must be renewed annually to maintain payment acceptance capabilities.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Requirements and Security Assessment Procedures

attributes.name: pci_dss_certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the current PCI DSS certification expires. Terminals must be recertified before this date to continue processing payment card transactions.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Requirements and Security Assessment Procedures

attributes.name: pin_debit_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal supports PIN-based debit card transactions. Requires secure PIN pad hardware.

attributes.name: qr_code_payment_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal supports QR code-based payment methods (e.g., Alipay, WeChat Pay, retailer-specific QR payment apps).

attributes.name: receipt_printer_model
attributes.description: Model identifier for the receipt printer peripheral attached to the POS terminal. Used for consumables ordering and maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: remote_management_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal can be remotely monitored, configured, and updated from a central management system. Enables efficient fleet management and rapid issue resolution.

attributes.name: scale_integrated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal has an integrated scale for weighing produce, bulk items, or other variable-weight merchandise. Common in grocery checkout lanes.
attributes.references: NIST Handbook 44 - Specifications for Weighing Devices

attributes.name: signature_capture_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal supports electronic signature capture for credit card transactions and delivery confirmations.

attributes.name: software_version
attributes.description: Version number of the POS application software currently installed on the terminal. Critical for security patch management and feature compatibility.

attributes.name: terminal_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label for the POS terminal, often indicating its location or purpose within the store (e.g., 'Lane 5', 'Customer Service Desk', 'Pharmacy Register').

attributes.name: terminal_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the POS terminal, typically displayed on the terminal and used in operational communications. Unique within a store location.

attributes.name: terminal_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the POS terminal. Determines whether the terminal is available for transaction processing. Active terminals are in production use; offline terminals are temporarily unavailable; maintenance terminals are undergoing service; decommissioned terminals are permanently retired.

attributes.name: terminal_type
attributes.description: Classification of the POS terminal based on its operational function and staffing model. Determines transaction workflows and customer interaction patterns.

attributes.name: tokenization_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal supports payment tokenization, replacing sensitive card data with non-sensitive tokens for storage and transmission. Reduces PCI DSS scope.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this POS terminal record was last modified in the master data system. Used for change tracking and data synchronization.

products.name: department
products.description: Master record for departments or selling zones within a store location — the primary sub-location operational unit in retail. Captures department ID, department name, department code, parent store location, floor number, zone coordinates, department type (grocery, apparel, electronics, household, pharmacy, bakery, deli, produce, frozen, health & beauty, seasonal, etc.), selling area (sq ft), number of fixtures, department manager assignment reference, labor budget allocation, and active status. Departments are the fundamental unit for planogram assignment, inventory allocation, staffing schedules, shrinkage attribution, and P&L sub-reporting within a store. Most operational KPIs (sales per sq ft, shrink rate, labor-to-sales ratio) are measured at department level.

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the store department. Primary key for the store department entity.

attributes.name: item_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.item_hierarchy. Business justification: Store departments map to merchandise categories (item hierarchy). Department managers are responsible for specific categories. Essential for departmental P&L reporting by category and category manager

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent store location where this department is physically located.

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list. Business justification: Licensed and specialty departments (pharmacy, optical, jewelry) operate under distinct price lists separate from the main store list. Department-level price list assignment drives POS price resolution

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the department record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: department_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the department. Active departments are open for business; inactive departments are closed or not yet operational.

attributes.name: department_type
attributes.description: Classification of the department by merchandise category. Determines merchandising strategy, planogram standards, and operational procedures. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: grocery|apparel|electronics|household|pharmacy|bakery|deli|produce|frozen|health_beauty|seasonal|home_garden|automotive|sporting_goods|toys|jewelry|furniture — 17 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the department ceased operations or when the current configuration ended. Null for currently active departments.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the department became operational or when the current configuration became effective. Used for historical tracking and comp sales analysis.

attributes.name: endcap_count
attributes.description: Number of endcap display positions (end-of-aisle promotional displays) available in the department. Prime real estate for high-margin or promotional items.

attributes.name: fixture_count
attributes.description: Total number of fixtures (gondolas, endcaps, shelving units, display cases) assigned to the department. Used for planogram capacity planning.

attributes.name: floor_number
attributes.description: Floor level where the department is located within the store. Ground floor is typically 1, basement levels may be 0 or negative.

attributes.name: gondola_count
attributes.description: Number of gondola shelving units (freestanding double-sided shelving) in the department. Key metric for planogram assignment and merchandising capacity.

attributes.name: gross_margin_target_percent
attributes.description: Target gross margin percentage for the department. Used to measure profitability and pricing effectiveness.

attributes.name: labor_budget_monthly
attributes.description: Monthly labor budget allocation for the department in local currency. Used for workforce scheduling and labor-to-sales ratio management.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified the department record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the department record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: license_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the regulatory license or permit for licensed departments. Null for non-licensed departments.

attributes.name: license_number
attributes.description: Regulatory license or permit number for licensed departments (e.g., pharmacy license, alcohol retail license). Null for non-licensed departments.

attributes.name: licensed_department_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the department requires special licensing or regulatory compliance (e.g., pharmacy, alcohol, tobacco, firearms). True if licensing is required.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the department. Used for operational context and exception handling.

attributes.name: omnichannel_fulfillment_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the department supports omnichannel fulfillment operations (BOPIS, ROPIS, ship-from-store). True if omnichannel fulfillment is enabled.

attributes.name: planogram_count
attributes.description: Number of active planograms (shelf layout diagrams) assigned to the department. Each planogram defines product placement and facings for a fixture or section.

attributes.name: pos_terminal_count
attributes.description: Number of POS terminals or checkout lanes assigned to or located within the department. Relevant for departments with dedicated checkout (e.g., pharmacy, jewelry).

attributes.name: sales_target_monthly
attributes.description: Monthly sales target or quota for the department in local currency. Used for performance management and comp sales (SSS) analysis.

attributes.name: selling_area_sq_ft
attributes.description: Total selling floor space allocated to the department measured in square feet. Used to calculate sales per square foot and space productivity metrics.

attributes.name: shrinkage_rate_percent
attributes.description: Historical shrinkage rate (inventory loss due to theft, damage, spoilage) for the department expressed as a percentage of sales. Used for loss prevention planning.
attributes.references: National Retail Federation (NRF) Loss Prevention Standards

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the department requires temperature-controlled environment (e.g., frozen, refrigerated, deli, bakery). True if climate control is required.
attributes.references: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Food Safety Standards

attributes.name: temperature_range_max_f
attributes.description: Maximum temperature threshold in Fahrenheit for temperature-controlled departments. Null for non-temperature-controlled departments.
attributes.references: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Food Safety Standards

attributes.name: temperature_range_min_f
attributes.description: Minimum temperature threshold in Fahrenheit for temperature-controlled departments. Null for non-temperature-controlled departments.
attributes.references: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Food Safety Standards

attributes.name: visual_merchandising_standard
attributes.description: Code or reference to the visual merchandising standard or guideline applied to the department. Defines display aesthetics, signage, and presentation rules.

attributes.name: zone_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the physical zone or area within the store floor plan. Used for wayfinding, inventory location, and planogram assignment.

products.name: cluster
products.description: Master record defining store clusters — logical groupings of store locations used for localized assortment planning, zone pricing, promotional targeting, and operational benchmarking. Captures cluster ID, name, type (assortment, pricing zone, demographic, performance tier, climate), clustering methodology (algorithmic, manual override, hybrid), effective date range, member store count, and cluster owner (merchandising, pricing, or operations team). Also owns store-to-cluster membership associations including effective dates and override reasons, supporting many-to-many store-cluster relationships across concurrent clustering schemes.

attributes.name: cluster_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the store cluster. Primary key.

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.dc_facility. Business justification: Cluster-level replenishment planning and assortment allocation require knowing which DC primarily serves a cluster. Retail planners assign clusters to DCs for distribution routing, promotional stock s

attributes.name: parent_cluster_id
attributes.description: Reference to a parent cluster if this cluster is part of a hierarchical clustering structure (e.g., sub-clusters within a regional cluster). Null for top-level clusters.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) - Cluster Hierarchy

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_zone. Business justification: Store clusters group locations by competitive/demographic profile; assigning a default price zone to a cluster operationalizes the cluster's pricing_strategy attribute. Cluster-level price zone drives

attributes.name: region_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.region. Business justification: Clusters are geographically scoped groupings of store locations. The cluster table carries geographic_scope (STRING) and urbanization_level (STRING) as descriptive fields, but has no FK to the authori

attributes.name: allows_overlap
attributes.description: Indicates whether a store can belong to multiple clusters of this type simultaneously. True for concurrent clustering schemes (e.g., a store can be in both an assortment cluster and a pricing zone cluster); false for mutually exclusive schemes.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) - Cluster Configuration

attributes.name: assortment_depth_strategy
attributes.description: Planned depth of product assortment for this cluster. Deep assortment offers extensive variety within categories; moderate offers balanced selection; shallow offers limited SKU count; curated offers highly selective premium assortment. Drives OTB planning and space allocation.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) - Assortment Planning

attributes.name: average_annual_sales_usd
attributes.description: Average annual sales volume in USD for stores in this cluster. Used for performance tier clustering and benchmarking. Business-confidential financial metric.

attributes.name: average_store_size_sqft
attributes.description: Average selling floor area in square feet of stores in this cluster. Used for format-based clustering and space productivity benchmarking.

attributes.name: climate_zone
attributes.description: Predominant climate classification for stores in this cluster. Used for climate-based clustering to drive seasonal assortment and inventory planning (e.g., winter apparel depth, cooling appliances).

attributes.name: cluster_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cluster. Active clusters are in operational use; inactive clusters are temporarily disabled; pending clusters are awaiting approval; archived clusters are historical; under_review clusters are being evaluated for changes.

attributes.name: cluster_type
attributes.description: Classification of the clustering scheme. Assortment clusters drive localized product mix; pricing zone clusters enable zone-based pricing strategies; demographic clusters group by customer profile; performance tier clusters segment by sales volume or profitability; climate clusters address seasonal/weather-driven needs; geographic clusters group by region; format clusters group by store format (hypermarket, discount, dark store); omnichannel clusters optimize fulfillment network. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: assortment|pricing_zone|demographic|performance_tier|climate|geographic|format|omnichannel — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: clustering_criteria
attributes.description: Business rules or data attributes used to assign stores to this cluster (e.g., sales volume > $10M, urban location, customer income > $75K, climate zone = temperate). Supports transparency and auditability of cluster logic.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Clustering Rules

attributes.name: clustering_methodology
attributes.description: Method used to define the cluster. Algorithmic indicates data-driven segmentation (e.g., k-means, hierarchical clustering); manual indicates business-defined groupings; hybrid combines both; machine_learning indicates advanced ML models; rule_based indicates business rules engine.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Clustering Engine

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Business-friendly alphanumeric code for the store cluster, used in reporting and operational systems. Typically follows a pattern like REGION-TYPE-SEQ (e.g., NE-ASSORT-01, SW-PRICE-03).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) - Cluster Master

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cluster record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the cluster purpose, characteristics, and intended use. Explains the rationale for grouping these stores together.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) - Cluster Master

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this cluster definition ceases to be effective. Null indicates the cluster is currently active with no planned end date.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) - Effective Dating

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this cluster definition becomes effective for operational use. Supports temporal validity and historical analysis of cluster changes.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) - Effective Dating

attributes.name: external_cluster_code
attributes.description: Cluster identifier from the source system of record. Used for cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic coverage of the cluster. National clusters span the entire country; regional clusters cover multi-state regions; state clusters are state-specific; metro clusters cover metropolitan areas; local clusters are city or neighborhood-level.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cluster record was last updated. Supports change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when this cluster definition was last reviewed and validated by the cluster owner. Used to track cluster maintenance and ensure clustering logic remains current.

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: Depth level in the cluster hierarchy. Level 1 is top-level (e.g., national or regional); higher numbers indicate more granular sub-clusters. Supports hierarchical rollup and drill-down analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) - Cluster Hierarchy

attributes.name: member_store_count
attributes.description: Total number of store locations currently assigned to this cluster. Updated as stores join or leave the cluster.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) - Cluster Membership

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the store cluster, used for display and business communication (e.g., Northeast Urban High-Income, Southwest Discount Tier 1).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) - Cluster Master

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next cluster review. Ensures periodic validation of cluster definitions and membership. Typically quarterly or semi-annually.

attributes.name: owner_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or role responsible for this cluster definition (e.g., Regional Merchandising Manager, Pricing Director).

attributes.name: owner_team
attributes.description: Business function responsible for defining and maintaining this cluster. Merchandising owns assortment clusters; pricing owns pricing zone clusters; operations owns performance tier clusters; supply chain owns fulfillment clusters; marketing owns demographic clusters; analytics owns data-driven experimental clusters.

attributes.name: pricing_strategy
attributes.description: Pricing approach for this cluster. EDLP (Everyday Low Price) maintains consistent low prices; hi-lo uses frequent promotions; premium targets high-margin customers; competitive matches market prices; value emphasizes affordability. Drives zone pricing rules.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) - Pricing Strategy

attributes.name: primary_business_purpose
attributes.description: Primary operational use case for this cluster (e.g., localized assortment planning, zone pricing strategy, promotional targeting, operational benchmarking, fulfillment network optimization).

attributes.name: promotional_intensity
attributes.description: Frequency and depth of promotional activity targeted at this cluster. High intensity clusters receive frequent deep discounts; low intensity clusters have minimal promotions; none indicates EDLP strategy with no promotions.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) - Promotion Planning

attributes.name: replenishment_frequency
attributes.description: Standard inventory replenishment cadence for stores in this cluster. Drives supply chain planning and DC allocation. High-volume urban stores typically receive daily replenishment; lower-volume rural stores may be weekly or bi-weekly.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Replenishment Policy

attributes.name: store_format_mix
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of store formats included in this cluster (e.g., hypermarket, discount, dark_store, MFC). Used for format-based clustering and omnichannel fulfillment optimization.

attributes.name: supports_omnichannel
attributes.description: Indicates whether stores in this cluster are enabled for omnichannel fulfillment capabilities (BOPIS, ROPIS, ship-from-store, curbside pickup). True if cluster is designed for omnichannel operations.

attributes.name: target_customer_segment
attributes.description: Primary customer demographic or psychographic segment this cluster is designed to serve (e.g., high-income urban professionals, budget-conscious families, college students). Used for demographic-based clustering.

attributes.name: urbanization_level
attributes.description: Population density classification for stores in this cluster. Urban stores serve high-density city centers; suburban stores serve residential areas; rural stores serve low-density regions; exurban stores serve outer suburban fringe areas.

products.name: sales_territory

attributes.name: sales_territory_id
attributes.description: Primary key for sales_territory

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who manages this sales territory. Responsible for territory performance and team oversight.

attributes.name: parent_sales_territory_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on sales_territory (parent_sales_territory_id)

attributes.name: parent_territory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent sales territory in a hierarchical territory structure. Null for top-level territories.

attributes.name: region_id

attributes.name: store_location_id

attributes.name: annual_revenue_target

attributes.name: boundary_definition
attributes.description: Textual or structured definition of territory boundaries (e.g., list of counties, postal codes, geographic coordinates, or natural boundaries).

attributes.name: competition_level
attributes.description: Assessment of competitive intensity within this sales territory: low (few competitors), moderate (balanced), high (many competitors), very_high (saturated market), monopoly (single dominant player).

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the primary country for this sales territory (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR, DEU).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sales territory record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for financial targets and reporting in this territory (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: customer_count
attributes.description: Number of active customers assigned to this sales territory. Used for territory balancing and performance benchmarking.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this sales territory ceases or ceased to be active. Null for open-ended territories.

attributes.name: effective_start_date

attributes.name: household_count

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: Primary language code for customer communication and marketing in this territory (e.g., en, es, fr, de).

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who last modified this sales territory record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sales territory record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: market_potential_score
attributes.description: Quantitative score (0-100) representing the market opportunity and growth potential of this territory, based on demographics, competition, and economic indicators.

attributes.name: median_household_income
attributes.description: Median annual household income within this territory, used for demographic profiling and product assortment planning.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes and comments about this sales territory, including special instructions, historical context, or operational considerations.

attributes.name: population_size
attributes.description: Total population count within the geographic boundaries of this sales territory. Used for market sizing and penetration analysis.

attributes.name: postal_code_range_end
attributes.description: Ending postal code for territories defined by postal code ranges. Used for geographic territory assignment.

attributes.name: postal_code_range_start
attributes.description: Starting postal code for territories defined by postal code ranges. Used for geographic territory assignment.

attributes.name: priority_tier
attributes.description: Strategic priority classification for resource allocation and management focus. Tier 1/strategic territories receive highest investment; tier 3/maintenance receive baseline support.

attributes.name: sales_channel
attributes.description: Primary sales channel served by this territory: retail (physical stores), wholesale (bulk/distributor), ecommerce (online), B2B (business customers), B2C (consumers), omnichannel (integrated).

attributes.name: sales_rep_count
attributes.description: Number of sales representatives currently assigned to this territory. Used for capacity planning and workload balancing.

attributes.name: sales_territory_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the sales territory. Active territories are operational; inactive are closed; pending are awaiting activation; suspended are temporarily halted; archived are historical; planned are future territories.

attributes.name: state_province_code
attributes.description: State or province code for territories defined at sub-national level (e.g., CA, TX, ON, QC).

attributes.name: store_count
attributes.description: Number of retail stores located within this sales territory. Used for territory sizing and resource allocation.

attributes.name: territory_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the sales territory, used for external reference and reporting.

attributes.name: territory_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the sales territory, including geographic boundaries, key characteristics, strategic focus, and special considerations.

attributes.name: territory_level
attributes.description: Numeric level in the territory hierarchy (e.g., 1=National, 2=Regional, 3=District, 4=Local). Used for rollup reporting and organizational structure.

attributes.name: territory_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the sales territory (e.g., 'Northeast Region', 'California Metro', 'EMEA South').

attributes.name: territory_type
attributes.description: Classification of the territory segmentation strategy: geographic (region-based), account-based (customer segments), product-based (product lines), channel-based (retail/wholesale/online), hybrid (combination), or strategic (key accounts).

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: Primary time zone for this sales territory (e.g., America/New_York, America/Los_Angeles, Europe/London). Used for scheduling and reporting.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who created this sales territory record.

products.name: ship_from_store_node
products.description: Master record designating a store location as a Ship-from-Store (SFS), dark store, or MFC fulfillment node within the omnichannel network. Captures node ID, store location reference, node type, daily fulfillment capacity (orders/day), active picking zones within the store, assigned carrier accounts, same-day/next-day cutoff times, geographic service radius, supported delivery SLAs, and node activation status. This is the SSOT for store-as-fulfillment-node configuration consumed by OMS and fulfillment domains. The fulfillment domain owns execution (pick/pack/ship); this product owns the node capability and capacity definition.
products.reference: SFS Node / Ship-from-Store Node / Dark Store

attributes.name: ship_from_store_node_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the ship-from-store fulfillment node. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.carrier. Business justification: SFS nodes operate under carrier contracts tracked at the carrier level. carrier_account_number is a denormalized carrier reference. A direct FK to carrier enables contract management, negotiated rate

attributes.name: carrier_service_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.carrier_service. Business justification: SFS nodes are configured with a primary carrier service driving label generation, rate shopping, and SLA commitments. primary_carrier_code is a denormalized text reference to carrier_service. Normaliz

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.dc_facility. Business justification: Each ship-from-store node is replenished by and returns excess inventory to a designated DC. OMS and WMS systems require this link to route replenishment orders, manage returns-to-DC workflows, and re

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.fulfillment_node. Business justification: SFS node operational governance: a ship-from-store node IS a fulfillment node operationally. Order routing, WMS integration, and SFS capacity planning all require knowing which fulfillment_node govern

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical store location that serves as this fulfillment node. Links to the store master record.

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_offer. Business justification: Omnichannel promotional offers are node-specific—BOPIS promotions, same-day delivery discounts, and curbside pickup incentives are tied to fulfillment node capabilities. E-commerce and store operation

attributes.name: replenishment_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.replenishment_plan. Business justification: Omnichannel campaigns drive ship-from-store orders; fulfillment nodes track campaign-attributed order volume for capacity planning and marketing attribution. E-commerce operations require campaign lin

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date when this fulfillment node was first activated and began accepting orders for fulfillment.

attributes.name: average_pack_time_minutes
attributes.description: Average time in minutes required to pack a standard order at this fulfillment node. Used for capacity planning and throughput estimation.

attributes.name: average_pick_time_minutes
attributes.description: Average time in minutes required to pick a standard order at this fulfillment node. Used for capacity planning and Service Level Agreement (SLA) estimation.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary operational contact for this fulfillment node. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary operational contact or fulfillment manager for this node. Business-confidential organizational contact information.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary operational contact for this fulfillment node. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164 International Phone Number Standard

attributes.name: cost_per_order
attributes.description: Average operational cost in local currency to fulfill one order from this node, including labor, packaging, and overhead. Used for profitability analysis and routing optimization.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fulfillment node record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: daily_capacity_orders
attributes.description: Maximum number of orders this fulfillment node can process per day, based on staffing, space, and operational constraints. Used by OMS for capacity-based order routing.

attributes.name: daily_capacity_units
attributes.description: Maximum number of individual units (SKUs) this fulfillment node can pick, pack, and ship per day. Complements order capacity for more granular planning.

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date when this fulfillment node was deactivated or decommissioned. Null for currently active nodes.

attributes.name: inventory_sync_frequency_minutes
attributes.description: Frequency in minutes at which inventory positions at this fulfillment node are synchronized with the central inventory system. Lower values enable more accurate real-time inventory visibility.

attributes.name: next_day_cutoff_time
attributes.description: Local time cutoff (HH:MM format) by which orders must be placed to qualify for next-day delivery from this node. Null if next-day delivery is not supported.

attributes.name: node_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for this fulfillment node, used in Order Management System (OMS) and Warehouse Management System (WMS) integrations.

attributes.name: node_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the fulfillment node, typically matching the store name or including a fulfillment designation (e.g., 'Downtown Store - SFS Node').

attributes.name: node_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fulfillment node: ship_from_store (SFS - regular store with fulfillment capability), dark_store (fulfillment-only location closed to customers), micro_fulfillment_center (MFC - automated compact fulfillment facility), or hybrid (combination model).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special instructions, or configuration details specific to this fulfillment node. Used for documentation and knowledge transfer.

attributes.name: oms_integration_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fulfillment node is integrated with the Order Management System (OMS) for automated order routing and status updates. True if OMS integration is active; false otherwise.

attributes.name: operating_hours
attributes.description: Standard operating hours for fulfillment operations at this node, typically in format 'Mon-Fri: 08:00-20:00, Sat-Sun: 09:00-18:00'. Used for capacity planning and order routing.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the fulfillment node. Active nodes accept orders; inactive nodes are temporarily offline; suspended nodes are under review; testing nodes are in pilot phase; decommissioned nodes are permanently closed.

attributes.name: picking_zone_count
attributes.description: Number of active picking zones configured within this fulfillment node. Zones organize inventory by category or location to optimize picking efficiency.

attributes.name: picking_zone_identifiers
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of picking zone codes or identifiers active in this fulfillment node (e.g., 'ZONE-A,ZONE-B,ZONE-C'). Used for WMS integration and picker assignment.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric priority rank for this fulfillment node in the order routing algorithm. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used when multiple nodes can fulfill an order.

attributes.name: same_day_cutoff_time
attributes.description: Local time cutoff (HH:MM format) by which orders must be placed to qualify for same-day delivery from this node. Null if same-day delivery is not supported.

attributes.name: service_postal_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of postal codes or postal code prefixes this fulfillment node serves. Used for zone-based order routing when radius-based routing is insufficient.

attributes.name: service_radius_km
attributes.description: Geographic service radius in kilometers from this fulfillment node. Orders within this radius are eligible for fulfillment from this node. Used by OMS for proximity-based routing.

attributes.name: supports_bopis
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supports Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS)
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fulfillment node supports Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS) service. True if BOPIS is available; false otherwise.

tag_set.value: Supports Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS)

attributes.name: supports_curbside_pickup
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fulfillment node offers curbside pickup service where customers can collect orders without entering the store. True if curbside pickup is available; false otherwise.

attributes.name: supports_next_day_delivery
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fulfillment node offers next-day delivery service. True if next-day delivery is available; false otherwise.

attributes.name: supports_same_day_delivery
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fulfillment node offers same-day delivery service. True if same-day delivery is available; false otherwise.

attributes.name: timezone
attributes.description: IANA timezone identifier for this fulfillment node (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London'). Used to interpret cutoff times and operating hours in local time.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified this fulfillment node record. Audit trail for accountability and compliance.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fulfillment node record was last modified. Audit trail for change tracking and data governance.

attributes.name: wms_integration_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fulfillment node is integrated with the Warehouse Management System (WMS) for automated pick/pack/ship workflows. True if WMS integration is active; false if manual processes are used.

products.name: region
products.description: Master reference table for region. Referenced by region_id.

attributes.name: region_id
attributes.description: Primary key for region

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.dc_facility. Business justification: Regional distribution planning assigns a primary DC to each region for inbound logistics routing, regional P&L cost allocation, and disaster-recovery rerouting. Retail supply chain directors expect re

attributes.name: parent_region_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing foreign key to the parent region in the geographic hierarchy (e.g., a sub-region rolls up to a macro-region). Null for top-level regions.

attributes.name: area_sq_km
attributes.description: Total geographic area of the region expressed in square kilometres. Used for store density analysis, market penetration calculations, and territory planning.

attributes.name: climate_zone
attributes.description: Köppen-Geiger climate classification zone for the region. Influences seasonal merchandise planning, HVAC standards for stores, and cold-chain logistics requirements.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short, externally-known alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies the region across operational systems (e.g., 'NE', 'APAC-SOUTH'). Used in reporting, store master data, and cross-system integration.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the primary country this region belongs to (e.g., 'GBR', 'USA', 'DEU'). Used for regulatory, tax, and currency alignment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this region record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SCD-2 history management. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the primary trading currency used in this region (e.g., 'GBP', 'USD', 'EUR'). Drives pricing, P&L reporting, and financial consolidation.

attributes.name: data_privacy_framework
attributes.description: Primary data privacy regulatory framework applicable to customer data collected in this region (e.g., GDPR for EU, CCPA for California, PDPA for Thailand). Drives consent management and data retention policies.

attributes.name: ecommerce_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the e-commerce platform is active and accepting orders for delivery or collection within this region. Drives digital marketing spend allocation and last-mile logistics planning.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this region definition ceased to be operationally effective. Null for currently active records. Supports SCD-2 history and GDPR audit requirements.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this region definition became operationally effective. Supports SCD-2 history tracking and enables point-in-time analysis of regional boundaries and assignments.

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: Region identifier as used in external partner systems, government statistical classifications (e.g., NUTS code in Europe, FIPS code in the USA), or third-party data providers. Enables cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: franchise_model
attributes.description: Indicates whether stores in this region operate under a franchise model rather than direct corporate ownership. Affects P&L consolidation, compliance obligations, and operational reporting scope.

attributes.name: gdp_per_capita_usd
attributes.description: Gross Domestic Product (GDP) per capita for the region expressed in USD, sourced from national statistics or IMF data. Used as a proxy for consumer purchasing power in assortment and pricing strategy.

attributes.name: gdp_reference_year
attributes.description: The calendar year to which the GDP per capita figure refers, enabling users to assess data currency.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric depth of this region within the geographic hierarchy. Level 1 is the top (e.g., global zone), increasing integers represent finer granularity (e.g., country, macro-region, sub-region, district).

attributes.name: hierarchy_path
attributes.description: Materialised slash-delimited path of region codes from root to this node (e.g., 'GLOBAL/EMEA/UK/NORTH'). Enables efficient subtree queries without recursive CTEs.

attributes.name: hq_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the street address for the region's administrative headquarters office. Used for official correspondence, regulatory filings, and field operations coordination.

attributes.name: hq_city
attributes.description: City in which the region's administrative headquarters is located. Used for correspondence, regulatory filings, and geographic reporting.

attributes.name: hq_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country in which the region's administrative headquarters is located. May differ from the region's operational country in cross-border management structures.

attributes.name: hq_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the region's administrative headquarters. Used for correspondence, tax jurisdiction mapping, and logistics routing.

attributes.name: is_current
attributes.description: SCD-2 indicator that is True for the currently active version of the region record and False for superseded historical versions. Simplifies current-state queries without date-range filtering.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: IETF BCP 47 language tag representing the primary language used in this region for store communications, signage, and customer-facing content (e.g., 'en-GB', 'fr-FR', 'de-DE').

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Decimal latitude of the geographic centroid of the region in WGS-84 coordinate system. Used for mapping, proximity analysis, and logistics optimisation.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Decimal longitude of the geographic centroid of the region in WGS-84 coordinate system. Used for mapping, proximity analysis, and logistics optimisation.

attributes.name: manager
attributes.description: Full name of the senior retail operations manager accountable for this region. Used for escalation routing, performance review, and organisational reporting. Classified confidential as it identifies an internal employee in a named role.

attributes.name: manager_email
attributes.description: Corporate email address of the region manager. Used for automated alerts, escalation workflows, and operational communications. Classified as confidential PII.

attributes.name: market_maturity
attributes.description: Assessment of the retail market development stage within the region. Drives investment strategy, promotional intensity, and format mix decisions (e.g., emerging markets favour discount formats).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full human-readable name of the region as used in business reporting and store operations (e.g., 'North-East', 'Pacific Rim'). Displayed in dashboards, planograms, and territory management tools.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, boundary change explanations, or special instructions relevant to this region. Intended for internal use by the store operations and data governance teams.

attributes.name: omnichannel_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether stores in this region are enabled for omnichannel fulfilment capabilities such as click-and-collect (BOPIS), ship-from-store (SFS), and same-day delivery. True means at least one omnichannel service is live.

attributes.name: population
attributes.description: Estimated total resident population within the region boundary. Sourced from national census or third-party demographic data. Used for market sizing, store count planning, and catchment analysis.

attributes.name: population_reference_year
attributes.description: The calendar year to which the population figure refers, enabling users to assess data currency and apply appropriate growth adjustments.

attributes.name: region_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the region record. 'active' means the region is in use for store assignment and reporting; 'inactive' means it has been decommissioned; 'pending' means it is being set up; 'archived' means it is retained for historical reference only.

attributes.name: region_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the region's primary business purpose. 'operational' covers day-to-day store management; 'sales' covers revenue territory; 'franchise' covers franchisee groupings; 'distribution' covers supply-chain zones; 'compliance' covers regulatory jurisdictions.

attributes.name: regulatory_zone
attributes.description: Identifier for the regulatory or compliance zone governing retail operations in this region (e.g., EU Single Market, US Federal, APAC Free Trade Zone). Determines applicable labour, food safety, and consumer protection regulations.

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated display name for the region used in space-constrained UI elements, POS terminal screens, and printed reports (e.g., 'NE Region', 'SW').

attributes.name: shrink_rate
attributes.description: Retail shrinkage rate for the region expressed as a percentage of net sales, encompassing theft, administrative error, and supplier fraud. Used for loss-prevention benchmarking and security resource allocation.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the upstream operational system from which this region record was sourced (e.g., the retail merchandising system, the store master data system). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: sss_index
attributes.description: Same-Store Sales (SSS) index for the region, representing the ratio of current-period comparable store sales to the prior-period baseline. A value above 1.0 indicates positive comp sales growth. Used for regional performance benchmarking.

attributes.name: sss_reference_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (e.g., 'FY2023-Q2') used as the baseline for the SSS index calculation. Ensures consistent interpretation of the SSS index across reporting cycles.

attributes.name: store_count
attributes.description: Number of active retail locations (hypermarkets, department stores, discount outlets, dark stores, MFCs) currently assigned to this region. Maintained as a denormalised reference figure; authoritative count is derived from the store master.

attributes.name: target_store_count
attributes.description: Planned number of stores to be operating within this region as per the current strategic expansion plan. Used for gap analysis and capital expenditure planning.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Official tax authority jurisdiction code for the region (e.g., state FIPS code in the USA, HMRC region code in the UK). Used for tax filing, audit, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: tier
attributes.description: Strategic importance tier assigned to the region, used to prioritise capital investment, promotional spend, and field support resources. Tier 1 represents highest-priority markets.

attributes.name: timezone
attributes.description: IANA timezone identifier for the region's primary operating timezone (e.g., 'Europe/London', 'America/New_York'). Used for scheduling, trading-hour calculations, and timestamp normalisation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this region record in the data platform. Used for incremental load detection, audit trail, and change data capture (CDC) processing. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: urbanisation_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of the region's population living in urban areas. Influences store format selection (hypermarket vs convenience), omnichannel investment, and last-mile delivery feasibility.

attributes.name: vat_rate
attributes.description: Standard Value Added Tax (VAT) or equivalent sales tax rate applicable in this region, expressed as a percentage. Used for price display, financial reporting, and tax remittance calculations.

domains.name: pricing
domains.description: SSOT for all pricing strategies including EDLP (Everyday Low Price), Hi-Lo pricing, competitive pricing, markdowns, ASP (Average Selling Price), AUR (Average Unit Retail), dynamic pricing rules, price zones, and cost-plus margins. Tracks GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment), price change audit trails, and markdown optimization. Integrates with Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) for enterprise-wide pricing governance.

products.name: price_list
products.description: Master record defining named price lists (e.g., EDLP base, Hi-Lo promotional, e-commerce, club member) with effective date ranges, currency, applicable channel, and price zone scope. Serves as the top-level pricing container from which individual SKU prices are derived. Each price list represents a distinct pricing context used in price resolution at POS and e-commerce checkout.

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the price list record. Primary key for the pricing.price_list data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.location. Business justification: Price lists are managed by merchandising cost centers for budget tracking and P&L accountability. Retail business process: departmental pricing authority and expense allocation for pricing strategy ex

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_strategy. Business justification: Price lists implement a pricing strategy (e.g., EDLP base list, Hi-Lo promotional list). Adding price_strategy_id FK links list to strategy. Removes pricing_strategy STRING column as redundant.

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.loyalty_program. Business justification: Price lists are frequently program-specific (e.g., 'Rewards Plus Member Pricing', 'Coalition Partner Pricing'). Existing loyalty_tier_code is insufficient for program-level assignment. Supports progra

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval state of the price list within the retail merchandising system's pricing governance process. PENDING = submitted for approval; APPROVED = authorized for activation; REJECTED = returned for revision; UNDER_REVIEW = in active review by pricing committee. Price lists must be APPROVED before transitioning to ACTIVE status.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); ISO 9001 Quality Management; NRF Pricing Governance

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the pricing manager or director who approved this price list for activation. Supports audit trail requirements for pricing governance and SOX compliance. Sourced from the retail merchandising system workflow approval records.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); ISO 27001 Information Security; FASB SOX Compliance

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the price list was formally approved by the pricing authority in the retail merchandising system of the price change audit trail required for pricing governance and regulatory compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606; ISO 27001

attributes.name: base_margin_pct
attributes.description: Target gross margin percentage applied as the baseline for cost-plus pricing calculations within this price list. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 35.00 = 35%). Used in GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) analysis and OTB (Open to Buy) planning. Confidential as it reveals internal margin strategy.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606; NRF GMROI Standards

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The retail channel(s) to which this price list applies. IN_STORE = physical POS; ECOMMERCE = the e-commerce platform digital storefront; MOBILE = mobile app; BOPIS = Buy Online Pick Up In Store; CATALOG = print/digital catalog; ALL = omnichannel. Drives channel-specific price resolution logic.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud; SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR); NRF Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the price list within the retail merchandising system Price Management (RPM) and SAP S/4HANA SD module. Used as the business key in EDI transactions, POS price resolution, and e-commerce checkout. Examples: EDLP_BASE, HILO_PROMO_Q4, ECOM_MEMBER.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); GS1 Global Data Standards

attributes.name: competitive_index
attributes.description: Ratio of this price list's average price level relative to key competitors, expressed as an index (e.g., 100.00 = price parity; 95.00 = 5% below market; 105.00 = 5% above market). Used in competitive pricing strategy analysis and EDLP positioning validation.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FTC Pricing Transparency; NRF Competitive Intelligence Standards

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country in which this price list is applicable (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR). Supports international retail operations and country-specific pricing compliance requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GS1 Global Standards; FTC Consumer Protection

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this price list record was first created in the system of record (the retail merchandising system or the customer master data system). Part of the mandatory audit trail for pricing governance and SOX compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); ISO 27001; FASB SOX Compliance

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all prices within this price list are denominated (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP, EUR). Ensures correct monetary interpretation at POS and in financial reporting under FASB ASC 606.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; FASB ASC 606; FTC Pricing Transparency

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Merchandise department code within the retail hierarchy to which this price list is scoped, as defined in the retail merchandising system Merchandising System (ORMS). Enables department-level pricing governance and category management alignment.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); NRF Category Management Standards

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the price list's purpose, scope, and intended use. Captures the pricing strategy rationale (e.g., EDLP everyday low price baseline, Hi-Lo promotional cadence, competitive response pricing).

attributes.name: division_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the retail division or business unit (e.g., GROCERY, APPAREL, ELECTRONICS, HOUSEHOLD) to which this price list is scoped. Enables division-specific pricing governance and GMROI tracking by merchandise division.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); SAP S/4HANA CO; NRF Merchandise Hierarchy Standards

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date after which this price list is no longer active for price resolution. Nullable for open-ended price lists (e.g., permanent EDLP base). When populated, the price list expires at end of this date. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The calendar date from which this price list becomes active and eligible for price resolution at POS and e-commerce checkout. Aligns with the retail merchandising system effective dating and SAP S/4HANA SD pricing condition validity. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: The price list identifier as it exists in the originating source system (e.g., the retail merchandising system price list ID, SAP SD pricing condition group). Enables cross-system reconciliation and EDI integration with supplier systems.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM; GS1 EDI Standards; Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM)

attributes.name: is_default
attributes.description: Indicates whether this price list serves as the default fallback price list when no other price list matches the resolution criteria at POS or e-commerce checkout. Only one price list per channel and price zone should be flagged as default. True = default; False = non-default.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing

attributes.name: is_taxable
attributes.description: Indicates whether prices in this price list are tax-inclusive (True) or tax-exclusive (False). Tax-inclusive pricing is common in international markets; tax-exclusive is standard in US retail. Drives tax calculation logic at POS and e-commerce checkout.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FTC Pricing Transparency; FDA Food Labeling (for grocery)

attributes.name: list_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pricing strategy this list represents. EDLP = Everyday Low Price stable baseline; HI_LO = High-Low promotional cadence; PROMOTIONAL = time-limited campaign price; CLEARANCE = markdown/end-of-life pricing; CLUB_MEMBER = loyalty or membership tier pricing; COMPETITIVE = market-response pricing. Drives price resolution logic at POS and e-commerce checkout. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EDLP|HI_LO|PROMOTIONAL|CLEARANCE|CLUB_MEMBER|COMPETITIVE|COST_PLUS|DYNAMIC — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Pricing Standards

attributes.name: loyalty_tier_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the customer loyalty tier (e.g., GOLD, PLATINUM, CLUB_MEMBER) for which this price list is exclusively applicable. Null for price lists that apply to all customers regardless of loyalty status. Links to the CRM loyalty program configuration for member-specific pricing.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud; Informatica MDM; NRF Loyalty Program Standards

attributes.name: markdown_pct
attributes.description: Default markdown percentage applied to AUR (Average Unit Retail) for clearance or promotional price lists. Expressed as a percentage reduction from the regular retail price (e.g., 20.00 = 20% off). Drives markdown optimization and end-of-season clearance planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Markdown Optimization Standards

attributes.name: max_selling_price
attributes.description: Ceiling price above which no SKU within this price list may be sold, ensuring competitive positioning and consumer protection compliance. Expressed in the price list's currency. Used in dynamic pricing guardrails to prevent price gouging.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FTC Consumer Protection; CPSC Pricing Standards

attributes.name: min_selling_price
attributes.description: Floor price below which no SKU within this price list may be sold, protecting minimum margin thresholds and preventing below-cost selling. Enforced at POS and e-commerce checkout via the retail merchandising system price guardrails. Expressed in the price list's currency.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FTC Pricing Transparency; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the price list as displayed in the retail merchandising system and merchandising systems. Examples: 'EDLP Base Price List', 'Hi-Lo Promotional Q4 2024', 'E-Commerce Club Member Pricing'.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Retail Data Standards

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next pricing review of this price list by the category management or pricing team. Used to trigger review workflows in the retail merchandising system and ensure timely price updates aligned with market conditions and promotional calendars.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional business context, pricing committee decisions, exceptions, or operational notes associated with this price list. Captured in the retail merchandising system and surfaced for pricing analysts and category managers.

attributes.name: price_list_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the price list within the retail merchandising system = under construction, not yet approved; ACTIVE = currently in use for price resolution; SUSPENDED = temporarily deactivated; EXPIRED = past effective end date; ARCHIVED = retired and no longer available for assignment.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric rank determining the order of precedence when multiple price lists are applicable to a single SKU at POS or e-commerce checkout. Lower values indicate higher priority (e.g., 1 = highest priority). Critical for price resolution logic in omnichannel environments where EDLP, promotional, and member prices may overlap.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR)

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled cadence at which this price list is reviewed and potentially updated by the pricing team. Drives pricing governance workflows in the retail merchandising system is typical for dynamic pricing; WEEKLY for Hi-Lo promotional; QUARTERLY for EDLP base reviews. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DAILY|WEEKLY|BIWEEKLY|MONTHLY|QUARTERLY|ANNUALLY|AD_HOC — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Pricing Governance Standards

attributes.name: rounding_rule
attributes.description: Rule applied to computed prices within this price list to produce consumer-facing shelf prices. NEAREST_CENT = standard rounding; ROUND_UP = always round up; ROUND_DOWN = always round down; CHARM_PRICING = round to nearest .99 or .95 (psychological pricing); NONE = no rounding applied. Configured in the retail merchandising system price calculation engine.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Pricing Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this price list record originated. RPM = the retail merchandising system Price Management; SAP_SD = SAP S/4HANA Sales & Distribution; SFCC = the e-commerce platform; ORMS = the retail merchandising system Merchandising System; MANUAL = manually created. Supports data lineage and MDM reconciliation.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM; Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this price list record was most recently modified. Tracks the last change event for audit trail purposes and supports incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); ISO 27001; Informatica MDM

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Monotonically increasing version counter tracking revisions to this price list. Incremented each time the price list is modified and re-approved. Supports price change audit trail requirements and enables rollback to prior pricing versions.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); ISO 27001 Audit Trail; FASB SOX Compliance

products.name: price_zone
products.description: Defines geographic or store-cluster pricing zones used to differentiate retail prices by market, region, or competitive environment. Each zone groups stores or fulfillment nodes sharing the same pricing strategy. Includes zone code, name, type (regional, competitive, urban/rural), effective dates, and zone-to-store/node membership assignments with assignment effective dates, expiry dates, assignment reasons, override flags, and historical tracking of zone reassignments.

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a price zone record in the the retail merchandising system Price Management (RPM) system. Serves as the primary key for all zone-level pricing governance and store cluster assignments.

attributes.name: parent_zone_price_zone_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to a parent price zone in a zone hierarchy. Enables multi-tier zone structures (e.g., a national zone containing regional sub-zones). Null for top-level zones with no parent. Used in the retail merchandising system Price Management (RPM) zone inheritance for pricing rule cascades.

attributes.name: base_price_multiplier
attributes.description: Zone-level multiplier applied to the national base price to derive the zone-specific retail price. A value of 1.0000 means no adjustment; 0.9500 means a 5% reduction; 1.0500 means a 5% premium. Used in the retail merchandising system Price Management (RPM) zone pricing calculations to support Hi-Lo and EDLP strategies.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: channel_applicability
attributes.description: Defines which retail channels this price zone governs. 'in_store' applies only to physical POS (Point of Sale) transactions; 'ecommerce' applies to the e-commerce platform digital orders; 'omnichannel' applies uniformly across all channels supporting BOPIS and ROPIS (Reserve Online Pick Up In Store); 'wholesale' applies to B2B pricing.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); Salesforce Commerce Cloud; NRF Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: competitive_index
attributes.description: Numeric index (0.00–999.99) representing the relative competitive pricing intensity of this zone compared to the baseline zone (index = 100.00). Values above 100 indicate a more price-competitive market requiring lower AUR (Average Unit Retail). Sourced from competitive intelligence feeds integrated with the retail merchandising system Price Management (RPM).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FTC Pricing Transparency Guidelines

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the primary country of operation for this price zone. Supports multi-country retail operations and regulatory compliance with FTC pricing transparency requirements. Example: 'USA', 'CAN', 'GBR'.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Pricing Transparency

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this price zone record was first created in the Databricks Silver Layer, sourced from the retail merchandising system Price Management (RPM) or the customer master data system. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and GDPR/CCPA data governance requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security; GDPR Article 5; CCPA

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code governing all price points within this zone. Ensures consistent monetary representation across SAP S/4HANA FI/CO and the retail merchandising system Price Management (RPM). Example: 'USD', 'CAD', 'GBP'.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this price zone expires and ceases to govern pricing for assigned stores. Null indicates an open-ended zone with no planned expiry. Used in zone reassignment workflows and markdown audit trails.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this price zone becomes active and its pricing rules begin governing assigned stores or fulfillment nodes. Used in Open-to-Buy (OTB) planning and markdown optimization scheduling.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_count
attributes.description: Current number of e-commerce fulfillment nodes (dark stores, micro-fulfillment centers, distribution centers) assigned to this price zone. Supports omnichannel pricing governance for BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store) and Ship-from-Store (SFS) operations.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); Salesforce Commerce Cloud
