attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FTC Pricing Transparency Guidelines; NRF Competitive Pricing Standards

attributes.name: cost_plus_margin_pct
attributes.description: The gross margin percentage applied above COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) when the rule_type is 'cost_plus_floor'. Defines the minimum acceptable margin to protect GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) targets. Example: 35.0000 = 35% margin above cost. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA CO (Controlling) module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA (CO Module); Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606; NRF GMROI Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this pricing rule record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit trail creation marker for data lineage, SOX compliance, and the retail merchandising system change management. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); SOX Internal Controls; ISO 27001 Information Security; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary values (min_price, max_price, adjustment_value) for this rule are denominated. Example: 'USD', 'CAD', 'GBP'. Supports multi-currency retail operations across international markets.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the pricing rule's business purpose, scope, and rationale. Authored by the pricing analyst or category manager in the retail merchandising system context for audit reviews, merchant onboarding, and pricing governance documentation.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Pricing Governance Standards

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this pricing rule expires and ceases execution. Null indicates an open-ended rule with no planned expiry (common for EDLP lock rules). the retail merchandising system automatically transitions rule_status to 'expired' when this date is passed. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this pricing rule becomes active and eligible for execution. Used by the retail merchandising system's scheduling engine to activate rules at the correct time. Aligns with OTB (Open to Buy) planning cycles and promotional calendar. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: execution_mode
attributes.description: Defines how the pricing rule is triggered and applied. 'manual' = merchant-initiated via the retail merchandising system; 'batch' = scheduled overnight or periodic run via SAP S/4HANA SD; 'real_time' = instantaneous algorithmic trigger at POS or checkout; 'near_real_time' = sub-minute latency via the retail analytics platform demand signals.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR)

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this pricing rule record was most recently modified. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer, and audit trail maintenance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); ISO 27001 Information Security; GDPR Article 5; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: loyalty_exclusive
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pricing rule applies exclusively to loyalty program members. True = price adjustment is only available to enrolled loyalty customers (e.g., member-only pricing); False = rule applies to all customers regardless of loyalty status. Integrates with CRM (Customer Relationship Management) loyalty program data.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); Salesforce Commerce Cloud; GDPR Article 6 (Lawful Basis); CCPA

attributes.name: markdown_depth_pct
attributes.description: The maximum allowable markdown percentage from the AUR (Average Unit Retail) or original retail price for markdown and clearance rules. Prevents excessive margin erosion. Example: 40.0000 = maximum 40% markdown. Used in markdown optimization workflows within the retail merchandising system and Blue Yonder Demand Planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); Blue Yonder Demand Planning; NRF Markdown Optimization Standards; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: max_price
attributes.description: The absolute ceiling price above which this rule must not raise the selling price. Prevents price gouging and ensures compliance with FTC consumer protection standards. Used in competitive match ceiling rules to cap price increases. Expressed in the operating currency (USD). Corresponds to the 'price ceiling' concept in the retail merchandising system
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FTC Consumer Protection Act; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: min_price
attributes.description: The absolute floor price below which this rule must not reduce the selling price, regardless of adjustment logic. Protects against below-cost selling and ensures compliance with FTC pricing transparency and predatory pricing regulations. Expressed in the operating currency (USD). Corresponds to the 'price floor' concept in the retail merchandising system
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FTC Pricing Transparency Guidelines; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the pricing rule, used by merchants and pricing analysts to identify the rule in the retail merchandising system dashboards and reporting. Example: 'Grocery EDLP Floor — Q1 2025', 'Electronics Hi-Lo Weekend Swing'.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); National Retail Federation (NRF)

attributes.name: override_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a manual price override for this rule requires supervisory approval before taking effect. True = approval workflow triggered in the retail merchandising system; False = override can be applied immediately by authorized users. Relevant only when override_permitted = True.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); ISO 27001 Information Security; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: override_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether a merchant or store manager is permitted to manually override this pricing rule at the POS (Point of Sale) or in the retail merchandising system = override allowed with appropriate role-based authorization; False = rule is locked and cannot be overridden (common for EDLP lock and regulatory compliance rules).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FTC Pricing Transparency Guidelines; ISO 27001 Access Control

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Integer ranking that determines execution order when multiple pricing rules apply to the same SKU simultaneously. Lower numeric value = higher priority (1 = highest). Used by the retail merchandising system's rule conflict resolution engine to determine which rule wins in overlapping scenarios. Critical for Hi-Lo vs EDLP conflict resolution.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Pricing Governance Standards

attributes.name: rounding_rule
attributes.description: Specifies the price rounding convention applied after the adjustment calculation. 'charm_99' rounds to the nearest X.99 (psychological pricing); 'charm_95' rounds to X.95; 'nearest_cent' rounds to two decimal places; 'nearest_dollar' rounds to whole dollar; 'custom' uses a merchant-defined rounding table in the retail merchandising system
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Pricing Best Practices

attributes.name: rule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the pricing rule within the retail merchandising system whether the rule is eligible for execution in batch or real-time pricing engines. 'draft' = under configuration; 'active' = live and enforced; 'inactive' = disabled but retained; 'suspended' = temporarily halted; 'expired' = past effective end date.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: rule_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the pricing rule's business logic. Defines the algorithmic or policy basis for price determination. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cost_plus_floor|competitive_match_ceiling|edlp_lock|hilo_swing_limit|rounding|dynamic_trigger|demand_based|inventory_based|time_of_day|markdown — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Pricing Standards

attributes.name: sell_through_target_pct
attributes.description: The target sell-through rate (percentage of inventory sold) that this pricing rule is designed to achieve. Used in inventory-based and markdown rules to drive clearance of dead stock. Example: 85.0000 = target 85% sell-through. Aligns with Blue Yonder Demand Planning replenishment signals and ORMS inventory management.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); Blue Yonder Demand Planning; NRF Inventory Management Standards

attributes.name: sku_scope
attributes.description: Defines the breadth of SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) applicability for this pricing rule. 'all_skus' applies enterprise-wide; 'category' scopes to a merchandise category; 'department' scopes to a department; 'specific_sku' targets individual SKUs; 'price_zone' applies to a geographic price zone. Aligns with the retail merchandising system Merchandising System (ORMS) hierarchy.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); GS1 Global Product Classification; Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM)

attributes.name: source_system_rule_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this pricing rule in the originating operational system of record (the retail merchandising system Price Management RPM). Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the RPM source system for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); Informatica MDM; ISO 27001 Data Lineage

attributes.name: stackable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pricing rule can be combined (stacked) with other active pricing rules or promotions for the same SKU. True = rule can stack with other discounts/promotions; False = rule is exclusive and prevents other rules from applying simultaneously. Critical for promotion conflict management in the retail merchandising system
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Promotions Management Standards

attributes.name: time_of_day_end
attributes.description: The daily end time (HH:MM in 24-hour format) at which this rule ceases to be active for intraday pricing windows. Paired with time_of_day_start to define the active window. Null if the rule applies all day.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR)

attributes.name: time_of_day_start
attributes.description: The daily start time (HH:MM in 24-hour format) from which this rule is active, applicable when trigger_type = 'time_based' or rule_type = 'time_of_day'. Enables intraday dynamic pricing (e.g., happy hour markdowns, peak-hour surcharges). Null if the rule applies all day.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR)

attributes.name: trigger_threshold_value
attributes.description: The numeric threshold value that must be breached to activate the trigger condition. Interpretation depends on trigger_type: for 'inventory_threshold' this is the WOS (Weeks of Supply) or unit count; for 'demand_surge' this is the demand index multiplier; for 'sell_through_rate' this is the percentage. Sourced from Blue Yonder Demand Planning signals.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning; Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: trigger_type
attributes.description: The business condition or event that activates this pricing rule. Defines what must occur for the rule to fire. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: inventory_threshold|demand_surge|competitor_undercut|time_based|weather|event_driven|scheduled|manual_override|sell_through_rate — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); Blue Yonder Demand Planning; SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the coupon record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.description: Total number of digital coupon codes issued via email, app, or SMS. Null for paper-only coupons.

attributes.name: digital_wallet_enabled_flag

attributes.name: discount_type

attributes.name: eligible_channel

attributes.name: eligible_product_scope

attributes.name: exclusion_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of product SKUs, categories, or brands explicitly excluded from coupon eligibility. Null if no exclusions apply.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Last date on which the coupon can be redeemed. After this date, the coupon is no longer valid.

attributes.name: face_value
attributes.description: Nominal discount value of the coupon. For fixed_amount coupons, this is the dollar discount. For percentage coupons, this is the percentage (e.g., 15.00 for 15% off). For BOGO, may represent the value of the free item.

attributes.name: geographic_restriction

attributes.name: issue_channel
attributes.description: Distribution channel through which the coupon was issued to customers. attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the coupon was first made available to customers. Marks the start of the coupons validity window.

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Entity responsible for funding and issuing the coupon. Retailer indicates store-funded, manufacturer indicates vendor-funded, vendor indicates supplier co-op, third_party indicates external promotion partner.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified the coupon record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the coupon record was last updated.

attributes.name: maximum_discount_amount
attributes.description: Cap on the total discount that can be applied by this coupon, regardless of cart value. Null if no cap applies. Relevant for percentage-based coupons.

attributes.name: minimum_purchase_amount
attributes.description: Minimum transaction subtotal required to qualify for coupon redemption. Null if no minimum applies.

attributes.name: print_quantity
attributes.description: Total number of physical paper coupons printed for distribution. Null for digital-only coupons.

attributes.name: redemption_limit_per_customer
attributes.description: Maximum number of times a single customer can redeem this coupon. Null or 0 indicates unlimited redemptions per customer.

attributes.name: single_use_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the coupon can only be used once (True) or multiple times (False) by the same customer, subject to redemption_limit_per_customer.

attributes.name: stackable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this coupon can be combined with other coupons or promotions in a single transaction (True) or must be used alone (False).

attributes.name: terms_and_conditions
attributes.description: Full legal text of coupon usage terms, restrictions, and disclaimers. Required for regulatory compliance and customer transparency.

attributes.name: total_redemption_limit
attributes.description: Maximum total number of redemptions allowed across all customers for this coupon. Null or 0 indicates unlimited total redemptions.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created the coupon record.

products.name: circular_ad
products.description: Master record for a printed or digital weekly/seasonal circular advertisement, including both the circular header and its featured item lines. Header captures circular name, edition number, publication date, effective date range, distribution channel (print, digital, email, app), geographic market coverage, page count, and production status. Item lines capture featured SKU, advertised price, promotional price, page number, position on page, feature type (front page, endcap feature, in-book), ad copy headline, image reference, and loss-leader flag. The circular is a key promotional vehicle in retail that drives planned traffic and is directly linked to campaign offers. Supports circular effectiveness analysis by item and planogram alignment with advertised features.

attributes.name: circular_name
attributes.description: Marketing name or title of the circular advertisement, such as 'Weekly Savings', 'Holiday Spectacular', or 'Back to School Event'.

attributes.name: circular_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the circular advertisement, typically a human-readable code or number used for reference in marketing and merchandising operations.

attributes.name: language_code

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: production_cost_currency_code

attributes.name: production_status

attributes.name: publication_date
attributes.description: Date when the circular advertisement is officially published or released to customers across distribution channels.

attributes.name: target_audience
attributes.description: Primary customer segment or demographic targeted by this circular, such as families, millennials, budget shoppers, or loyalty members. Supports personalized marketing strategies.

attributes.name: theme
attributes.description: Marketing theme or creative concept for the circular, such as 'Summer Savings', 'Holiday Gift Guide', or 'Spring Refresh', used for brand consistency and customer engagement.

attributes.name: vendor_funding_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of vendor co-op funding or promotional allowances applied to this circular, used for cost allocation and vendor settlement.

products.name: rebate
products.description: Master record for a rebate program offered to customers or funded by vendors. Captures rebate name, rebate type (instant rebate, mail-in rebate, vendor-funded rebate), rebate amount or percentage, qualifying purchase conditions, submission deadline, payment method (check, store credit, digital credit), sponsoring vendor, and rebate program status. Supports both consumer-facing rebates and vendor-funded promotional allowances.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the rebate program. Primary key.

attributes.description: Identifier of the parent promotional campaign or event to which this rebate belongs. Null if rebate is standalone.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) - Promotion Hierarchy

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_offer. Business justification: A rebate in retail is a specific deal mechanic (e.g., 'buy X, get $Y back') that is defined at the offer level, not just the campaign level. Linking rebate to promo_offer allows precise tracking of wh

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.region. Business justification: Rebate geographic eligibility is a regulatory and operational requirement in retail — rebates are restricted by state/region due to legal constraints or vendor agreements. geographic_eligibility is a

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Rebates apply to specific qualifying products. Claim validation verifies purchased SKU matches rebate terms. Vendor chargeback reconciliation requires SKU-level tracking. Inventory planning adjusts fo

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.profile. Business justification: Rebate claim processing requires tracking which customer submitted each claim for fraud detection, payment fulfillment, and per-customer redemption limit enforcement. Finance and customer service team

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Fixed monetary value of the rebate in the transaction currency. Null if rebate is percentage-based.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval state for the rebate program before it can be activated. Ensures financial and legal review compliance.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the rebate program was approved. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: channel_eligibility
attributes.description: Sales channels where the rebate can be redeemed: all_channels (any touchpoint), pos_only (in-store Point of Sale only), ecommerce_only (online purchases), mobile_app_only (mobile app transactions), or omnichannel (integrated cross-channel).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the rebate program record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the rebate amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: customer_segment_eligibility
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of customer segment codes eligible for the rebate (e.g., loyalty_member, employee, senior, student). Null if available to all customers.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed internal description of the rebate program purpose, target audience, and business objectives. Used for internal planning and reporting.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the rebate program expires and is no longer available for new submissions. Null for open-ended programs.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the rebate program becomes active and eligible for customer redemption.

attributes.name: exclusion_product_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) codes or product categories explicitly excluded from the rebate program.

attributes.name: geographic_eligibility
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of three-letter ISO country codes or region codes where the rebate is valid (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR). Null if available in all operating regions.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the rebate program record was last updated.

attributes.name: marketing_message

attributes.name: maximum_rebate_amount
attributes.description: Cap on the total rebate value that can be claimed per transaction or per customer. Null if no cap applies.

attributes.name: minimum_purchase_amount
attributes.description: Minimum transaction value required to qualify for the rebate. Null if no minimum threshold applies.

attributes.name: minimum_purchase_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum number of qualifying units (Stock Keeping Units) that must be purchased to qualify for the rebate. Null if no quantity threshold applies.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Marketing name of the rebate program displayed to customers and used in promotional materials.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Mechanism by which the rebate value is returned to the customer: check (mailed physical check), store_credit (loyalty account credit), digital_credit (e-wallet or app credit), prepaid_card (branded debit card), bank_transfer (direct deposit), or instant_discount (applied at Point of Sale).
attributes.references: Payment Card Industry Security Standards Council (PCI SSC)

attributes.name: payment_processing_days
attributes.description: Expected number of business days from rebate approval to payment issuance. Used for customer Service Level Agreement (SLA) communication.
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: percentage
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied as rebate (e.g., 10.00 for 10% off). Null if rebate is fixed-amount.

attributes.name: qualifying_product_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) codes, Universal Product Code (UPC) numbers, or product category codes that qualify for the rebate. Null if rebate applies to all products.

attributes.name: rebate_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique business identifier for the rebate program, used in customer communications and vendor agreements.

attributes.name: rebate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the rebate program: draft (being configured), active (live and accepting submissions), paused (temporarily suspended), expired (past end date), cancelled (terminated early), or completed (ended successfully).

attributes.name: rebate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rebate mechanism: instant rebate (applied at Point of Sale), mail-in rebate (customer submits proof of purchase), vendor-funded rebate (supplier-sponsored), digital rebate (online redemption), promotional allowance (trade promotion), or volume rebate (quantity-based incentive).

attributes.name: redemption_limit_per_customer
attributes.description: Maximum number of times a single customer can claim this rebate during the program period. Null if no limit applies.

attributes.name: redemption_limit_per_transaction
attributes.description: Maximum number of rebate instances that can be applied in a single transaction. Null if no limit applies.

attributes.name: requires_proof_of_purchase
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers must submit receipt or purchase documentation to claim the rebate. True for mail-in rebates, false for instant rebates applied at Point of Sale.
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: stackable_with_other_promotions
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rebate can be combined with other promotional offers (coupons, markdowns, Buy One Get One (BOGO) deals) in the same transaction.

attributes.name: submission_deadline_date
attributes.description: Final date by which customers must submit rebate claims for purchases made during the effective period. Typically extends beyond the effective end date for mail-in rebates.
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: terms_and_conditions
attributes.description: Full legal text of the rebate program terms, conditions, restrictions, and disclaimers. Must comply with Federal Trade Commission (FTC) disclosure requirements.

attributes.name: total_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total financial budget allocated for the rebate program. Used for cost control and Return on Investment (ROI) tracking. Null if budget is uncapped.

attributes.name: vendor_funding_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the rebate cost funded by the vendor in co-op promotional agreements (e.g., 75.00 means vendor pays 75%, retailer pays 25%). Null for fully retailer-funded rebates.

products.name: promo_redemption

Serves as the single source of truth for all promotion redemption activity — including coupon redemptions, automatic BOGO applications, threshold discounts, and bundle deals. Critical for promotional ROI calculation, coupon fraud prevention, vendor chargeback evidence, and real-time redemption limit enforcement.

attributes.name: chargeback_amount
attributes.description: The amount claimed from or paid by the vendor for this promotion redemption. May differ from discount_amount due to negotiated funding rates or caps.

attributes.name: chargeback_status
attributes.description: Status of the vendor chargeback claim for vendor-funded promotions. Tracks the lifecycle from pending submission through payment receipt.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this redemption record was first created in the database. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the discount amount. Supports multi-currency operations across international markets.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the discount granted to the customer through this promotion redemption. Expressed in the transaction currency. Critical for promotional ROI calculation and vendor chargeback reconciliation.

attributes.name: discount_type
attributes.description: The category of discount applied. Distinguishes between percentage-based discounts, fixed dollar amounts, buy-one-get-one offers, bundle deals, spend threshold promotions, and shipping incentives.

attributes.name: final_price
attributes.description: The post-discount price after this promotion was applied. May differ from transaction final price if multiple promotions were stacked.

attributes.name: fraud_score

attributes.name: loyalty_points_earned

attributes.name: loyalty_points_redeemed

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: original_price

attributes.name: processing_system

attributes.name: redemption_channel

attributes.name: redemption_limit_type
attributes.description: The scope of redemption limits enforced for this promotion. Indicates whether limits apply per customer, per transaction, per day, or across the entire campaign period.

attributes.name: redemption_mechanism
attributes.description: Method by which the promotion was applied to the transaction. Indicates whether the discount was automatically triggered by system rules, manually entered via coupon code, applied through loyalty program, or activated through other channels. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: automatic_system_triggered|coupon_code_entry|loyalty_auto_apply|cart_rule|manual_cashier_apply|mobile_app_clip|digital_wallet — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: redemption_sequence_number
attributes.description: The sequential count of this redemption within the applicable limit scope. For example, if limit is per_customer, this tracks which redemption number this is for that customer (1st, 2nd, 3rd, etc.).

attributes.name: redemption_status
attributes.description: Validation status of the promotion redemption. Indicates whether the redemption was successfully processed or rejected due to expiration, duplicate use, limit violations, or fraud detection.

attributes.name: redemption_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the promotion was applied to the transaction. Represents the business event time of redemption, distinct from record creation time.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: The specific product SKU to which the promotion was applied. Populated for item-level promotions. Null for transaction-level or basket-level promotions.

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this redemption record in the source operational system. Enables traceability back to the system of record.

attributes.name: stack_sequence
attributes.description: The order in which this promotion was applied within a stacked promotion scenario. Determines calculation precedence when multiple discounts are layered.

attributes.name: validation_error_code
attributes.description: System error code returned when a redemption attempt fails validation. Provides technical detail for troubleshooting invalid redemptions. Null for successful redemptions.

attributes.name: validation_error_message
attributes.description: Human-readable error message explaining why a redemption was rejected. Displayed to customers or cashiers. Null for successful redemptions.

attributes.name: vendor_funded_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotion discount is funded by a vendor/supplier through a trade promotion agreement. True when the cost is charged back to the vendor; false when retailer-funded.

products.name: promo_performance
products.description: Operational record capturing the measured performance of a promotional offer or campaign at the offer-store-week grain. Stores actual units sold, revenue generated, discount dollars given, incremental units vs. baseline, redemption count, sell-through rate, promotional ROI, margin impact, and cannibalization estimate. Written by the retail analytics platform demand signal repository and Blue Yonder systems during and after promotion execution. This is an operational performance record — not an analytics aggregate — used for vendor settlement evidence, markdown planning decisions, and post-promotion review. Supports comparison against promo_forecast for forecast accuracy measurement.

attributes.name: promo_performance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the promotion performance record. Primary key for this operational performance measurement entity.

attributes.name: cluster_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.cluster. Business justification: Cluster-level promotional performance reporting is a key retail analytics use case — merchants evaluate whether a promotion performed consistently across a store cluster. Not derivable from existing p

attributes.name: demand_forecast_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.demand_forecast. Business justification: Post-promotion forecast accuracy review: promo_performance has `forecast_accuracy_percent` which requires knowing the source demand_forecast. Retail merchandising teams compare actual promotional resu

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.department. Business justification: Department-level promotional performance is a fundamental retail metric — category managers track how promotions perform within specific departments (electronics, apparel, grocery). Not derivable from

attributes.name: format_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.format. Business justification: Performance records explicitly measure campaigns against defined KPIs. Weekly performance snapshots calculate specific KPI values (sell-through rate, promotional ROI, incremental units). Merchandising

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.fulfillment_node. Business justification: Retail promotional performance reporting requires node-level granularity (store vs. DC vs. ship-from-store) to measure promotional lift by fulfillment channel. promo_performance already tracks locatio

attributes.name: item_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.assortment_plan. Business justification: Promotional performance directly impacts assortment decisions. Merchandising evaluates which promoted items to continue, expand, or discontinue based on promotional lift, margin impact, and sell-throu

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store location where this promotion performance was measured. Supports store-level promotion analysis.

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list. Business justification: Post-promotion performance analysis requires knowing which price list was active during the measurement period to calculate true margin impact and baseline price comparisons. Retail category managers

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.loyalty_program. Business justification: Standard retail promotional analytics segment performance by loyalty program membership (loyalty vs. non-loyalty lift). promo_performance tracks new_customer_count, repeat_customer_count, unique_custo

attributes.name: promo_calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_calendar. Business justification: Performance is measured over promotional periods defined in the promotional calendar. The promo_performance has performance_week_start_date and performance_week_end_date that align with promotional ca

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Promotional performance can be measured at both campaign level and offer level. While promo_performance already has promo_offer_id (offer-level measurement), adding promo_campaign_id enables direct ca

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific promotional offer or campaign being measured. Links to the promotion master definition.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Performance tracking measures promotional lift by SKU. Required for calculating incremental units, ROI, cannibalization analysis, and feeding promotional forecasts. Unlinked sku column exists but need

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.storefront. Business justification: Promotional performance must be measured at the storefront level for e-commerce channel ROI reporting and storefront-specific campaign optimization. Storefront-level promo performance is a named retai

attributes.name: average_transaction_value
attributes.description: Average basket value for transactions that included this promoted item. Measures promotion impact on overall basket size.

attributes.name: baseline_units
attributes.description: Estimated units that would have sold without the promotion, based on historical trends. Used to calculate incremental lift.

attributes.name: cannibalization_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated units of related non-promoted products that lost sales due to this promotion. Measures negative cross-product impact.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the promoted product was sold. Supports omnichannel promotion performance analysis.

attributes.name: cogs
attributes.description: Total cost of goods sold during the promotion period. Used to calculate gross margin and promotional ROI.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this performance record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this record. Typically matches store local currency.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The operational system that generated or last updated this performance record. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar value of discounts given during the promotion period. Represents the promotional investment at retail price level.

attributes.name: forecast_accuracy_percent
attributes.description: Accuracy of the promotional forecast compared to actual performance. Calculated as 100 minus absolute percentage error. Used to improve future forecasting.

attributes.name: gross_margin
attributes.description: Gross profit generated during the promotion. Calculated as net_revenue minus COGS. Critical for assessing promotion profitability.

attributes.name: gross_margin_percent
attributes.description: Gross margin as a percentage of net revenue. Expressed as a percentage value (e.g., 25.50 for 25.5%). Measures promotion profitability rate.

attributes.name: gross_revenue
attributes.description: Total revenue generated from units sold at regular price before promotional discounts. Denominated in local store currency.

attributes.name: incremental_units
attributes.description: Additional units sold above baseline due to the promotion. Calculated as units_sold minus baseline_units. Key measure of promotion effectiveness.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this performance record was last modified. Audit trail for record changes during adjustments or settlement.

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this performance measurement was calculated and recorded. Represents the business event time for this operational record.

attributes.name: net_revenue
attributes.description: Revenue after promotional discounts. Calculated as gross_revenue minus discount_amount. Actual revenue realized from the promotion.

attributes.name: new_customer_count
attributes.description: Number of customers who purchased this SKU for the first time during the promotion. Measures customer acquisition effectiveness.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing exceptional circumstances, adjustments, or explanations for performance anomalies. Used for post-promotion review and vendor settlement discussions.

attributes.name: out_of_stock_days
attributes.description: Number of days during the promotion period when the SKU was out of stock at this store. Indicates lost sales opportunity.

attributes.name: performance_status
attributes.description: Current status of this performance record. Preliminary during promotion execution, final after close, adjusted if corrections made, settled after vendor payment.

attributes.name: performance_week_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the week for which this promotion performance is measured. Defines the weekly measurement window.

attributes.name: performance_week_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the week for which this promotion performance is measured. Promotion performance is captured at weekly grain for trend analysis.

attributes.name: promotional_roi
attributes.description: Return on investment for the promotion, calculated as incremental gross margin divided by promotional investment. Expressed as ratio (e.g., 2.50 means $2.50 return per $1 invested).

attributes.name: redemption_count
attributes.description: Number of times the promotion was redeemed (coupon scans, digital offer applications, BOGO transactions). Measures customer engagement with the offer.

attributes.name: repeat_customer_count
attributes.description: Number of customers who had previously purchased this SKU and bought again during the promotion. Measures loyalty reinforcement.

attributes.name: retailer_funded_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount funded by the retailer for this promotion. Combined with vendor_funded_amount gives total promotional investment.

attributes.name: sell_through_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of promotional inventory sold during the promotion period. Expressed as percentage (e.g., 85.50 for 85.5%). Indicates inventory velocity.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: The specific product SKU included in this promotion performance measurement. Enables product-level promotion effectiveness analysis.

attributes.name: unique_customer_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct customers who purchased the promoted item during the period. Measures promotion reach.

attributes.name: units_per_transaction
attributes.description: Average number of units of the promoted SKU purchased per transaction. Indicates promotion-driven purchase intensity.

attributes.name: units_sold
attributes.description: Total number of units sold during the promotion period for this SKU at this store. Core volume metric for promotion effectiveness.

attributes.name: vendor_funded_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount funded by the vendor/supplier as part of co-op or trade promotion agreement. Used for vendor settlement and chargeback processing.

products.name: promo_calendar
products.description: Master record for the retail promotional calendar defining planned promotional periods, key retail events, blackout dates, and competitive response windows for a fiscal year. Captures period name, period type (weekly ad cycle, seasonal event, holiday, clearance window, competitive response), start/end dates, fiscal week/month/quarter alignment, priority tier, planning lock date, planning status (draft, locked, active, archived), and banner/market applicability for multi-banner retailers. Used by merchandising, marketing, and supply chain teams to coordinate promotional activity, inventory positioning, and circular production timelines. Serves as the shared planning backbone that prevents promotional conflicts and ensures adequate lead time for vendor negotiations and inventory builds. Supports multi-banner coordination by allowing banner-specific or enterprise-wide calendar periods.

attributes.name: promo_calendar_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the promotional calendar period. Primary key for the promotional calendar master record.

attributes.name: item_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.item_hierarchy. Business justification: Promotional calendars are planned at category/department level to coordinate seasonal events (back-to-school, holiday), inventory builds, and assortment timing. Category managers need calendar visibil

attributes.name: region_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.region. Business justification: Promotional calendars are built per region/market in retail (different event timing, blackout periods, fiscal calendars by market). applicable_market_codes and market_applicability are denormalized te

attributes.name: applicable_banner_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of banner codes to which this promotional period applies. Populated only when banner_applicability is 'banner_specific'.

attributes.name: applicable_market_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of market or region codes to which this promotional period applies. Populated when market_applicability is 'regional' or 'local'.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date when this promotional calendar period was formally approved by management. Null if still pending approval.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether executive or senior management approval is required for promotions during this period (true) or standard approval workflows apply (false).

attributes.name: approved_by_name
attributes.description: Name of the executive or manager who approved this promotional calendar period.

attributes.name: banner_applicability
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotional period applies across all retail banners (enterprise-wide) or is specific to individual banners (banner-specific). Supports multi-banner coordination.

attributes.name: blackout_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for why this period is designated as a promotional blackout (e.g., inventory transition, system maintenance, post-holiday recovery).

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: Total budget allocated for this promotional period including markdown funding, advertising spend, and vendor co-op contributions.

attributes.name: budget_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the promotional budget amount (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR).

attributes.name: channel_applicability
attributes.description: Indicates which sales channels this promotional period applies to (omnichannel, store-only, e-commerce-only, mobile-app-only).

attributes.name: circular_production_deadline
attributes.description: The deadline by which all promotional circular materials (print ads, digital circulars) must be finalized for production and distribution.

attributes.name: competitive_response_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotional period was created as a competitive response to rival retailer promotions (true) or is part of the planned calendar (false).

attributes.name: competitive_trigger_description
attributes.description: Description of the competitive market event or rival promotion that triggered this promotional period. Populated when competitive_response_flag is true.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this promotional calendar record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date when the promotional period ends. Defines the effective end of promotional activity and pricing.

attributes.name: expected_sales_lift_pct
attributes.description: Forecasted percentage increase in sales revenue expected during this promotional period compared to baseline or prior year.

attributes.name: expected_traffic_lift_pct
attributes.description: Forecasted percentage increase in customer traffic (footfall and digital visits) expected during this promotional period compared to baseline.

attributes.name: fiscal_month
attributes.description: The fiscal month (1-12) to which this promotional period belongs.

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter (1-4) to which this promotional period belongs.

attributes.name: fiscal_week
attributes.description: The fiscal week number (1-52 or 1-53) to which this promotional period belongs, aligned with the retail 4-5-4 calendar.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this promotional period belongs (e.g., 2024, 2025).

attributes.name: inventory_build_start_date
attributes.description: The date when inventory positioning and build-up for this promotional period should begin to ensure adequate stock levels.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotional calendar period is currently active and valid (true) or has been logically deleted or superseded (false).

attributes.name: is_blackout_period
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this period is a promotional blackout window where no new promotions should be launched (true) or a normal promotional period (false).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this promotional calendar record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: market_applicability
attributes.description: Geographic scope of the promotional period indicating whether it applies nationally, regionally, or to specific local markets.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments regarding special considerations, constraints, or coordination requirements for this promotional period.

attributes.name: period_name
attributes.description: Business-friendly name for the promotional period (e.g., 'Spring Sale 2024', 'Black Friday Week', 'Back to School August').

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Classification of the promotional period indicating the nature and purpose of the promotion (weekly ad cycle, seasonal event, holiday, clearance window, competitive response, vendor-funded).

attributes.name: planning_lock_date
attributes.description: The date by which all promotional planning for this period must be finalized and locked. After this date, changes require executive approval.

attributes.name: planning_owner_email
attributes.description: Email address of the planning owner for coordination and communication regarding this promotional period.

attributes.name: planning_owner_name
attributes.description: Name of the merchandising or marketing manager responsible for planning and executing this promotional period.

attributes.name: planning_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the promotional calendar period (draft - under development, locked - finalized for execution, active - currently running, archived - completed and historical).

attributes.name: priority_tier
attributes.description: Priority classification of the promotional period indicating strategic importance and resource allocation level (tier 1 strategic, tier 2 major, tier 3 standard, tier 4 tactical).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system from which this promotional calendar record originated (e.g., ORMS, RPM, internal planning tool).

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date when the promotional period begins. Defines the effective start of promotional activity and pricing.

attributes.name: target_customer_segment
attributes.description: Primary customer segment or demographic group targeted by this promotional period (e.g., 'families', 'millennials', 'loyalty members', 'value shoppers').

attributes.name: theme_description
attributes.description: Marketing theme or creative concept for the promotional period (e.g., 'Summer Savings', 'Holiday Gift Guide', 'New Year New You').

attributes.name: vendor_negotiation_deadline
attributes.description: The deadline by which all vendor-funded promotional agreements and co-op advertising commitments must be finalized.

domains.name: loyalty
domains.description: Manages customer loyalty programs, membership tiers, points accrual and redemption, rewards catalogs, personalized offers, tier qualification rules, clienteling interaction records, and engagement campaigns. Tracks program enrollment, active members, points liability, and program ROI. Integrates with customer domain for unified customer view and supports omnichannel loyalty recognition across all touchpoints.

products.name: program
products.description: Master record for each customer loyalty program operated by the retailer (e.g., tiered rewards club, co-branded credit card program, coalition program). Captures program name, type, enrollment rules, points currency definition, expiry policy, program status, launch/end dates, and omnichannel recognition configuration. SSOT for loyalty program definitions referenced by all downstream entities (membership, tiers, rules, rewards, campaigns). Supports multi-program retailers operating distinct programs for different banners or customer segments.

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the loyalty program. Primary key. Inferred role: MASTER_RESOURCE (loyalty program is a managed resource/offering). This entity represents a loyalty program offering operated by the retailer.

attributes.name: region_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.region. Business justification: Loyalty programs are scoped to geographic regions for regulatory compliance (GDPR by region, tax treatment of points by jurisdiction) and regional market strategy. A program operating in EU vs. US req

attributes.name: annual_fee_amount
attributes.description: Recurring annual membership fee for subscription-based loyalty programs. Zero for free programs.

attributes.name: banner_affiliation
attributes.description: Retail banner or brand name this loyalty program is associated with. Supports multi-banner retailers operating distinct programs for different store formats (e.g., Hypermarket Rewards, Discount Club, Premium Grocery).

attributes.name: charitable_donation_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether members can donate their earned points or rewards to charitable organizations through the loyalty program.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the loyalty program (e.g., REWARDS_PLUS, GOLD_CLUB). Used in operational systems, customer communications, and integrations.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Financial cost center code to which loyalty program expenses (rewards liability, marketing, operations) are allocated for P&L reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this loyalty program record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this program (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: customer_service_email
attributes.description: Dedicated customer service email address for loyalty program member inquiries and support requests.

attributes.name: customer_service_phone
attributes.description: Dedicated customer service phone number for loyalty program member inquiries, support, and issue resolution.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the loyalty programs value proposition, benefits, and key features. Used for internal reference and customer-facing communications.

attributes.name: ecommerce_integration_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the loyalty program is integrated with the retailers e-commerce platform for online member identification, points accrual, and redemption during digital checkout.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when the loyalty program is scheduled to end or was retired. Null for ongoing programs.

attributes.name: enrollment_eligibility_rule
attributes.description: Business rule defining who can enroll in the program (e.g., age 18+, US residents only, minimum purchase requirement, invitation only). Free-text description of eligibility criteria.
attributes.references: FTC - Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) Compliance

attributes.name: enrollment_fee_amount
attributes.description: One-time fee charged to enroll in the loyalty program. Zero for free programs.

attributes.name: gamification_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the loyalty program incorporates gamification elements such as challenges, badges, leaderboards, or bonus point events to drive engagement.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this loyalty program record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: Date when the loyalty program was officially launched and made available to customers for enrollment.

attributes.name: mobile_app_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the loyalty program has a dedicated mobile application or is accessible through the retailers mobile app for member self-service, digital card, and personalized offers.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Human-readable marketing name of the loyalty program displayed to customers (e.g., Rewards Plus, Gold Member Club, Everyday Savings).
attributes.references: NRF - National Retail Federation Loyalty Standards

attributes.name: omnichannel_recognition_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether loyalty program benefits and points accrual are recognized across all customer touchpoints (in-store POS, e-commerce, mobile app, call center). True for unified omnichannel programs.

attributes.name: partner_coalition_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this loyalty program participates in a coalition with external partners (e.g., airlines, hotels, other retailers) allowing members to earn and redeem across multiple brands.

attributes.name: personalization_engine_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the loyalty program leverages AI/ML-driven personalization to deliver individualized offers, recommendations, and communications to members based on purchase history and behavior.

attributes.name: points_currency_name
attributes.description: Name of the points currency used in this program (e.g., Rewards Points, Stars, Miles, Cash Back Dollars). Null for non-points programs.

attributes.name: points_earn_rate
attributes.description: Base rate at which members earn points per unit of spend (e.g., 1.0 = 1 point per dollar, 0.5 = 1 point per 2 dollars). Null for non-points programs.

attributes.name: points_expiry_duration_months
attributes.description: Number of months until points expire, applicable when points_expiry_policy is rolling_months or activity_based. Null for non-expiring programs.

attributes.name: points_expiry_policy
attributes.description: Policy governing when earned points expire: never (no expiration), rolling_months (expire N months after earn date), calendar_year (expire end of year), fixed_date (expire on specific date), activity_based (expire if no activity for N months).

attributes.name: points_redemption_rate
attributes.description: Base rate at which points convert to monetary value for redemption (e.g., 0.01 = 1 point = $0.01, 100 points = $1). Null for non-points programs.

attributes.name: pos_integration_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Point of Sale (POS) Integration Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the loyalty program is integrated with in-store POS systems for real-time member identification, points accrual, and redemption at checkout.
attributes.references: PCI DSS - Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

tag_set.value: Point of Sale (POS) Integration Enabled Flag

attributes.name: privacy_policy_url
attributes.description: URL to the privacy policy specific to the loyalty program, detailing how member data is collected, used, and protected.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 13 - Information to be Provided, CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: program_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the loyalty program: active (accepting enrollments and accruals), inactive (temporarily paused), suspended (enrollment closed but existing members active), planned (designed but not launched), retired (permanently closed).

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Classification of the loyalty program structure: tiered (multiple membership levels with escalating benefits), points_based (earn and redeem points), cashback (percentage rebate), coalition (multi-retailer partnership), co_branded_card (linked to credit card), subscription (paid membership with benefits).

attributes.name: referral_program_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the loyalty program includes a member-get-member referral component where existing members earn rewards for referring new enrollees.

attributes.name: target_customer_segment
attributes.description: Primary customer demographic or behavioral segment this loyalty program is designed to attract and retain (e.g., high-value shoppers, frequent buyers, millennials, grocery-focused).

attributes.name: terms_and_conditions_url
attributes.description: URL to the official terms and conditions document governing the loyalty program, including member rights, obligations, and program rules.

attributes.name: tier_evaluation_period
attributes.description: Time window over which tier qualification is evaluated: calendar_year (Jan-Dec), rolling_12_months (trailing 12 months), program_year (anniversary-based), lifetime (cumulative since enrollment). Null for non-tiered programs.
attributes.references: NRF - Loyalty Tier Management Best Practices

attributes.name: tier_qualification_metric
attributes.description: Primary metric used to qualify members for tier advancement: annual_spend (total dollars spent), points_earned (total points accumulated), transaction_count (number of purchases), hybrid (combination of metrics). Null for non-tiered programs.
attributes.references: NRF - Loyalty Tier Management Best Practices

attributes.name: tier_structure_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this loyalty program has a tiered membership structure with multiple levels (e.g., Silver, Gold, Platinum). True for tiered programs, false for flat programs.

products.name: membership
products.description: Represents an individual customer's active enrollment in a loyalty program. Captures member number, enrollment date, enrollment channel (in-store, online, mobile, referral), current tier, tier qualification date, tier expiry date, previous tier (for downgrade tracking), membership status (active, suspended, lapsed, closed), opt-in preferences, linked customer reference, lifetime points earned, lifetime points redeemed, and tier change history summary. One customer may have memberships across multiple programs. Serves as the anchor entity for all member-level activity — points, redemptions, offers, interactions, and referrals link back here.

attributes.name: membership_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the loyalty program membership. Primary key.

attributes.name: primary_loyalty_location_id
attributes.description: Store location where the customer enrolled, if enrollment occurred in-store. Null for digital enrollments.

attributes.name: primary_storefront_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.storefront. Business justification: Members enroll and transact through specific digital storefronts; tracking primary storefront enables channel-specific loyalty offers, omnichannel recognition, and storefront-level member segmentation

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who holds this membership. Links to the customer domain for unified customer view.

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty program this membership belongs to. Supports multiple program structures.

attributes.name: referred_by_member_loyalty_membership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the member who referred this customer to the loyalty program. Null if not a referral enrollment.

attributes.name: anniversary_date
attributes.description: Annual anniversary date of membership enrollment. Used for anniversary campaigns and special offers.

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date when the membership was permanently closed or terminated. Null for active, suspended, or lapsed memberships.

attributes.name: closed_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description for membership closure. Examples: customer_request, fraud, terms_violation, duplicate_account, deceased.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the membership record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Currency in which points value and spend amounts are tracked for this membership. Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USD|EUR|GBP|CAD|AUD|JPY|CNY|INR|BRL|MXN — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: current_points_balance
attributes.description: Current available points balance that can be redeemed. Calculated as lifetime earned minus lifetime redeemed minus expired points.

attributes.name: enrollment_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the customer enrolled in the loyalty program. Supports omnichannel enrollment tracking and channel effectiveness analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: in_store|online|mobile_app|call_center|referral|partner|social_media — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the customer enrolled in the loyalty program. Used for tenure analysis and anniversary campaigns.

attributes.name: fraud_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the membership has been flagged for suspected fraudulent activity. Used for risk management and account review.

products.name: points_ledger
products.description: Immutable append-only ledger recording every points movement for a loyalty membership, including tier-change qualification events. Each entry captures transaction type (earn, redeem, expire, adjust, bonus, transfer, reversal, tier_qualify), signed points amount, source reference (POS transaction, order, promotion, partner, tier evaluation), channel, location, timestamp, running balance, and optional tier-change metadata (previous tier, new tier, qualifying period). Serves as the financial-grade audit trail for points liability management, ASC 606 compliance evidence, tier history reporting, and CLTV calculation. No updates or deletes — corrections are posted as reversal entries. Tier qualification events include the qualifying spend/points amount and evaluation period for complete audit trail.

domains.name: ecommerce
domains.description: Manages digital commerce operations including online storefronts, product catalogs, shopping carts, checkout flows, digital payment processing, session tracking, CTR (Click-Through Rate), CR (Conversion Rate), AOV (Average Order Value), and GMV (Gross Merchandise Value). Tracks digital customer journeys, abandoned carts, and online-to-offline attribution. Integrates with Salesforce Commerce Cloud for unified digital commerce platform.

products.name: storefront
products.description: Master record for each digital storefront or online channel operated by Retail, including the main e-commerce site, mobile app storefronts, and marketplace presences. Captures storefront identity, locale, currency, domain URL, platform configuration (the e-commerce platform site ID, channel-specific settings, feature flags, theme/template references), launch date, status, supported payment methods, and supported fulfillment modes (BOPIS, ship-to-home, drop-ship). SSOT for digital channel identity and configuration within the e-commerce domain. Domain ownership principle: the ecommerce domain owns digital commerce operations from storefront configuration through checkout completion. Customer identity is owned by the customer domain; post-checkout order lifecycle is owned by the order domain; promotional campaign definitions are owned by the promotion domain; product master data is owned by the product domain.

attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code representing the primary transactional currency for this storefront (e.g., 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR'). Governs pricing display, checkout totals, AOV calculations, and GMV reporting. Aligns with the retail merchandising system Price Management (RPM) currency configuration.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; FASB ASC 606 — Revenue Recognition; Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM)

attributes.name: customer_service_email
attributes.description: The operational customer service email address displayed to customers on this storefront for support inquiries, returns (RMA — Return Merchandise Authorization), and complaints. Routed to the case management system for case management. Classified confidential as an organizational contact identifier.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 13 — Information to be Provided; FTC — Consumer Protection Contact Requirements; Salesforce Service Cloud

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this storefront was or is scheduled to be permanently retired and removed from active digital commerce operations. Nullable for currently active storefronts. Used for channel sunset planning, data retention scheduling, and regulatory compliance archival.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 — Information Lifecycle Management; GDPR Article 17 — Right to Erasure

attributes.name: default_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code representing the default display language for this storefront (e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'es'). Used when a customer's browser language preference cannot be resolved or when the storefront operates in a single-language mode. Distinct from locale_code which also encodes regional formatting.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1 — Language Codes; W3C Internationalization Standards

attributes.name: domain_url
attributes.description: The primary public-facing domain URL for this storefront (e.g., 'https://www.retail.com' or 'https://m.retail.com'). Used for SEO configuration, SSL certificate management, CDN routing, and digital marketing attribution. Classified confidential as it represents proprietary digital infrastructure configuration.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 — Information Security Management; PCI DSS — Secure URL and domain management

attributes.name: free_shipping_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum order value (in the storefront's primary currency) at which free standard shipping is automatically applied at checkout. A key lever for AOV (Average Order Value) optimization and customer acquisition. Configured in the retail merchandising system Price Management (RPM) or the e-commerce platform promotion rules.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF — Promotions Management Standards; FTC — Advertising and Pricing Transparency

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront is subject to GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) consent requirements, triggering cookie consent banners, data processing notices, and opt-in workflows for customers in EU/EEA jurisdictions. Drives compliance configuration in the e-commerce platform and CRM systems.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 — Conditions for Consent; GDPR Article 13 — Information to be Provided; EU ePrivacy Directive

attributes.name: is_bopis_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS) Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront supports the BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store) fulfillment mode, allowing customers to purchase online and collect from a physical store location. Drives fulfillment routing logic in the OMS (Order Management System) and store operations workflows.
attributes.references: NRF — Omnichannel Fulfillment Standards; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — BOPIS Configuration

tag_set.value: Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS) Enabled Flag

attributes.name: is_drop_ship_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront supports drop-ship fulfillment, where vendors ship products directly to customers without passing through Retail's DC (Distribution Center). Relevant for extended assortment and marketplace-style operations. Aligns with supplier management and EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) integration.
attributes.references: NRF — Drop Ship Vendor Standards; GS1 — EDI Standards for Direct-to-Consumer Fulfillment

attributes.name: is_loyalty_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront is integrated with Retail's customer loyalty and engagement program, enabling points accrual, redemption, and CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value) tracking at the digital channel level. Drives loyalty-specific promotional targeting and RFM (Recency Frequency Monetary) segmentation.
attributes.references: NRF — Customer Loyalty Program Standards; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Loyalty Integration

attributes.name: is_ropis_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reserve Online Pick Up In Store (ROPIS) Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront supports ROPIS (Reserve Online Pick Up In Store), allowing customers to reserve items online without payment and collect them in-store. Distinct from BOPIS in that no payment transaction occurs at the digital checkout stage.
attributes.references: NRF — Omnichannel Commerce Standards; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — ROPIS Configuration

tag_set.value: Reserve Online Pick Up In Store (ROPIS) Enabled Flag

attributes.name: is_ship_from_store_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront supports SFS (Ship-from-Store) fulfillment, where physical store locations act as fulfillment centers for online orders. Enables distributed inventory utilization and faster last-mile delivery. Integrates with Manhattan Associates WMS for store-level pick/pack/ship operations.
attributes.references: NRF — Ship-from-Store Operational Standards; Manhattan Associates WMS — Store Fulfillment Module

attributes.name: is_ship_to_home_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront supports ship-to-home fulfillment, where orders are dispatched from a DC (Distribution Center) or store directly to the customer's delivery address. Governs last-mile delivery eligibility and carrier integration activation for this channel.
attributes.references: NRF — Last Mile Delivery Standards; Manhattan Associates WMS — Fulfillment Mode Configuration

attributes.name: is_tax_inclusive_pricing
attributes.description: Indicates whether product prices displayed on this storefront include taxes (tax-inclusive, common in EU/UK markets) or exclude taxes (tax-exclusive, common in US markets). Governs price display logic at the product listing and checkout stages. Aligns with the retail merchandising system Price Management (RPM) tax display configuration.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606 — Revenue Recognition; Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this storefront record was most recently updated in the system of record. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental ETL processing, and audit trail maintenance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 — Audit Logging Requirements; GDPR Article 5 — Accountability Principle; Informatica MDM

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this storefront was first made publicly available to customers. Used for channel age analysis, anniversary promotions, and historical performance benchmarking. Represents the effective-from date for the storefront's commercial lifecycle.
attributes.references: NRF — Digital Commerce Channel Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: locale_code
attributes.description: IETF BCP 47 locale code defining the primary language and regional formatting for this storefront (e.g., 'en_US', 'fr_CA', 'es_MX'). Controls language display, date/number formatting, and content localization within the e-commerce platform. Critical for omnichannel customer experience consistency.
attributes.references: IETF BCP 47 — Language Tag Standard; ISO 639-1 Language Codes; ISO 3166-1 Country Codes

attributes.name: max_cart_line_items
attributes.description: The maximum number of distinct line items (SKUs) permitted in a single shopping cart session on this storefront. Governs cart capacity limits configured in the e-commerce platform to manage checkout performance and order processing capacity. Relevant for B2B or bulk-purchase storefronts.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Cart Configuration; NRF — E-Commerce Operations Standards

attributes.name: min_order_amount
attributes.description: The minimum cart value (in the storefront's primary currency) required for a customer to complete checkout on this storefront. Used to enforce MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity) value thresholds, qualify for free shipping promotions, or meet marketplace seller requirements. Configured in the e-commerce platform checkout rules.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Checkout Configuration; NRF — Pricing and Promotions Standards

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Human-readable display name of the digital storefront or online channel (e.g., 'Retail Main Site', 'Retail Mobile App', 'Retail Marketplace — Amazon'). Used in reporting dashboards, operational tooling, and business communications.
attributes.references: NRF — Digital Commerce Channel Naming Standards

attributes.name: pci_compliance_level
attributes.description: The PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard) merchant compliance level assigned to this storefront, determined by annual card transaction volume (Level 1: >6M transactions; Level 2: 1M–6M; Level 3: 20K–1M; Level 4: <20K). Governs the scope of annual security assessments and SAQ (Self-Assessment Questionnaire) requirements. Classified confidential as it reveals security posture.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 — Merchant Compliance Levels; PCI SSC — Merchant Level Definitions

attributes.name: platform_version
