CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_retail_v1`.`_metrics`.`inventory_cycle_count`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Inventory accuracy and cycle count performance metrics measuring variance, accuracy rates, and operational efficiency of physical inventory verification programs."
  source: "`vibe_retail_v1`.`inventory`.`cycle_count`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "count_type"
      expr: count_type
      comment: "Type of cycle count (full, partial, spot, ABC-based)"
    - name: "count_status"
      expr: count_status
      comment: "Status of the count (scheduled, in-progress, completed, approved)"
    - name: "abc_classification"
      expr: abc_classification
      comment: "ABC classification of counted items (A=high value, B=medium, C=low)"
    - name: "shrinkage_category"
      expr: shrinkage_category
      comment: "Category of shrinkage identified during count"
    - name: "adjustment_generated"
      expr: adjustment_generated
      comment: "Flag indicating whether count resulted in inventory adjustment"
    - name: "recount_required"
      expr: recount_required
      comment: "Flag indicating variance exceeded tolerance requiring recount"
    - name: "inventory_node_id"
      expr: inventory_node_id
      comment: "Location where cycle count was performed"
    - name: "department_id"
      expr: department_id
      comment: "Department responsible for the count"
    - name: "sku_id"
      expr: sku_id
      comment: "SKU being counted"
    - name: "fiscal_period"
      expr: fiscal_period
      comment: "Fiscal period of the count"
    - name: "count_date"
      expr: DATE(count_start_timestamp)
      comment: "Date cycle count was initiated"
    - name: "count_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', count_start_timestamp)
      comment: "Month of cycle count for trend analysis"
  measures:
    - name: "total_variance_quantity"
      expr: SUM(CAST(variance_quantity AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity variance between system and physical count (positive=overage, negative=shortage)"
    - name: "total_variance_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(variance_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total cost impact of inventory variances identified"
    - name: "total_counted_quantity"
      expr: SUM(CAST(counted_quantity AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total physical quantity counted"
    - name: "total_system_quantity"
      expr: SUM(CAST(system_quantity AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total system quantity expected at time of count"
    - name: "count_accuracy_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(variance_quantity AS DOUBLE) = 0 THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of counts with zero variance (perfect accuracy)"
    - name: "avg_variance_percentage"
      expr: AVG(CAST(variance_percentage AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average variance as percentage of system quantity"
    - name: "recount_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN recount_required = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of counts requiring recount due to variance exceeding tolerance"
    - name: "adjustment_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN adjustment_generated = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of counts resulting in inventory adjustment"
    - name: "total_shortage_quantity"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(variance_quantity AS DOUBLE) < 0 THEN ABS(CAST(variance_quantity AS DOUBLE)) ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Total quantity of shortages identified (system > physical)"
    - name: "total_overage_quantity"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(variance_quantity AS DOUBLE) > 0 THEN CAST(variance_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Total quantity of overages identified (physical > system)"
    - name: "cycle_count_volume"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of cycle count events for program activity tracking"
    - name: "distinct_sku_counted"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT sku_id)
      comment: "Number of unique SKUs counted for coverage analysis"
$$
metric_views.description: Inventory accuracy and cycle count performance metrics measuring variance, accuracy rates, and operational efficiency of physical inventory verification programs.

      expr: sku_id

      expr: department_id
      comment: "Department receiving goods"

      expr: receipt_date
      comment: "Date goods were received"
    - name: "receipt_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', receipt_timestamp)
      comment: "Month of receipt for trend analysis"
  measures:

      expr: SUM(CAST(expected_qty AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity expected based on purchase orders"
    - name: "total_received_quantity"
      expr: SUM(CAST(received_qty AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity physically received"
    - name: "total_accepted_quantity"
      expr: SUM(CAST(accepted_qty AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity accepted after quality inspection"
    - name: "total_rejected_quantity"
      expr: SUM(CAST(rejected_qty AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity rejected due to quality issues"
    - name: "total_shortage_quantity"
      expr: SUM(CAST(shortage_qty AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity short (expected > received)"
    - name: "total_overage_quantity"
      expr: SUM(CAST(overage_qty AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity over (received > expected)"
    - name: "total_receipt_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_receipt_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total cost value of goods received"
    - name: "receipt_accuracy_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(received_qty AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(expected_qty AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of expected quantity actually received (supplier delivery performance)"
    - name: "quality_acceptance_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(accepted_qty AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(received_qty AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of received quantity passing quality inspection"
    - name: "rejection_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(rejected_qty AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(received_qty AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of received quantity rejected for quality issues"
    - name: "shortage_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(shortage_qty AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(expected_qty AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of expected quantity that was short on receipt"
    - name: "rtv_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN rtv_initiated = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of receipts requiring return-to-vendor"
    - name: "chargeback_eligible_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN chargeback_eligible = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of receipts eligible for supplier chargeback"
    - name: "receipt_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of goods receipt transactions"
    - name: "distinct_sku_received"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT sku_id)
      comment: "Number of unique SKUs received"
$$
metric_views.description: Inbound receiving quality and accuracy metrics tracking receipt variances, quality inspection outcomes, and supplier performance for procurement and quality management.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_retail_v1`.`_metrics`.`inventory_stock_ledger`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Inventory movement and transaction metrics tracking inflows, outflows, adjustments, and valuation changes for financial reconciliation and operational audit."
  source: "`vibe_retail_v1`.`inventory`.`stock_ledger`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "transaction_type"
      expr: transaction_type
      comment: "Type of inventory transaction (receipt, sale, adjustment, transfer)"
    - name: "transaction_status"
      expr: transaction_status
      comment: "Status of the transaction (posted, pending, reversed)"
    - name: "movement_reason_code"
      expr: movement_reason_code
      comment: "Reason code for inventory movement"
    - name: "channel"
      expr: channel
      comment: "Sales or fulfillment channel for the transaction"
    - name: "sku_id"
      expr: sku_id
      comment: "Product SKU involved in the transaction"
    - name: "inventory_node_id"
      expr: inventory_node_id
      comment: "Location where transaction occurred"
    - name: "department_id"
      expr: department_id
      comment: "Department responsible for the transaction"
    - name: "fiscal_period"
      expr: fiscal_period
      comment: "Fiscal period for financial reporting alignment"
    - name: "shrinkage_flag"
      expr: shrinkage_flag
      comment: "Flag indicating shrinkage-related transaction"
    - name: "reversal_flag"
      expr: reversal_flag
      comment: "Flag indicating transaction reversal"
    - name: "dead_stock_flag"
      expr: dead_stock_flag
      comment: "Flag indicating dead stock movement"
    - name: "transaction_date"
      expr: DATE(transaction_timestamp)
      comment: "Date of inventory transaction"
    - name: "transaction_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', transaction_timestamp)
      comment: "Month of transaction for trend analysis"
    - name: "posting_date"
      expr: posting_date
      comment: "Financial posting date for accounting reconciliation"
  measures:
    - name: "total_movement_quantity"
      expr: SUM(CAST(movement_quantity AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total inventory quantity moved (positive for inflows, negative for outflows)"
    - name: "total_inflow_quantity"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(movement_quantity AS DOUBLE) > 0 THEN CAST(movement_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Total inventory received or added"
    - name: "total_outflow_quantity"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(movement_quantity AS DOUBLE) < 0 THEN ABS(CAST(movement_quantity AS DOUBLE)) ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Total inventory sold, transferred out, or removed"
    - name: "total_extended_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(extended_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total cost impact of inventory movements"
    - name: "total_extended_retail_value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(extended_retail_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total retail value of inventory movements"
    - name: "shrinkage_quantity"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN shrinkage_flag = TRUE THEN ABS(CAST(movement_quantity AS DOUBLE)) ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Total inventory lost to shrinkage (theft, damage, error)"
    - name: "shrinkage_cost"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN shrinkage_flag = TRUE THEN ABS(CAST(extended_cost AS DOUBLE)) ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Total cost of shrinkage for loss prevention analysis"
    - name: "reversal_quantity"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN reversal_flag = TRUE THEN ABS(CAST(movement_quantity AS DOUBLE)) ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Total quantity involved in transaction reversals"
    - name: "transaction_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of inventory transactions for activity volume analysis"
    - name: "shrinkage_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN shrinkage_flag = TRUE THEN ABS(CAST(movement_quantity AS DOUBLE)) ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(movement_quantity AS DOUBLE) < 0 THEN ABS(CAST(movement_quantity AS DOUBLE)) ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Shrinkage as a percentage of total outflows (key loss prevention KPI)"
    - name: "avg_transaction_value"
      expr: AVG(CAST(extended_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average cost value per inventory transaction"
    - name: "distinct_sku_transacted"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT sku_id)
      comment: "Number of unique SKUs with inventory movement activity"
$$
metric_views.description: Inventory movement and transaction metrics tracking inflows, outflows, adjustments, and valuation changes for financial reconciliation and operational audit.

      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', position_timestamp)
      comment: "Month of stock position for trend analysis"
  measures:
    - name: "total_on_hand_qty"
      expr: SUM(CAST(on_hand_qty AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total physical inventory on hand across all locations and SKUs"
    - name: "total_available_to_promise_qty"
      expr: SUM(CAST(available_to_promise_qty AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total inventory available for sale (on-hand minus reserved and damaged)"
    - name: "total_reserved_qty"
      expr: SUM(CAST(reserved_qty AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total inventory reserved for orders or other commitments"
    - name: "total_in_transit_qty"
      expr: SUM(CAST(in_transit_qty AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total inventory in transit between locations"
    - name: "total_on_order_qty"
      expr: SUM(CAST(on_order_qty AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total inventory on order from suppliers not yet received"
    - name: "total_damaged_qty"
      expr: SUM(CAST(damaged_qty AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total damaged inventory requiring disposition"
    - name: "total_quarantine_qty"
      expr: SUM(CAST(quarantine_qty AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total inventory in quarantine pending quality clearance"
    - name: "total_shrinkage_qty"
      expr: SUM(CAST(shrinkage_qty AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total inventory shrinkage (theft, damage, loss)"
    - name: "total_inventory_value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(on_hand_qty AS DOUBLE) * CAST(unit_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total inventory value at cost (on-hand quantity times unit cost)"
    - name: "avg_weeks_of_supply"
      expr: AVG(CAST(weeks_of_supply AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average weeks of supply across SKUs indicating inventory coverage"
    - name: "avg_sell_through_rate"
      expr: AVG(CAST(sell_through_rate AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average sell-through rate indicating inventory turnover velocity"
    - name: "inventory_availability_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(available_to_promise_qty AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(on_hand_qty AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of on-hand inventory available for sale (not reserved or damaged)"
    - name: "dead_stock_value"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN is_dead_stock = TRUE THEN CAST(on_hand_qty AS DOUBLE) * CAST(unit_cost AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Total value of dead stock requiring clearance or write-off"
    - name: "stockout_risk_skus"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(on_hand_qty AS DOUBLE) <= CAST(safety_stock_qty AS DOUBLE) THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of SKUs at or below safety stock threshold indicating stockout risk"
    - name: "overstock_skus"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(on_hand_qty AS DOUBLE) > CAST(max_stock_qty AS DOUBLE) THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of SKUs exceeding maximum stock level indicating overstock"
    - name: "distinct_sku_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT sku_id)
      comment: "Number of unique SKUs in inventory for assortment breadth analysis"
$$
metric_views.description: Core inventory health and availability metrics by SKU and location, tracking on-hand, reserved, available-to-promise, and weeks of supply for operational and strategic inventory management decisions.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_retail_v1`.`_metrics`.`order_cancellation`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Order cancellation KPIs for lost revenue analysis, operational efficiency, and customer experience - critical for reducing revenue leakage"
  source: "`vibe_retail_v1`.`order`.`cancellation`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "cancellation_status"
      expr: cancellation_status
      comment: "Status of the cancellation (e.g., pending, approved, completed, reversed)"
    - name: "reason_code"
      expr: reason_code
      comment: "Reason code for cancellation - enables root cause analysis of lost sales"
    - name: "initiator_type"
      expr: initiator_type
      comment: "Who initiated the cancellation (e.g., customer, system, merchant)"
    - name: "channel"
      expr: channel
      comment: "Channel through which cancellation was processed"
    - name: "refund_eligible_flag"
      expr: refund_eligible_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether cancellation is eligible for refund"
    - name: "refund_method"
      expr: refund_method
      comment: "Method used for refund processing"
    - name: "fraud_flag"
      expr: fraud_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether cancellation was flagged for fraud"
    - name: "approval_required_flag"
      expr: approval_required_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether cancellation required approval - measures policy compliance"
    - name: "reversal_flag"
      expr: reversal_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether cancellation was reversed - measures cancellation accuracy"
    - name: "stage"
      expr: stage
      comment: "Stage at which cancellation occurred (e.g., pre-shipment, in-transit, delivered)"
  measures:
    - name: "total_cancellations"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT cancellation_id)
      comment: "Total number of cancellations - primary volume metric for lost sales analysis"
    - name: "total_cancelled_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(cancelled_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total revenue lost to cancellations - critical KPI for revenue leakage and operational improvement"
    - name: "total_cancelled_quantity"
      expr: SUM(CAST(cancelled_quantity AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total units cancelled - measures inventory impact and lost sales volume"
    - name: "total_refund_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(refund_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total refunds issued for cancellations - measures cash flow impact"
    - name: "total_restocking_fee"
      expr: SUM(CAST(restocking_fee_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total restocking fees collected - measures cost recovery from cancellations"
    - name: "total_cancellation_fee"
      expr: SUM(CAST(fee_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total cancellation fees collected - measures policy enforcement and cost recovery"
    - name: "avg_cancelled_amount"
      expr: AVG(CAST(cancelled_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average revenue lost per cancellation - measures cancellation impact severity"
    - name: "fraud_cancellation_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fraud_flag = TRUE THEN cancellation_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT cancellation_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of cancellations flagged for fraud - measures fraud risk in cancellation process"
    - name: "reversal_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN reversal_flag = TRUE THEN cancellation_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT cancellation_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of cancellations that were reversed - measures cancellation process accuracy"
    - name: "customer_initiated_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN initiator_type = 'customer' THEN cancellation_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT cancellation_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of cancellations initiated by customers - measures customer satisfaction and expectation management"
    - name: "avg_fraud_score"
      expr: AVG(CAST(fraud_score AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average fraud score for cancellations - measures fraud risk exposure in cancellation process"
$$
metric_views.description: Order cancellation KPIs for lost revenue analysis, operational efficiency, and customer experience - critical for reducing revenue leakage

      expr: SUM(CAST(tax_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total tax collected - critical for financial reconciliation and compliance"
    - name: "total_shipping_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(shipping_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total shipping revenue collected - measures logistics revenue contribution"
    - name: "avg_order_value"
      expr: AVG(CAST(grand_total_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average order value - key metric for customer value and pricing strategy"
    - name: "discount_penetration_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN discount_amount > 0 THEN header_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT header_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of orders with discounts applied - measures promotional reach and strategy effectiveness"
    - name: "avg_discount_per_order"
      expr: AVG(CAST(discount_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average discount amount per order - measures promotional intensity and margin impact"
    - name: "on_time_delivery_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN actual_delivery_date <= promised_delivery_date THEN header_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN actual_delivery_date IS NOT NULL AND promised_delivery_date IS NOT NULL THEN header_id END), 0), 2)

      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT profile_id)

AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Payment processing KPIs including authorization rates, fraud detection, and payment method performance - critical for financial operations and risk management"
  source: "`vibe_retail_v1`.`order`.`payment`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "payment_status"
      expr: payment_status
      comment: "Status of the payment (e.g., authorized, captured, declined, refunded)"
    - name: "method_type"
      expr: method_type
      comment: "Type of payment method (e.g., credit card, debit card, digital wallet, gift card)"
    - name: "card_brand"
      expr: card_brand
      comment: "Card brand for card payments (e.g., Visa, Mastercard, Amex)"
    - name: "digital_wallet_type"
      expr: digital_wallet_type
      comment: "Type of digital wallet used (e.g., Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal)"
    - name: "channel"
      expr: channel
      comment: "Channel through which payment was processed (e.g., online, in-store, mobile)"
    - name: "fraud_decision"
      expr: fraud_decision
      comment: "Fraud screening decision (e.g., approved, declined, review)"
    - name: "currency_code"
      expr: currency_code
      comment: "Currency in which payment was processed"
    - name: "bnpl_provider"
      expr: bnpl_provider
      comment: "Buy-now-pay-later provider if applicable (e.g., Affirm, Klarna, Afterpay)"
    - name: "three_ds_authentication_result"
      expr: three_ds_authentication_result
      comment: "3D Secure authentication result - measures security compliance"
    - name: "avs_result_code"
      expr: avs_result_code
      comment: "Address verification system result code - fraud prevention metric"
    - name: "cvv_result_code"
      expr: cvv_result_code
      comment: "CVV verification result code - fraud prevention metric"
  measures:
    - name: "total_payments"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT payment_id)
      comment: "Total number of payment transactions - measures payment processing volume"
    - name: "total_payment_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total payment amount processed - primary financial metric for payment operations"
    - name: "total_refund_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(refund_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total refunds issued - measures return impact on cash flow and customer satisfaction"
    - name: "avg_payment_amount"
      expr: AVG(CAST(amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average payment amount - measures transaction size by payment method"
    - name: "authorization_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN authorization_code IS NOT NULL THEN payment_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT payment_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of payments successfully authorized - critical payment success KPI for revenue optimization"
    - name: "fraud_decline_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fraud_decision = 'declined' THEN payment_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT payment_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of payments declined due to fraud - measures fraud prevention effectiveness and false positive impact"
    - name: "refund_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN refund_amount > 0 THEN payment_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT payment_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of payments with refunds - measures return impact and customer satisfaction"
    - name: "avg_fraud_score"
      expr: AVG(CAST(fraud_score AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average fraud risk score across payments - measures overall fraud risk exposure"
    - name: "three_ds_authentication_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN three_ds_authentication_result IS NOT NULL THEN payment_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT payment_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of payments with 3D Secure authentication - measures security compliance and fraud prevention"
    - name: "digital_wallet_adoption_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN digital_wallet_type IS NOT NULL THEN payment_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT payment_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of payments using digital wallets - measures modern payment method adoption"
    - name: "bnpl_adoption_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bnpl_provider IS NOT NULL THEN payment_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT payment_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of payments using buy-now-pay-later - measures alternative payment adoption and customer financing needs"
$$
metric_views.description: Payment processing KPIs including authorization rates, fraud detection, and payment method performance - critical for financial operations and risk management

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_retail_v1`.`_metrics`.`pricing_markdown`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$

  source: "`vibe_retail_v1`.`pricing`.`markdown`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "markdown_type"
      expr: markdown_type

      expr: markdown_status
      comment: "Current status of markdown (e.g., active, expired, pending) for lifecycle tracking"

      expr: clearance_stage
      comment: "Stage in clearance process (e.g., initial, mid, final) for clearance progression analysis"

      expr: reason_code
      comment: "Reason for markdown (e.g., overstock, end-of-season, damage) for root cause analysis"
    - name: "channel"
      expr: channel
      comment: "Sales channel for markdown for channel-specific clearance strategy"
    - name: "disposition_method"
      expr: disposition_method
      comment: "Method of inventory disposition (e.g., store sale, outlet, liquidation) for disposition strategy tracking"
    - name: "is_competitive_response"
      expr: is_competitive_response
      comment: "Flag indicating markdown was a competitive response"
    - name: "is_dead_stock"
      expr: is_dead_stock
      comment: "Flag indicating markdown is for dead stock for inventory health monitoring"
    - name: "effective_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', effective_start_date)
      comment: "Month when markdown became effective for seasonal markdown analysis"
  measures:
    - name: "total_markdowns"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of markdown events for markdown activity volume"
    - name: "avg_markdown_pct"
      expr: AVG(CAST(percent AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average markdown percentage for discount depth benchmarking"
    - name: "total_markdown_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total dollar value of markdowns for gross margin impact estimation"
    - name: "avg_sell_through_actual_pct"
      expr: AVG(CAST(sell_through_actual_pct AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average actual sell-through percentage for markdown effectiveness assessment"
    - name: "sell_through_attainment_rate"
      expr: AVG(CAST(sell_through_actual_pct AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(sell_through_target_pct AS DOUBLE), 0))
      comment: "Ratio of actual to target sell-through for markdown performance vs plan"
    - name: "avg_weeks_of_supply"
      expr: AVG(CAST(weeks_of_supply AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average weeks of supply at markdown initiation for inventory health indicator"
    - name: "dead_stock_markdown_rate"
      expr: AVG(CASE WHEN is_dead_stock = TRUE THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)
      comment: "Proportion of markdowns on dead stock for inventory quality assessment"
    - name: "competitive_markdown_rate"
      expr: AVG(CASE WHEN is_competitive_response = TRUE THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)
      comment: "Proportion of markdowns driven by competitive pressure for competitive intensity tracking"
    - name: "avg_price_reduction_amount"
      expr: AVG(CAST(original_retail_price AS DOUBLE) - CAST(marked_down_price AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average dollar reduction from original to marked-down price for discount magnitude"
    - name: "distinct_sku_markdown_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT sku_id)
      comment: "Number of unique SKUs on markdown for markdown breadth tracking"

    - name: "total_chargeback_amount"

      comment: "Flag indicating bonded warehouse status for customs and duty deferral"
    - name: "is_hazmat_certified"
      expr: hazmat_certified_flag
      comment: "Flag indicating hazmat certification for compliance and capability analysis"
    - name: "is_24_7_operation"
      expr: twenty_four_seven_operation_flag
      comment: "Flag indicating 24/7 operational capability for throughput planning"
    - name: "has_ambient_zone"
      expr: temperature_zone_ambient_flag
      comment: "Flag indicating ambient temperature zone capability"
    - name: "has_chilled_zone"
      expr: temperature_zone_chilled_flag
      comment: "Flag indicating chilled temperature zone capability"
    - name: "has_frozen_zone"
      expr: temperature_zone_frozen_flag
      comment: "Flag indicating frozen temperature zone capability"
  measures:
    - name: "total_square_footage"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_square_footage AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total facility square footage - primary capacity metric for network planning and real estate decisions"
    - name: "total_warehouse_square_footage"
      expr: SUM(CAST(warehouse_square_footage AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total warehouse storage square footage - usable capacity metric for inventory planning"
    - name: "total_storage_capacity_cubic_feet"
      expr: SUM(CAST(storage_capacity_cubic_feet AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total storage capacity in cubic feet - volumetric capacity metric for SKU slotting and density optimization"
    - name: "avg_latitude"
      expr: AVG(CAST(latitude AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average latitude of facilities - geographic centroid for network optimization modeling"
    - name: "avg_longitude"
      expr: AVG(CAST(longitude AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average longitude of facilities - geographic centroid for transportation cost modeling"
    - name: "facility_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Number of distribution facilities - network footprint metric for strategic planning"
    - name: "active_facility_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN facility_status = 'active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of active facilities - operational network size for capacity and service level analysis"
    - name: "avg_capacity_utilization_potential"
      expr: AVG(CAST(warehouse_square_footage AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(total_square_footage AS DOUBLE), 0))
      comment: "Average ratio of warehouse to total square footage - space efficiency metric for facility design optimization"
$$
metric_views.description: Distribution center capacity and operational readiness KPIs for network planning and facility management

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_retail_v1`.`_metrics`.`supplychain_demand_forecast`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Demand planning and forecast accuracy KPIs for inventory optimization and replenishment decisions"
  source: "`vibe_retail_v1`.`supplychain`.`demand_forecast`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "forecast_type"
      expr: forecast_type
      comment: "Type of forecast model applied (statistical, ML, hybrid)"
    - name: "forecast_status"
      expr: forecast_status
      comment: "Current status of the forecast (draft, approved, locked)"
    - name: "demand_category"
      expr: demand_category
      comment: "Demand classification (regular, promotional, seasonal, new product)"
    - name: "planning_channel"
      expr: planning_channel
      comment: "Sales channel for which demand is forecasted"
    - name: "forecast_period_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', forecast_period_start_date)
      comment: "Month of the forecast period start date"
    - name: "is_promotional_period"
      expr: is_promotional_period
      comment: "Flag indicating if forecast period includes promotional activity"
    - name: "is_latest_version"
      expr: is_latest_version
      comment: "Flag indicating if this is the most current forecast version"
    - name: "forecast_horizon_weeks"
      expr: forecast_horizon_weeks
      comment: "Number of weeks ahead being forecasted"
  measures:
    - name: "total_forecasted_units"
      expr: SUM(CAST(forecasted_units AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total units forecasted across all SKUs and locations - primary demand planning metric"
    - name: "total_forecasted_revenue"
      expr: SUM(CAST(forecasted_revenue AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total revenue forecasted - key financial planning metric for budget and resource allocation"
    - name: "avg_forecast_accuracy_mape"
      expr: AVG(CAST(mape AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average Mean Absolute Percentage Error - primary forecast quality metric for model tuning"
    - name: "avg_forecast_accuracy_wmape"
      expr: AVG(CAST(wmape AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average Weighted Mean Absolute Percentage Error - volume-weighted forecast accuracy for executive reporting"
    - name: "avg_forecast_bias"
      expr: AVG(CAST(forecast_bias AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average forecast bias - detects systematic over/under-forecasting requiring process correction"
    - name: "total_promotional_lift_units"
      expr: SUM(CAST(promotional_lift_units AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total incremental units expected from promotions - drives promotional ROI decisions"
    - name: "avg_confidence_level"
      expr: AVG(CAST(confidence_level_pct AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average confidence level of forecasts - risk metric for safety stock and capacity planning"
    - name: "forecast_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Number of forecast records - coverage metric for planning completeness"
    - name: "override_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_override_applied = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of forecasts manually overridden - process quality metric indicating model trust"
$$
metric_views.description: Demand planning and forecast accuracy KPIs for inventory optimization and replenishment decisions

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_retail_v1`.`_metrics`.`supplychain_inbound_shipment`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Inbound logistics performance and receiving efficiency KPIs for warehouse operations and supplier compliance"
  source: "`vibe_retail_v1`.`supplychain`.`inbound_shipment`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "shipment_status"
      expr: shipment_status
      comment: "Current status of inbound shipment (in-transit, arrived, receiving, completed)"
    - name: "shipment_type"
      expr: shipment_type
      comment: "Type of inbound shipment (vendor, transfer, return, cross-dock)"
    - name: "expected_arrival_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', expected_arrival_date)
      comment: "Month when shipment was expected to arrive"
    - name: "actual_arrival_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', actual_arrival_date)
      comment: "Month when shipment actually arrived"
    - name: "is_cross_dock"
      expr: cross_dock_flag
      comment: "Flag indicating cross-dock operation for flow-through efficiency"
    - name: "is_temperature_controlled"
      expr: temperature_controlled_flag
      comment: "Flag indicating temperature-sensitive shipment requiring special handling"
    - name: "is_hazmat"
      expr: hazmat_flag
      comment: "Flag indicating hazardous materials requiring compliance monitoring"
    - name: "on_time_arrival"
      expr: on_time_arrival_flag
      comment: "Flag indicating whether shipment arrived on time - primary carrier performance dimension"
    - name: "temperature_compliant"
      expr: temperature_compliant_flag
      comment: "Flag indicating temperature compliance for quality and regulatory reporting"
  measures:
    - name: "total_freight_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(freight_cost_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total inbound freight cost - primary logistics spend metric for cost optimization"
    - name: "total_expected_weight_kg"
      expr: SUM(CAST(expected_weight_kg AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total expected weight in kilograms - capacity planning metric for dock scheduling"
    - name: "total_actual_weight_kg"
      expr: SUM(CAST(actual_weight_kg AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total actual weight received - variance metric for freight audit and supplier compliance"
    - name: "shipment_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Number of inbound shipments - volume metric for warehouse staffing and capacity planning"
    - name: "on_time_arrival_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN on_time_arrival_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of shipments arriving on time - critical carrier performance KPI for vendor management"
    - name: "temperature_compliance_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN temperature_compliant_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN temperature_controlled_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of temperature-controlled shipments meeting compliance - quality and regulatory risk metric"
    - name: "avg_freight_cost_per_kg"
      expr: ROUND(SUM(CAST(freight_cost_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(actual_weight_kg AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Average freight cost per kilogram - efficiency metric for carrier rate negotiation"
    - name: "cross_dock_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cross_dock_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of shipments cross-docked - flow-through efficiency metric for inventory velocity"
$$
metric_views.description: Inbound logistics performance and receiving efficiency KPIs for warehouse operations and supplier compliance

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_retail_v1`.`_metrics`.`supplychain_outbound_order`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Outbound fulfillment performance and distribution efficiency KPIs for customer service and logistics optimization"
  source: "`vibe_retail_v1`.`supplychain`.`outbound_order`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "order_status"
      expr: order_status
      comment: "Current status of outbound order (open, allocated, picked, shipped, delivered, cancelled)"
    - name: "order_type"
      expr: order_type
      comment: "Type of outbound order (replenishment, customer, transfer, return)"
    - name: "destination_type"
      expr: destination_type
      comment: "Type of destination (store, DC, customer, vendor)"
    - name: "order_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', order_date)
      comment: "Month when order was created"
    - name: "requested_ship_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', requested_ship_date)
      comment: "Month when shipment was requested"
    - name: "is_cross_dock"
      expr: is_cross_dock
      comment: "Flag indicating cross-dock operation for flow-through analysis"
    - name: "is_drop_ship"
      expr: is_drop_ship
      comment: "Flag indicating drop-ship fulfillment model"
    - name: "priority_level"
      expr: priority_level
      comment: "Order priority level for service level analysis"
    - name: "replenishment_type"
      expr: replenishment_type
      comment: "Type of replenishment (auto, manual, emergency)"
    - name: "carrier_service_level"
      expr: carrier_service_level
      comment: "Carrier service level selected (ground, express, overnight)"
  measures:
    - name: "total_weight_kg"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_weight_kg AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total weight shipped in kilograms - capacity utilization metric for transportation planning"
    - name: "total_cube_m3"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_cube_m3 AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total cubic meters shipped - volumetric capacity metric for trailer and container optimization"
    - name: "avg_fill_rate"
      expr: AVG(CAST(fill_rate_pct AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average order fill rate - critical customer service metric for inventory availability"
    - name: "order_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Number of outbound orders - volume metric for warehouse labor and capacity planning"
    - name: "on_time_ship_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN actual_ship_date <= requested_ship_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN actual_ship_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of orders shipped on or before requested date - primary fulfillment performance KPI"
    - name: "on_time_delivery_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN actual_delivery_date <= required_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN actual_delivery_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of orders delivered on or before required date - critical customer satisfaction metric"
    - name: "cancellation_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cancellation_reason_code IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of orders cancelled - service failure metric requiring root cause investigation"
    - name: "drop_ship_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_drop_ship = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of orders fulfilled via drop-ship - fulfillment model mix metric for cost optimization"
$$
metric_views.description: Outbound fulfillment performance and distribution efficiency KPIs for customer service and logistics optimization

      comment: "Type of replenishment plan (auto, manual, emergency, promotional)"

      comment: "Replenishment methodology applied (min-max, ROP, DRP, VMI)"

    - name: "total_forecasted_demand"

    - name: "total_current_on_hand"
